release.description:
Desktop Commander gives ChatGPT access to your computer, so it can work on it directly rather than telling you what to do. It reads the files, runs the commands, and sees the results itself, then continues from there.

It connects to your own machine: a laptop, a desktop, or a server. Not a cloud environment. Your actual files and programs, in an ordinary ChatGPT conversation.

Common uses:

- Files and documents: finding things, comparing versions, renaming and sorting, searching large local archives
- Code and projects: writing, running and fixing code on your own machine
- Servers and devices: checking a VPS, deploying a change, reading logs, home automation
- Troubleshooting: why a program won't start, a disk that's filled up, a service that stopped working

To set it up, install Desktop Commander on the machine you want ChatGPT to reach and sign in with your email.

You choose which machine it connects to, and you can disconnect at any time. The machine needs to be on and online. You can use it from anywhere you're signed in to ChatGPT, including a phone.

release.description:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

release.description:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.

release.description:
Granola MCP connects your meeting history to ChatGPT so your assistant can pull real context from past conversations while you work.

Use MCP when you're already working on something bigger:

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft
    
-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings
    
-   Strategic analysis: Merge meeting insights with documents, data, and other sources for comprehensive analysis
    
How it works:

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

The difference:

Instead of copy-pasting meeting notes into prompts, your AI pulls exactly what it needs from your meeting history automatically. You stay focused on the work, not the research or context.

release.description:
HYPD connects your advertising platforms, analytics, ecommerce, and search data to ChatGPT and is built for PPC and paid media marketers, agencies, freelancers, ecommerce brands, and small business owners.

Platforms
HYPD connects your Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Advertising/Bing Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Merchant Center, and Google Search Console to ChatGPT.

Included marketing data
Built-in competitor-analysis tools help marketers research competing ads on Google & Meta Ads(ad libraries), research keywords (Keyword Planner), analyze Google SERPs and Google Shopping data, find competitors and audit landing pages.

Use HYPD to:
- Run detailed Google Ads audits across campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, search terms, bidding strategies, budgets, and conversion tracking.
- Mine Google Ads search terms to find high-intent queries, new keyword opportunities, irrelevant searches, negative-keyword ideas, and non-converting spend.
- Diagnose Google Ads performance changes and wasted spend by comparing metrics such as CPC, CTR, conversions, CPA, and ROAS across periods, campaign types, devices, locations, and audiences.
- Discover keywords using Keyword Planner data and forecast potential impressions, clicks, CPC, demand, and advertising costs.
- Analyze Meta Ads at the campaign, ad-set, ad, and creative levels to understand spend, reach, clicks, conversions, CPA, and ROAS.
- Identify winning and fatigued Meta creatives, compare audiences and placements, and investigate delivery, pixel, catalog, or product-feed issues.
- Diagnose GA4, consent, attribution, conversion-tracking, and funnel problems, including differences between advertising platforms and GA4.
- Troubleshoot Merchant Center disapprovals, product-feed problems, weak Shopping visibility, price competitiveness, and underperforming products.
- Investigate website and organic-search traffic declines, audit landing pages, plan campaign tests, and prepare reports for business owners or clients.

Solutions
For eCommerce shops and SMBs, HYPD connects all important marketing data and turns it into clear answers about budgets, results, and next steps. eCommerce shops can also investigate product-feed issues, Shopping performance, customer journeys, and revenue attribution.

For agencies and freelancers, HYPD helps analyze multiple client accounts, explain performance changes, uncover optimization opportunities, and prepare client-ready reports.

HYPD is read-only: it analyzes data and recommends actions but does not change campaigns, budgets, ads, or account settings.

release.description:
Trusted by over 47 million people, Todoist simplifies tasks for individuals and teams. Instantly declutter your mind, boost productivity and use it as a habit tracker.

With a simple tap, add your tasks and remind yourself about them, enjoy multiple views like calendar, list and boards, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, collaborate on projects, and achieve peace of mind.

Why choose Todoist?
Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.

• Create a habit of adding tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon” or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring dates.
• View any project as a list, as boards or as a calendar planner to give you ultimate flexibility when planning both your tasks and your time.
• Available on any device – with apps, extensions, and widgets – Todoist is everywhere you need it to be.
• Link Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, and 100+ other tools such as Outlook, Gmail, and Slack.
• Collaborate on projects of all sizes by assigning tasks to others. Keep everything at hand by adding deadlines, notes, and files.
• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS
• Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
• Location-based reminders available on upgrade. Never forget an errand again.
• All the power from iOS: Siri, Today widget, share extension, handoff, and quick actions.

release.description:
Bigdata.com is the AI grounding layer for finance, bringing cited financial research directly into ChatGPT. Research stocks and companies, follow the latest news on your portfolio, and query market data, fundamentals, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, broker and analyst research, sentiment signals, and premium news, with every answer grounded in real, citable sources instead of guesses.

Connect in seconds. No setup, no code. You're searching cited financial data from your first prompt.

release.description:
Connect ChatGPT to Miro to summarize existing boards, update them, or build new ones from scratch. Point ChatGPT at a board and it reads what your team has already decided, researched, and drawn, so its answers start from your context. Ask it to build, and its answers land on the board as native Miro objects – slides, tables, docs, diagrams, sticky notes, frames, and workshop widgets – visual, instantly editable, and collaborative by default.

Key Use Cases:
Product strategy review: ChatGPT generates a strategy presentation as Miro slides, alongside your team's priorities, so the team sees the full picture and comes together to review and collaborate on it. From there, ChatGPT reads the feedback and discussion – the call transcript plus Miro comments and stickies – and writes the update for the wider team.
System design review: Get ChatGPT to create an interactive architecture diagram and documentation for a team of engineers to review and discuss ahead of upcoming changes.
Documentation automation: Set up a scheduled task in ChatGPT to keep your Miro diagrams and documents up to date as things change.
Journey mapping: ChatGPT maps out an existing user journey in Miro for the team to review in a collaborative session. From there, any proposed changes can be picked up by ChatGPT and drafted into follow-up items.

Invoke Miro directly with @Miro, or just describe what you want in plain language. Try prompts like:
- @Miro, summarize the decisions on this board [board URL]
- @Miro, turn this strategy doc into slides alongside our priorities
- @Miro, diagram this service's architecture with the docs beside it
- @Miro, update the journey map on this board with the changes we agreed
- @Miro, turn the comments on this board into action items
- @Miro, build a retro board for my team with dot voting

What Miro can do in ChatGPT:
- Read, search, and summarize context from your Miro boards
- Create boards, and generate full boards for workshops, retros, and planning sessions
- Create slides, diagrams, docs, tables, timelines, sticky notes, and images on the canvas
- Update and edit content already on the canvas, and delete what it created
- Create and update tables, including kanban and timeline views
- Read, reply to, and resolve board comments
- Upload images to a board
- Create, update, and share Miro spaces

Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

Put your meetings to work:
Draft documents and proposals using decisions, feedback, and stakeholder input from past meetings. Prepare for upcoming meetings with quick briefs on previous discussions, pending items, and attendees. Track follow ups by surfacing open action items across all meetings, filtered by assignee, status, or date. Search for specific moments by topic, attendee, keyword, or date range. Build presentations and reports by combining insights from multiple conversations in one place.

Your AI assistant searches and retrieves information from your Krisp meetings in real time. Ask in plain language, such as “What did we decide about pricing last week?” or “Show my open action items,” and get answers grounded in what was actually discussed. Full transcripts are available whenever you need deeper context.
Why it’s different:
Krisp captures complete meeting transcripts with noise cancelled audio clarity, so your AI works from accurate and comprehensive records. Instead of static notes, your meetings become a structured, searchable knowledge base your AI assistant can use whenever you need it.

interface.short_description: Search peer-reviewed research
interface.long_description:
Consensus connects ChatGPT and Codex to the peer-reviewed scientific literature. Ask a research question in plain language and Consensus searches more than 400 million academic papers from Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and PubMed, then returns the most relevant studies so answers can cite the research behind them.

Use Consensus to:
- Find studies on scientific, medical, health, and social-science questions
- Narrow results by publication year, study design (such as randomized controlled trials, meta-analyses, and systematic reviews), human studies, or field of study
- Review paper details such as authors, journal, year, citation count, abstract, and DOI when available
- Ground summaries, literature reviews, and evidence tables in citable sources, with a link to each paper on consensus.app

Consensus is built for students, researchers, clinicians, educators, and anyone who wants answers grounded in published research.

Limitations: Consensus searches paper records and abstracts, not the full text of paywalled articles. Search results reflect the published literature and are not professional medical, legal, or financial advice.

release.description: Vibe Prospecting: Find leads & B2B contact data.

interface.short_description: Find leads & B2B contact data
interface.long_description:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.
capabilities: Turn an ideal customer profile into a targeted list of companies and decision-makers
Find business emails and phone numbers for named contacts or prospects matching your criteria
Enrich company and contact records with firmographics, technology data and professional profiles

Map potential buying-committee roles and prepare meeting briefs from company and attendee research
Find lookalike companies using a seed account's industry, size, geography and technology profile
Count companies matching your ICP to estimate market size and refine territory filters
Source candidates from a role brief and map talent pools across target companies
Normalize pasted company and contact lists, flag formatting issues and identify matched duplicates

release.description:
Everyone has a Rhythm — a way they like to be talked to.

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner lets you shape ChatGPT's voice to match yours. Five quick cards, fifteen sliders, about a minute: choose how warm or professional it should feel, how direct, how much detail, whether it should challenge your thinking or validate first, hold you accountable or keep things gentle. When you finish, ChatGPT starts speaking your rhythm right there in the conversation — and a before-and-after preview shows you the difference.

Prefer it straight? Your rhythm can say so. Turn down the praise, turn up the pushback, and get answers that tell you what you need to hear — not just what you want to hear.

Your rhythm tunes fifteen dimensions of how ChatGPT communicates, including the ones that matter when a conversation gets personal: emotional awareness, encouragement, and the kind of support you actually want in the moment.

Save your rhythm with a free Rhythm account to keep it. It follows you into new conversations — just @-mention Rhythm to bring it along — and into the Rhythm app, a space to reflect, process, and grow at your own pace. Tune it in either place; it stays in sync.

release.description:
Play chess without leaving ChatGPT. Start a new game in seconds, make moves in normal chess language, and talk about every part of the game as you play. You can ask why a move is good, why a move is bad, what to do next, or how to get better. This app is made for people who want to play, learn, and have fun at the same time.

The app is easy to use. Just begin a game and make your moves. You can use simple move names, standard chess notation, or ask questions in plain English. If you are not sure what to do, ask for help. The game keeps going while you chat, so learning feels natural instead of like reading a long lesson.

If you are brand new to chess, this app is a friendly place to start. It explains ideas in small, simple steps. It tells you what each piece can do and why some moves are stronger than others. You never have to pretend you understand. Just ask another question. You can learn one move at a time.

If you already know how to play, you can go deeper. Talk about openings, middle games, endgames, tactics, strategy, planning, and common mistakes. Ask why a position feels better for one side. Compare different moves. Explore new ideas. The conversation changes to fit your questions.

Play at your own speed. Think for a long time or move quickly. Stop to ask about a position. Go back and look at an earlier move. Try a different idea and see what could happen. Chess is not only about finding the best move. It is also about understanding why that move works.

The app can explain forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, double checks, sacrifices, passed pawns, king safety, piece activity, space, time, and many other chess ideas using clear language. Hard topics become easier because you can ask for another explanation whenever you need one.

Want to improve? Review your games after they finish. Talk about turning points, missed chances, and strong moves. Ask where the game changed. Find patterns in your play. Learn from mistakes instead of simply seeing that they happened. Every game becomes a chance to get stronger.

You can also practice specific parts of chess. Focus on openings you want to remember. Study endgames that appear often. Learn how to attack, defend, trade pieces, or make better plans. Ask for tips that match your current skill level instead of getting the same advice every player receives.

release.description:
TriAstra creates personalized birth charts and natal horoscopes in ChatGPT across three traditions: Western astrology, Vedic astrology (Jyotish/Kundli), and Korean Saju (Korean Four Pillars/Myeongri).

Enter your birth date, birth time, and birthplace, then choose the tradition you want to explore. The interactive result highlights the placements and patterns that matter most in your chart and explains the calculation behind them in plain language. If your birth time is unknown, TriAstra keeps the reading to what can still be calculated reliably and leaves out houses, angles, and other time-dependent conclusions. For Saju, biological sex is used only to determine the traditional Daeun direction.

Western and Vedic charts use Swiss Ephemeris astronomical data; Saju follows Korean Myeongri principles. TriAstra is designed for individual natal readings rather than daily forecasts or relationship matching. Results are for reflection and entertainment and are not medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.

release.description:
Understand Your Day Through Personalized Astrology

Discover a deeper, more personal way to experience astrology with a fully personalized daily horoscope. Horoscope transforms planetary movements, moon phases, and cosmic shifts into clear insights about your emotions, decisions, and life patterns all calculated from your unique birth data.
No generic predictions. Connect the app, ask for a horoscope and we will create one based on precise planetary positions right now.

Each daily horoscope reading explains:

1. How today’s planetary transits affect your love life, career, health, and relationships
2. A thoughtful daily reflection question to encourage mindfulness and growth
3. What the current moon phase means for your mood, energy, and focus
4. Three key highlights that define the tone of your day
5. Your lucky color of the day

Astrology becomes less abstract and more personal something you can reflect on and apply in your daily life.

Our app is capable generating:

- Personalized daily horoscopes based on planetary transits
- A complete natal (birth) chart calculated from your exact birth details
- Transit charts showing how current cosmic movements interact with your birth chart

All calculations are aligned with real astrological movement ensuring accuracy you can trust.

Connect our app and enjoy:

Truly Personalized Readings
Every insight is tailored to your birth chart, not just your sun sign.

Natal & Transit Charts Made Clear
Explore your astrological blueprint and see how today’s planets influence your life right now.

Focus on Real Life Areas
Love, career, health, and relationships explained in clear, relatable language.

Moon Phase & Lucky Color Tracking
Align your actions with daily cosmic energy.

Daily Reflection Question
One simple question each day to encourage awareness and personal growth.

Simple, Beautiful Design
A clean, modern interface that makes astrology easy to return to every day.

Notice, understand and take action on your life patterns.

release.description:
AI blogging and content for WordPress, managed entirely from ChatGPT — connect your site once and ChatGPT can write, edit, publish, schedule, SEO-optimize, and maintain it end to end. WP Agent is keyless: you don't bring an AI API key.

ChatGPT authors the content, image prompts, and SEO; WP Agent executes them on your WordPress site through purpose-built tools.

Create, edit, schedule, and publish posts and pages, update existing content, and manage revisions.

Handle the full media library: upload images, generate AI hero images or pull free stock photos, and set featured images sized for WordPress.

Run complete SEO workflows — titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and per-post SEO analysis.

Manage categories, tags, menus, comments, authors, site settings, custom CSS, and plugins — all from ChatGPT. Safe by design: destructive actions are confirm-gated, publishing is explicit, and every tool call is audited.

Works with any self-hosted WordPress site: connect with a one-time approval link in wp-admin, using a standard, revocable application password.

The optional WP Agent Connector plugin adds SEO meta support (Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO) and compatibility with restrictive hosts.

release.description:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.

Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX

Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.

release.description:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.

Want to know what the stars say today? This app makes it easy to read your horoscope and learn about every star sign. Pick your zodiac sign and see your daily horoscope in seconds. You can also explore fun facts, simple guides, and helpful information about all twelve zodiac signs. Everything is written in clear, easy words so anyone can enjoy reading it.

Whether you read your horoscope every day or you are just curious about astrology, this app gives you a quick and friendly way to explore. Read about your own sign or learn about your family and friends. Discover what makes every zodiac sign special, what each sign is known for, and how the signs are different from one another.

Every horoscope is easy to find. Just choose your sign and start reading. You do not need to search through long pages or confusing menus. The information is simple, organized, and easy to understand.

The app includes all twelve zodiac signs:

Aries

Taurus

Gemini

Cancer

Leo

Virgo

Libra

Scorpio

Sagittarius

Capricorn

Aquarius

Pisces

For every sign, you can learn about common personality traits, strengths, challenges, symbols, elements, and other interesting facts. If you have ever wondered why people talk about fire signs, earth signs, air signs, or water signs, you can find simple explanations here.

You can also discover the dates for every zodiac sign. If you are not sure which sign belongs to a birthday, the app makes it easy to check. It is a handy guide whenever you want to learn more about astrology or help someone else find their sign.

Daily horoscopes are quick to read. They are made for people who want a fast look at what the day may bring. Read your own horoscope in the morning, during the day, or whenever you want a little inspiration. You can also compare horoscopes with friends and family just for fun.

The app is designed to be simple and easy to use. Pages are clear. Navigation is easy. Information is organized so you can quickly find what you want. Whether you are new to astrology or have been reading horoscopes for years, you can enjoy exploring everything in one place.

If you are learning about zodiac signs for the first time, this app is a great place to begin. You do not need to know anything before you start. Each topic is explained in plain language without making things difficult. You can read a little or a lot, depending on what interests you.

If you already enjoy astrology, the app gives you a convenient way to check your horoscope and refresh your knowledge about every sign. It is useful as a quick reference whenever you want to remember dates, traits, elements, or symbols.

People use horoscopes in many different ways. Some read them every morning. Some enjoy talking about zodiac signs with friends. Others simply like learning about different personalities. No matter why you are interested, this app gives you one easy place to explore.

Features include:

• Daily horoscopes for every zodiac sign.
• Information about all twelve star signs.
• Zodiac sign dates.
• Personality traits.
• Strengths and challenges.
• Elements and symbols.
• Simple, easy-to-read explanations.
• Fast navigation.
• Clean layout.
• Great for beginners and astrology fans alike.

Whether you call them horoscopes, zodiac signs, or star signs, this app brings them together in one simple guide. Read today’s horoscope, explore every zodiac sign, learn something new, and enjoy discovering the world of astrology one sign at a time.

release.description:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because ChatGPT is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.

release.description:
Follow every match in one simple place. This ChatGPT app helps you see fixtures, live scores, results, league tables, and team details without jumping between lots of websites. Pick your league, choose your favorite club, and quickly find the games and information you want. Everything is laid out in a clean, easy-to-read view so you can spend more time enjoying football and less time searching for it.

The app is made for everyone. You do not need to know football statistics or understand complicated menus. If you only want to know who is playing today, you can. If you want to check how your team is doing in the league, you can do that too. Every screen is designed to be simple, fast, and easy to understand.

Browse competitions from around the world, including the biggest leagues and tournaments. Select a competition to see the current standings, upcoming fixtures, completed matches, and club information. Change leagues with a tap and instantly see new results. Whether you support one team or follow many competitions, the app keeps everything together in one place.

Choose any team to make the experience even more personal. When you select a club, you can quickly find its upcoming matches, recent results, and position in the table. No more scrolling through pages filled with teams you do not follow. The app helps you focus on the football that matters most to you.

The league table is clear and easy to read. See each club’s position, matches played, wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference at a glance. Tables update as results change, making it simple to keep track of the season. Whether your team is chasing the title, fighting for Europe, or trying to avoid relegation, you can see where they stand in seconds.

Match information is presented in a clean and organized way. Check who is playing, when the match starts, and how the game ended once it is finished. Live scores and completed results are easy to follow, helping you stay connected even when you cannot watch the match.

The simple design works well on different screen sizes and keeps distractions to a minimum. Clear navigation makes moving between competitions, teams, and matches feel natural. Large text, familiar football icons, and organized tables make information easy to find for both new and experienced fans.

Because the app runs inside ChatGPT, you can also ask questions naturally. Instead of searching through menus, you can ask about a team’s recent matches, league position, or upcoming fixtures. ChatGPT helps you find answers quickly while the app presents the information in a structured format.

Whether you follow football every day or only check scores on weekends, this app saves time. It brings together fixtures, results, standings, and team information in one place so you always know what is happening. It is useful before a match, during the action, and after the final whistle.

Key features include:

* Easy competition selection.
* Team filtering for faster browsing.
* Live scores and finished match results.
* Upcoming fixtures.
* League tables with wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference.
* Clean, simple interface.
* Fast navigation between competitions and clubs.
* Natural language support through ChatGPT.

From the first match of the season to the last, this app makes following football simple. Open it, choose a league, pick a team, and see the information you need in just a few taps. Whether you support a local club, a Premier League giant, or teams from leagues around the world, this app keeps football easy to follow, easy to understand, and always close at hand.

release.description:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

release.description:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

Slides come from a catalog of 150+ patterns: KPI scoreboards, status dashboards, funnels, waterfalls, Gantt plans, org charts, roadmaps, and more. release.description:
Prezi's plugin takes slides you already have, made in ChatGPT, generated in another tool, or uploaded as a PowerPoint or PDF, and places them on Prezi's open, zoomable canvas, turning a flat deck into a highly visual, interactive presentation. You get a full suite of presentation, engagement, and sharing tools that go beyond static slides: engagement features like polls, quizzes, and Q&A help you teach, sell, and give your ideas traction long after the slides are made.

Already have a deck? Bring it in. Or describe a topic and Prezi will build one for you, with an inline animated preview as it renders. Revise in place: add, edit, reorder, or remove slides and switch themes.

Present and share your way:
Present live with your content next to you in an interactive video with Newscaster mode
Share and export it as a narrated video or a podcast
Share one interactive link where your audience can answer polls and quizzes, submit and upvote questions, and respond to word clouds live or on their own time
Export to PDF, PowerPoint, or SCORM

Every deck lands in your own Prezi account. New decks are private on paid plans and public on free plans. A public deck can be opened by anyone with its link; a private deck has no share link. Changing a deck's visibility requires a paid plan. Signing in with your Prezi account is required.

@Prezi create an interactive lesson about [topic] for [audience]. Include an opening poll, a visual explanation, a demonstration, two knowledge checks, a word cloud, and a final quiz.
@Prezi turn the attached presentation into a zoomable, interactive presentation for [audience]. Create a clear presentation path and add an opening poll, a word cloud after [section], a moderated Q&A, a five-question quiz, and a feedback activity.
@Prezi review this presentation and add audience activities in the most useful places. Include an opening poll, a midpoint word cloud, a moderated Q&A, a five-question closing quiz, and a feedback form.

release.description:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.

release.description:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.

interface.short_description: Your notes, your AI's memory.
interface.long_description:
Hjarni is a knowledge base your AI can actually use.

Write notes in Markdown. Organize them in folders and tags. ChatGPT reads them directly through a built-in MCP server. No plugins. No pasting the same context into every conversation.

ChatGPT starts every conversation from zero. Connect Hjarni once and it stops asking. Ask questions across all your notes. Have ChatGPT write new notes, update old ones, and tag them the way you want.

Set instructions per folder to control how ChatGPT writes, formats, and tags. Share a folder with your team so everyone's AI works from the same knowledge base. Search across everything in one call.

Built on the same open MCP standard as Claude, so your knowledge base is not locked to one assistant.

Use it as your second brain, your project memory, your research library, or your team's shared context. Notes, folders, tags. That is the product. Simple on purpose.

Free to start. No credit card required.

default_prompts: What do my notes say about this?

release.description:
Music Block turns music ideas in ChatGPT into playable sheet music and TAB.

Ask for guitar licks, piano voicings, bass lines, drum grooves, melodies, chord progressions, exercises, arrangements, or music theory examples, and Music Block renders them as engraved notation directly in the conversation.

Try prompts like “give me 5 melodic minor licks over B7alt,” “write a walking bass line over a ii–V–I,” “show me jazz piano voicings with smooth voice leading,” or “arrange this melody for string quartet.”

Music Block supports guitar, bass, ukulele, piano and keyboards, drums, strings, brass, woodwinds, saxophones, and voices. Guitar, bass, and ukulele examples include TAB; keyboards use a grand staff; ensembles can contain up to eight parts.

Every example includes playback, so you can hear what you are learning, change the tempo, and mute or solo individual parts. You can also work with alternate tunings, extended-range guitars and basses, swing and shuffle rhythms, tuplets, chord symbols, and common guitar techniques such as bends, slides, hammer-ons, and pull-offs.

Use Music Block for practice, teaching, songwriting, arranging, and exploring music theory with short, original examples created for your conversation.

release.description:
FoundRole is an AI job search and job application tracker. Search a live job board by title, location, salary, date posted, and work type: remote, work-from-home, or on-site. Save the roles you want to your tracker.

Subscribe to daily, weekly, or monthly job alerts and get job recommendations matched to your profile. 
When you need guidance, FoundRole answers from its library of career guides on resumes, interviews, and salary.

Free to use. Everything stays in sync with FoundRole on the web.

release.description:
Find hidden words, have fun every day, and give your brain a happy workout. Our Word Search game is easy to play, relaxing, and full of exciting puzzles for every age. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole afternoon, you can enjoy thousands of word searches anytime. Play at home, on the bus, during a break, or before bed. There is always a new puzzle waiting for you.

Each puzzle is filled with hidden words. Look across, down, up, backward, or diagonal to find them all. Tap or drag across the letters to mark each word. Finish the list to solve the puzzle and move on to the next challenge. The controls are simple, so anyone can start playing in seconds.

There are puzzles for beginners and experts. Start with easy games or test yourself with harder challenges. As you play, you will spot words faster, learn new words, and build your confidence. Every completed puzzle feels rewarding and keeps you coming back for one more game.

Choose from many fun topics. Search for animals, food, nature, space, sports, travel, music, holidays, science, colors, jobs, and much more. Every theme brings a fresh collection of words to discover, making each puzzle feel new and exciting.

Play whenever you want, even without an internet connection. This makes the game perfect for travel, waiting rooms, flights, road trips, camping, or anywhere you want quiet entertainment. Your next puzzle is always ready.

Need a little help? Use hints if you get stuck. They point you in the right direction so you can keep having fun without feeling frustrated. Whether you are learning or challenging yourself, hints make every puzzle enjoyable.

The clean design is easy on your eyes. Bright letters, smooth controls, and clear layouts make finding words simple and comfortable. Play for a few minutes or enjoy longer sessions without distractions.

Word Search is more than a game. It is a relaxing way to exercise your mind. Finding hidden words helps improve focus, attention, spelling, vocabulary, and pattern recognition while keeping gameplay calm and enjoyable. Many players enjoy using word searches to unwind after a busy day.

There is no rush unless you want one. Take your time and enjoy every puzzle, or challenge yourself to finish as quickly as possible. Play your way and set your own pace.

The game is designed for everyone. Children can practice reading and spelling. Teens can sharpen their vocabulary. Adults can relax after work. Seniors can enjoy gentle brain exercise while having fun. Families can even play together and see who finds the most words.

New puzzles and fresh challenges help keep the adventure going. With so many word lists and themes, there is always something different to discover. You can play again and again without running out of fun.

release.description:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.

release.description:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.

release.description:
Front is your team's customer operations platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp and chat. Connect it to ChatGPT to work on real customer conversations.

Summarise a thread and draft a reply on its original channel. Triage an inbox by classifying requests, tagging them and assigning the right teammate. Look up a contact or account and their history before a call. See what is open and assigned to you, and what is waiting on someone else.

ChatGPT reads the full conversation timeline in one view, including customer messages, internal comments, assignments, tags and status changes, so replies and updates carry the context your team already has.

A workspace admin installs Front for the company, and each teammate authorises it individually. ChatGPT acts with exactly that teammate's Front permissions, and an admin can remove access at any time by uninstalling.

release.description:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. Connect to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Athena, MariaDB, SQL Anywhere, Databricks, Clickhouse, and Oracle.

As a comprehensive Business Intelligence layer, BlazeSQL also enables visualization, dashboards, advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, scheduled reports, and custom PDF or interactive HTML reports.

release.description:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through ChatGPT, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.

skills.name: category-monitor
skills.description: Monitors one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category's aggregate health via JoomPulse — estimated sales, number of products and catalog products, active sellers, the seller-medal distribution, and the monopolization level. Each run builds today's snapshot table and offers it for download; to see what changed, the user sends a table from a previous period and the skill shows the metric-by-metric difference. The baseline is whatever table the user supplies — no hidden session memory. Triggers: "monitor this category", "what changed in this category", "track category sales and sellers", and the pt-BR "monitorar esta categoria", "o que mudou na categoria", "comparar a categoria com o período anterior". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To track one named product over time use the product-change-monitor skill; for a one-shot market-size or opportunity snapshot use the category-opportunity-index skill.

release.description:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.

release.description:
VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you started earlier.

Access is granted through OAuth 2.1 with a consent screen that shows exactly which scopes you are approving: voice:read for browsing your library, voice:generate for producing audio and transcripts. You can revoke a connection at any time from Connected Apps in the VoiceLabs app, which invalidates both the stored consent and any live access tokens. Voice cloning is deliberately excluded from this surface. The plugin can only provision VoiceLabs' own preset voices, because uploading samples of a real person's voice requires a consent an agent cannot hold on your behalf.

Generated audio is returned as a short-lived signed link rather than a permanent public URL, and every tool call is recorded on the account's audit trail with its outcome.

release.description:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.

release.description:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.

Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Ask for a document by name and it searches your Drive to find it, then reads the contents back as clean markdown you can quote, summarize, translate or rework. Ask for something new and it creates the document and writes the first draft. From there you get real editing, not just appending: insert and replace text anywhere in the document, replace every occurrence of a phrase in one pass, restyle paragraphs and individual runs of text, and turn lists into proper bullets or strip them back out.

Tables are fully supported: create them, add or remove rows and columns, merge cells, style rows and cells, and pin header rows so they repeat across pages. So is the document furniture most tools skip: headers, footers, footnotes, page and section breaks, page layout settings, inline images, dates and people chips.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

It fits naturally into recurring document work: updating status reports, filling out templates, cleaning up formatting across a long file, and reworking a draft someone else started.

release.description:
StockLens scores 9,500+ stocks every night across five domains: Fundamental, Technical, Risk, Sentiment, and Macro. Ask about a stock and get its latest composite score, the domain scores behind it, and the strengths and challenges the scoring run surfaced. The 600 largest companies answer with no StockLens account and no sign-in. Free accounts read those same 600, Pro reads the top 5,000, and Max reads the whole scored universe. Any account also reads every stock on its own watchlist, however deep it ranks.

Find your next idea instead of checking one ticker at a time. Discover Stocks screens the whole nightly-analyzed universe by region, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, or volume and ranks the results by any StockLens score, so "the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ" is a single question. Free accounts browse with scores hidden; Pro and Max plans include the ranked results.

Build and manage your own watchlist right from the conversation: add or remove a ticker, then ask how everything on it scored last night. Free tracks up to 10 stocks; Pro and Max plans track an unlimited number.

When one stock matters, start a full analysis on demand, follow its progress, and read the result. Plus Analysis adds an AI narrative and is part of the Pro and Max plans.

- "How does NVDA score on StockLens?"
- "Show me the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ from last night's run"

- "Add GOOGL to my StockLens watchlist"
- "How do the stocks on my StockLens watchlist score?"
