release.description:
Connect ChatGPT to 50 marketing, advertising, analytics, SEO, social media, e-commerce, database, and productivity platforms through one InsightfulPipe workspace. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, compare performance across channels, create reports, and perform supported actions when your connection allows it.

Advertising and competitive research: Analyze campaigns, spend, conversions, audiences, and creatives across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, X Ads, and OpenAI Ads. Research competitors with supported public advertising libraries.

Analytics, SEO, and site health: Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, YouTube Analytics, DataForSEO, PageSpeed Insights, website crawling, screenshots, and Google Tag Manager.

Social media, content, and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, WordPress, and Telegram sources. Upload media and schedule, publish, cancel, or reschedule supported social posts across connected accounts.

E-commerce, email, and app research: Explore Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp data. Research apps, developers, and reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play.

Business data and custom sources: Query BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server according to each connection's permissions. Work with Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Slack, and workspace-defined REST APIs based on OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

InsightfulPipe can combine data that normally lives in separate services. For example, compare ad spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue, or combine search performance with technical SEO findings to prioritize optimizations.

Read and write capabilities are separated. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts. Write actions require the necessary permissions and confirmation for destructive or public-facing changes. Platform-specific safety controls also apply.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, fields, metrics, and actions depend on the user's connected services, plan, and granted permissions.

release.description:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

release.description:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

release.description:
Trabber is a travel metasearch engine. Search for a flight, a place to stay or a rental car, and you get the current prices from the airline, travel agency, hotel and car rental websites that sell it, side by side, plus a direct link to book the one you pick on that seller's own website.

Why that helps: the identical trip can cost quite different amounts depending on where you buy it, and the cheapest seller changes from one route or property to the next. Checking by hand means a dozen browser tabs. Here you ask once.

What you can search:

- Flights, one way, return or multi-city.

- Accommodation of any kind: hotels, apartments, aparthotels, hostels, guest houses, villas, campgrounds.

- Rental cars.

- Flight deals, for when you have no destination or dates in mind yet.

Narrow any search down by asking: direct flights only, morning departures, breakfast and free cancellation, automatic with unlimited mileage. Connect your Trabber account and you can pick your recent searches back up.

Trabber doesn't sell travel. You book, pay and get support on the seller's website, under their terms.

The podcast episodes can be listened to in the Spkr mobile app or any podcast player.

Examples:
“Create a 10-minute podcast episode explaining what the world might look like in 2035.”
“Create a podcast episode explaining how to build better habits using behavioral science.”
“Explain black holes like I’m an intelligent non-scientist.”
“Tell the story of how the internet was invented and the key people behind it.”

Spkr is an app that allows users to convert articles, documents, emails, and ChatGPT responses to personalize podcasts for later listening.

interface.long_description:
Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Codex by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

You can use the Coupler.io connector to:

1. Analyze customer acquisition costs: "What's our overall customer acquisition cost across all paid channels this quarter compared to last quarter? I need this for the board meeting"
2. Review marketing ROI: "Show me the ROI breakdown by marketing channel for the past 6 months. I need to reallocate our annual budget"
3. Identify high-performing campaigns:"Which campaigns are contributing most to our pipeline revenue? I want to double down on what's working"
4. Review sales pipeline: "Can you pull the sales pipeline report for this month? I need to see how many deals are in each stage and the total value at each stage"
5. Analyze conversion rates: "What are our conversion rates from lead to opportunity and from opportunity to closed-won for the last quarter? How do they compare to our targets?"
6. Forecast revenue: "How many deals are expected to close this month based on their probability scores? What's our forecasted revenue vs our monthly target?"
7. Compare quarterly profits: "Check the profit for this quarter, compare it to last quarter, and provide a breakdown by department"
8. Generate cash flow reports: "Could you provide a cash flow report for the last 30 days, including all incoming and outgoing transactions?"
9. Review accounts receivable: "Share the current accounts receivable status and tell me how many overdue invoices we have and which customers owe the most"

release.description:
Use legal methods and guidance shared by practitioners directly in ChatGPT.

Lawve brings together legal AI skills written by practicing lawyers, in-house counsel, academics, and legal technologists from around the world, covering a wide range of practice areas and jurisdictions. Each skill gives ChatGPT step-by-step instructions for a specific legal task.

 Describe your legal task, and ChatGPT can find a relevant skill on Lawve and apply its author’s methodology directly to your documents or questions.

You can use the Lawve connector to:
    - Challenge an argument: “Find a skill on Lawve to review this legal argument from opposing counsel’s perspective, then identify weaknesses I should address.”
    - Assess an AI system: “Find and apply a skill on Lawve to help classify our recruitment AI tool under the EU AI Act and identify the obligations that follow.”
    - Improve legal writing: “Use a relevant skill on Lawve to make this legal letter clearer and more persuasive, while preserving the facts and my position.”
    - Review against your standards: “Find a skill on Lawve to review this supplier agreement against our negotiation playbook, then flag deviations and suggest changes.”

release.description:
Play Checkers inside ChatGPT!

Turn any chat into a live checkers match. This app brings the classic strategy game directly into your conversation, letting you start a new game in seconds, make moves naturally through chat, and watch the board update as you play.

Whether you’re looking for a quick casual game, a challenging strategic battle, or a way to sharpen your tactical thinking, the app makes checkers feel effortless and interactive. Play against ChatGPT, test new openings, practice endgame techniques, or challenge yourself with increasingly difficult positions.

Features

* Instant gameplay directly inside the conversation
* Interactive game board that updates after every move
* Play against ChatGPT at your own pace
* Ask the AI for move suggestions and strategy tips for learning and improvement
* Start fresh or load custom positions for practice
* No downloads, accounts, or setup required

From beginners learning the basics to experienced players refining their tactics, this app transforms a simple chat into an engaging, competitive experience. Open a game, make your move, and see if you have what it takes to outmaneuver your opponent and claim victory!

release.description: Engram gives your AI assistant long-term memory. Search → Read → Tailor → Cover Letter → Apply
All in one conversation, end to end.

release.description:
Turn what you're learning into a quiz you can actually play.

Paste a short note, add fuller notes, name a subject, share a supported public webpage, or ask ChatGPT to use relevant text it can read from an attached file. Trivana Study creates one unlisted 5-, 7-, or 10-question practice quiz with automatic scoring, an AI host, and a play link for you or your study group.

Short note seeds may be supplemented with verified, well-established subject knowledge so there is enough material for a complete round. Fuller notes and supported webpages remain grounded in the supplied source. If you ask to use only the supplied material, Study keeps that strict boundary and may ask for more material.

Answer a warm-up in ChatGPT, then open the full quiz—players need no account. Sofia hosts by default, or choose from 8 personalities in 10 supported languages. If Save & track scores appears, you can claim the quiz and keep plays, scores, and replays.

Unlisted means anyone with the link can play, but the quiz is not automatically featured publicly. For attached files, ChatGPT may send extracted or condensed text; Trivana does not receive the raw attachment. Built for lecture review, class revision, exam and certification practice, and quick checks of what actually stuck.

release.description:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

release.description:
Unabyss is your personal context layer for AI. Connect the apps you already use — LinkedIn, your website, Notion, Gmail, Slack, GitHub — and Unabyss extracts, structures, and keeps your context up to date automatically. Then any AI tool you use, including ChatGPT, can pull exactly the right context when you need it.
No more re-explaining your role, your projects, your tone, or your company at the start of every conversation. Your context lives in one place, stays current as your sources change, and travels with you across every AI tool you use.
What you get:

Auto-extraction from your existing tools in under 90 seconds
Structured context files you fully own — persona, voice, company, and more
Granular permissions: share your writing voice without exposing professional details
One-click exports for investor updates, meeting prep, bios, and ICPs
Always up to date as your connected sources sync

Built for founders, operators, and builders who live across multiple AI tools and are tired of starting from zero every time. If you've ever thought "ChatGPT should already know this" — that's what Unabyss fixes.

release.description:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

release.description:
Finding a movie should be easy. This ChatGPT app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple. Instead of opening many websites and searching over and over, you can ask in plain words and keep chatting. It feels natural, fast, and fun.

Once you find a movie, you can learn more about it. See the story, the main cast, the director, the release year, the running time, and other helpful details. Learn who plays each character. Find out what other movies an actor has been in. Explore the work of a director. Jump from one movie to another without starting a new search.

The app is great for quick questions too. See when a movie came out. See who stars in it. See who directed it. See how long it is. See what it is about before you decide to watch it. Everything stays inside your chat, making it easy to keep exploring.

If you enjoy learning about film, this app is a fun way to discover connections. See actors in different movies. See famous directors. Find movie series and collections. Compare different films. Learn about old classics and brand-new releases. Every question can lead to another interesting discovery.

The app works well for casual movie fans and people who love films. You do not need to know movie trivia or remember exact names. Just ask naturally. The conversation keeps going, so you can ask follow-up questions without repeating yourself. That makes exploring movies feel smooth and simple.

Everything is designed to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying movies. Instead of jumping between pages, you can browse, discover, compare, and learn in one place. It is an easy way to explore the world of film through natural conversation.

Whether you want your next favorite movie, information about a classic, details about a new release, or help remembering a film from years ago, this ChatGPT app is ready to help. Ask simple questions, explore deeper, and enjoy discovering movies one conversation at a time.

release.description:
SkinKnowledgeBase is a public skincare knowledge website and AI-accessible reference layer for answering skincare and skincare-product questions with source-backed context.
For people, it offers readable pages about skincare questions, ingredients, products, concerns, side effects, cited sources, and product comparisons. For AI assistants, it provides read-only MCP access to the same public knowledge structure, so answers can include canonical SkinKnowledgeBase URLs, citations where available, product facts, ingredient context, comparison caveats, and clear uncertainty when source information is limited.
SkinKnowledgeBase is designed for transparent cosmetic-skincare reference, not medical advice. It avoids fake ratings, paid rankings, guaranteed outcomes, and unsupported “best overall” claims. It is useful for shoppers, researchers, content teams, and AI assistants that need grounded skincare context instead of vague beauty claims.

release.description:
Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside ChatGPT.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

release.description:
Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards.
You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place. From there, creators can refine every detail - manually editing elements, adjusting layouts and interactions, and accessing the underlying code whenever needed. This allows professionals to keep full control over every pixel and maintain the level of craft their work demands.

What makes Sticklight especially valuable for experienced creators is the ability to produce non-generic results. Instead of templated outputs, the platform is designed to support custom design decisions and unique product ideas while still accelerating the building process. Creators can combine AI-assisted generation with their own expertise to deliver polished, high-quality experiences that are ready for real users and real traffic.

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.

release.description:
A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
- Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.
- Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.
- Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps ChatGPT write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
- Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.
- Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.
- Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.
- Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
- Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT.
- Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.
- Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Sample Prompts:
- Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."
- Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."
- Knowledge Graph: "@AI Wisebase Generate an interactive knowledge graph for my files."
- Video Learning: "@AI Wisebase Create a video explaining this concept."
- Quiz/Flashcards: "@AI Wisebase Create flashcards from my saved chats."
- Translate: "@AI Wisebase Translate this PDF into English."

release.description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

release.description:
The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.

Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.
• Read, write, and edit real notes - Fetch a note's full content, tags, and attachments; create new notes in the right notebook; update titles and bodies; and restore anything that ends up in the trash.
• Keep your account organized - Move notes between notebooks, add and remove tags, rename and re-parent tags, and create notebooks and Spaces as your work grows.
• Manage tasks inside your notes - Create tasks, update status and due dates, and find the ones you own or have been assigned, filtered by priority.
Everything happens inside your own account, under your existing permissions.

release.description:
Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.

Databases: create tables and the fields to match your project, structure and import records, and browse data sources you have already connected.

Applications: generate an app on top of your data, add and arrange pages and blocks, configure sign-up and login, set user groups and page permissions, and manage app users. Extend any page with a custom code block that ChatGPT writes for you, with every version saved so you can roll back.

Workflows: build multi-step automations with triggers, actions, and branching logic, test each step against real data, and publish when it works.

ChatGPT can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.

Day to day, ChatGPT can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.

Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.

release.description:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.

release.description:
Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.

What you can ask for:

• Your natal chart — every placement, your rising sign and midheaven, the houses and the complete aspect list, with the wheel drawn beside it.

• What's happening right now — the transits currently touching your chart, or a scan of the coming weeks and months that shows the exact date each one peaks and how long it stays in effect.

• You and someone else — a compatibility comparison that lays out every contact between two charts, closest first.

• Quick sky questions — is Mercury retrograde, what sign is the Moon in, when is the next full moon. These need no birth details at all.

If you don't know your birth time, you still get a chart. The app tells you which parts it cannot determine without it — rising sign, midheaven and houses — instead of quietly guessing them.

Birthplaces are matched against a built-in list of over 120,000 towns and cities, so a small home town works as well as a capital. When a name is genuinely shared — Springfield, or the London in Ontario — you are asked which one you mean instead of being guessed at.

Planets are placed at their real degrees rather than rounded into a sign, and every chart is worked out fresh from astronomical data when you ask for it.

release.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

release.description:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.

release.description:
Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can ask for soft, bold, bright, dark, warm, cool, modern, vintage, playful, elegant, natural, futuristic, or minimal styles. You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. If you are creating marketing graphics, it can generate eye-catching backgrounds without overwhelming your content.

It can also explain why certain colors work together, how warm and cool colors change the mood, and how contrast affects readability. The explanations are simple enough for beginners while still being useful for experienced creators.

Need inspiration? Ask for dozens of ideas. Want something unique? Ask for unexpected combinations. Want something safe? Ask for classic choices. The GPT adapts to your goals instead of giving the same answers every time.

You can refine results by saying things like “make it brighter,” “less purple,” “more premium,” “more playful,” “higher contrast,” “better for dark mode,” or “closer to nature.” Each request builds on the last so you can quickly explore different directions.

Developers can ask for CSS gradients or color values. Designers can focus on appearance. Beginners can simply describe what they imagine without worrying about technical details.

This GPT works well for websites, mobile apps, dashboards, presentations, posters, logos, illustrations, social media graphics, game interfaces, email banners, portfolios, branding, product mockups, wallpapers, and digital art.

Whether you need one quick gradient or want to explore many creative directions, this GPT helps you move from idea to polished result in minutes. Describe the feeling, purpose, audience, or colors you have in mind, and receive thoughtful gradient suggestions that are easy to understand, easy to refine, and ready to use in your next project.

release.description:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.

Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.

Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.

release.description:
PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

This connector lets ChatGPT have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.

Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Go beyond "what did I spend?": uncover unusual merchant and timing patterns, see what your spending reveals about your priorities and turn years of financial data into answers, stories and decisions that feel relevant to your life.

Get answers to questions like: "why does my cash flow dip next month?", "what changed our net worth most this year?" and "what does our spending suggest we valued, and which choices bought us the most joy, ease or security?"

Keep your budget in check: review budget performance, analyze spending trends across periods, find recurring expenses, plus access monthly reviews and financial health snapshots.

Plan ahead: use PocketSmith's forecasting engine to predict future cashflow and net worth, and manage the budget events that map out your future.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.

Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.

ChatGPT connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.

release.description:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

Ansvar Systems AB is a Swedish cybersecurity company that gives AI agents verifiable access to law, regulation and security standards.

Customers connect the AI assistant they already use (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or any MCP-compatible client) to the Ansvar Gateway and run compliance work directly in that assistant: regulatory gap analyses, threat models (STRIDE/LINDDUN, TARA), DPIAs and audit preparation, grounded in more than 300 curated corpora of EU and international legislation, case law, preparatory works, regulator guidance and security standards.

release.description:
Factagora — Explore Truth Through Interactive Argument Graphs

Don't just get an answer — see how it was reached.

Factagora turns claims and predictions into interactive knowledge graphs where adversarial AI agents debate opposing viewpoints and generate transparent verdicts. Each node represents a claim, piece of evidence, or argument; each connection shows how they relate. Click through the graph to understand the reasoning behind every conclusion.

What you get:
• Verdicts — TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN with confidence scores from adversarial AI debate
• Evidence — Credibility-scored sources supporting or opposing the claim
• AI Debate — Multiple AI agents (Skeptic, Analyst, Optimist) argue their positions with cited reasoning
• Interactive Graph — Navigate the full argument map visually, not just as a list

Ideal for researchers, journalists, analysts, students, and anyone who wants to understand why something is true — not just that it is.

Sample prompts:
• "Is nuclear energy the safest large-scale energy source?"
• "Will AGI be achieved before 2040?"
• "Is Trump making money from his presidency?"

release.description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

release.description:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.

release.description:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

release.description:
Practice a hard conversation out loud before you have it, and keep getting better at it over time. You talk by voice with a character who holds their own position. Between sessions, ChatGPT keeps track of one or two things you're working on, such as pushing back without over-explaining, and makes the practice harder as you improve.

Use it for a job interview or mock interview, a performance review, giving feedback to someone who gets defensive, a 1:1 with your manager or a direct report, asking for a raise or negotiating salary, a sales call or cold call, an angry customer, resigning, letting someone go, setting boundaries, or a conflict at work or at home.

ChatGPT writes a brief from what you tell it: who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes the conversation hard. NoPressure builds a character, a scene image, and a voice from it, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the call in the NoPressure web app. Before a real conversation, ChatGPT also writes a short cheatsheet with your goal, the points that matter, the pushback to expect and how to answer it, and an opening line.

After the call, you rate the practice in a short questionnaire and ChatGPT gives you feedback from the saved transcript. Then you pick what's next: the same simulation again to compare attempts, a harder or calmer version, prep for the real conversation, or regular practice, for example before your weekly 1:1s. ChatGPT can also give feedback on a real conversation you describe or paste.

If you agree, ChatGPT can use connectors you already have in ChatGPT, such as your calendar or Slack, to find conversations worth practicing and add context to the brief. NoPressure sees only the brief and has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. Your simulations stay in your own private workspace.

skills.name: metrics-queries
skills.description: How to query OpenTelemetry metrics datasets in Honeycomb correctly. Metrics datasets follow different rules from trace/event datasets — many operations (bare COUNT, RATE_SUM, RATE_AVG, RATE_MAX, CONCURRENCY) are forbidden, temporal aggregation is automatic, and each metric has its own attributes. Use this skill when querying a metrics dataset (gauges, counters, histograms, sums), asking about temporal aggregation (RATE, INCREASE, SUMMARIZE, LAST), finding the metrics dataset or discovering metric names and attributes, debugging unexpected metrics query results, or querying infrastructure metrics like CPU, memory, disk I/O, or network stats. Do NOT use for instrumenting metrics (use otel-instrumentation), querying event datasets with "metrics" in their name, or conceptual questions (use observability-fundamentals).

release.description:
Breakreach is a social media scheduler inside ChatGPT: schedule and post to all your social accounts, answer comments and DMs, and track your analytics from a conversation.

Plan and publish
Write posts in chat and schedule them on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Telegram and Discord: at a time you choose, at the next free slot of your posting schedule, or right away. Save drafts to finish in Breakreach, edit or reschedule any post that hasn't gone out yet, and retry a failed one. Platform options are built in: TikTok privacy, YouTube title and visibility, Instagram stories, Pinterest boards, Reddit subreddits and flairs.

Manage your community
Read the latest comments on your Instagram, Facebook, Threads and YouTube posts and the replies to your X posts in one place. Reply to them, hide spam on Instagram, Facebook and Threads, or delete comments on Instagram and Facebook. Read and answer your direct messages on Instagram, Facebook Messenger and X.

Understand what works
Social media analytics in plain language: views, likes, comments, shares and engagement rate for every post over up to a year on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, YouTube and Bluesky, including posts you didn't publish with Breakreach. Get followers and 28-day views and reach for every account, TikTok and Pinterest included, daily account trends, and the full insights of a single post (reach, saves, watch time, retention) compared with your average post.

Getting started
You need a Breakreach account with an active plan or trial. Connect your social accounts once in Breakreach, then connect Breakreach in ChatGPT and sign in: authentication is OAuth, with no API key to copy.

Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.

Ask for a natal chart and an interactive wheel opens in the conversation. Click a planet, a house, or an aspect line and the interpretation loads in place. Switch house systems without asking again. The same applies to Human Design bodygraphs, synastry bi-wheels, transit timelines, Vedic Rashi grids and BaZi Four Pillars charts.

Beyond charts: transits and progressions, solar and lunar returns, eclipse timing and local visibility, astrocartography, electional search for timing windows, and fixed-star positions.

Free to start, no card required.

release.description:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.

release.description:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

release.description:
LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries. You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). Only extracted text/values are stored, never the raw image.
Example use cases
"Remember I prefer window seats on flights — tag it 'travel'."
"Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"
Upload a business-card photo → contact created; upload a receipt photo → expense + meal logged.

release.description: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

release.description:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.

release.description:
Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet app for ChatGPT connects the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.

With this app, users can:
- Create padlets and organize them with sections, layouts, wallpapers, and appearance settings.
- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.

The app does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the app can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.

release.description: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening. Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance. Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.

release.description:
Check, fix and verify any domain's DNS, explained in plain English. DNS Doctor reads the records behind a domain, tells you what is wrong and why, and gives you the exact record to publish when there is one.

Scan a domain for email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mail routing (MX), DNS health, blacklists and domain and SSL certificate expiry. Look up any record on the domain's own nameservers, see whether a change has reached resolvers in six locations, check reverse DNS for a mail server, count SPF lookups, audit the third-party includes an SPF record trusts, and read a domain's registration: registrar, expiry, nameservers and locks.

DMARC records are generated and validated by a deterministic engine that follows the RFCs. The AI writes the explanation, never the record. SPF is diagnosed but never rewritten, because a changed SPF record can silently cut off a real sender. Nothing is applied to your DNS: you publish every record yourself.

Connect your DNS Doctor account to work with your monitored domains from ChatGPT: add a domain, check its ownership record, and read the alerts DNS Doctor raises for record changes, expiry, blacklisting, registrar or nameserver changes and new email senders seen in DMARC reports. It also tells you when that report evidence says it is safe to move DMARC from none to quarantine and then to reject.
