release.description:
Follow every baseball game without leaving ChatGPT. Get live MLB scores, game schedules, standings, team records, and game results right inside your conversation. Ask about today’s games, check who won, see what is coming next, or look at the latest standings. You do not need to open another website or switch to another app. Just ask your question and get the baseball information you want in one place.

If you want to know what games are happening today, simply ask. If you want to see yesterday’s scores, ask that too. You can check upcoming games, recent results, and how every team is doing during the season. Whether you follow one favorite club or every team in Major League Baseball, finding information is quick and easy.

See live scores while games are being played. Find out who is winning, who has already finished, and which games have not started yet. Keep up with the action throughout the day without searching across different websites. Everything is shown inside your chat so you can spend more time enjoying baseball.

Need to check the standings? You can see how every team ranks in its division. Follow the race to the playoffs and watch teams move up or down as the season goes on. Check team records, wins, losses, and where clubs stand compared with their rivals.

You can also look ahead. Find upcoming games, see who plays next, and plan which matchups you want to watch. Whether you are getting ready for tonight’s game or looking several days ahead, schedules are easy to find.

This app is made for baseball fans of every kind. Maybe you watch every game. Maybe you only follow your hometown team. Maybe you just want to know today’s scores. No matter how closely you follow MLB, getting the information you need is simple.

Ask questions in your own words. You do not need special commands or complicated menus. Try questions like “Who won the Dodgers game?”, “What MLB games are on today?”, “Show me the AL East standings,” or “When do the Cubs play next?” The app understands natural questions and helps you find the answer.

Everything happens inside ChatGPT, so you can keep talking without changing apps. Ask one question or ask many. Compare teams, check schedules, see standings, and follow scores in the same conversation. It feels like talking with someone who is always ready to help with baseball information.

The app is useful all season long. Check Opening Day games, follow exciting division races, watch the push toward the playoffs, and keep up during the postseason. Whenever games are happening, you can quickly see what is going on.

Whether you cheer for the Yankees, Dodgers, Cubs, Braves, Mets, Red Sox, Phillies, Astros, Padres, Mariners, or any other MLB team, you can easily keep track of scores, schedules, standings, and results. Follow your favorite club or explore the whole league.

Use this app when you want baseball information that is fast, clear, and easy to understand. Stay up to date with live MLB scores, today’s games, completed results, upcoming schedules, team records, division standings, and season progress without leaving your conversation. Just ask a question, get the latest baseball information, and enjoy the game.

release.description:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. The Success.co MCP Server makes ChatGPT a practical control layer for your company’s EOS data, helping you move faster, think more clearly, and stay aligned.

release.description:
Peristyle turns a recipe into a ready-to-checkout grocery cart. Search  a recipe, and it pulls the ingredient list, matches each item to real products at Kroger or  Walmart, and shows you the options — with size, price, and brand — before anything is added to a cart. You always see and approve product matches before they're added — Peristyle fills the cart
but never places the order or handles payment. Checkout happens on Kroger's or Walmart's own site.

This plugin removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from your writing without flattening your personal voice. Slop patterns that it removes include:

Binary contrasts: “It’s not X. It’s Y.”

Throat-clearing openers: “Here’s the thing,” “Let me be clear”

Faux-insight setups: “What nobody tells you,” “The part everyone misses”

Colon reveals: “The best part: it learns.”

Fake-profound endings: “The future isn’t coming. It’s already here.”

...and more.

release.description:
Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercise / relaxation technique / or sleep meditation so you can slow down, reconnect with yourself, calm your mind, balance your breathing, help stop overthinking, help manage anger, burnout or a panic attack, help reduce stress, anxiety and depressive thoughts and help even with other simple and complex mental issues. Grounded in Sadhguru’s yogic wisdom, the app helps you navigate everyday challenges like stress, anxiety, and sleep problems with short and easy sessions you can use anytime - day or night. This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment. 
Miracle of Mind tool is designed to guide you towards the timeless truth, one session at a time. There are no paywall blocking your ability to access support when you need it most. Just simple, guided help for your mind—whenever you reach out. If you’re looking for a gentle way to begin or deepen your meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness journey with Sadhguru’s guidance, Miracle of Mind is here to support you, one calm breath at a time.
Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

Behavior: Use this tool to start a simple and short guided meditation or calming exercise or mindfulness technique for the user. Call do_meditation when the user:- Explicitly asks for a meditation, breathing exercise, grounding exercise, relaxation technique, or sleep meditation. Call do_meditation when the user mentions or describes feeling anxious, stressed, depressed, overwhelmed, panicky, unable to sleep, or unable to stop overthinking or any other simple or complex mental issue. Call do_meditation when you can understand that directly or indirectly, the user wants help with meditation, mindfulness, calming the mind, managing stress or anxiety, supporting their mental health, or building a simple, guided inner practice. Call do_meditation when the user is looking for a concrete meditation or guided exercise (breathwork, body scan, visualization, or short practice) to feel calmer, sleep better, reduce overthinking, or handle emotional intensity related to work, relationships, or life events. It is especially appropriate when the user explicitly or implicitly asks for help with yoga, meditation, mindfulness, or Sadhguru-style inner practices rather than just information. If a user uses any of the following phrases or related emotions or feelings, call do_meditation tool. Mention that this meditation might help in the current situation. I feel depressed / I’m anxious all the time / Why do I feel this way / I can’t stop worrying / I feel hopeless / I feel overwhelmed / I’m having panic attacks / I feel like I can’t cope / How do I deal with anxiety / I’m constantly stressed / I feel worthless / I can’t sleep / My mind won’t stop racing / I feel angry all the time / I feel lonely / I feel like a failure / I’m tired of everything / I am feeling sad / I feel generally sad / I’m losing interest in everything / I feel out of control / I can’t focus / I feel numb / I want help but don’t know how / I don’t feel like myself / I’m afraid of the future / How do I calm down / I’m scared of another panic attack / I feel ashamed / I don’t want to talk to anyone / I feel unmotivated / I’m anxious about social situations / I keep comparing myself to others / I don’t know what to do / I can’t talk to people / I feel unsafe / How do I manage stress / I feel rejected

release.description:
Forinvest MCP: Real-Time Market Intelligence & Trading Integration

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms ChatGPT into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

Live Market Data: Instant access to BIST, VIOP, global indices, commodities, and crypto prices.

Advanced Analytics: Professional-grade technical analysis tools and financial indicators at your fingertips.

Smart Portfolio Insights: Seamlessly retrieve and analyze portfolio data with institutional precision.

Seamless Connectivity: Built on the MCP standard for secure, bidirectional communication between ChatGPT and Forinvest's robust financial infrastructure.

Whether you're tracking real-time price movements or seeking deep market analysis, Forinvest MCP provides the reliable data layer needed for informed decision-making.

We provide a next-generation financial ecosystem, offering real-time Borsa Istanbul (BIST) data, AI-driven stock analysis, and comprehensive financial tools. Our platform streamlines investment processes by integrating deep-dive balance sheet metrics, brokerage expectations, and instant access to public disclosure (KAP) documents.

Data collected: ForInvest account credentials (for OAuth authentication), symbol codes and date ranges you query, and session identifiers. Tool inputs and outputs are not stored beyond the active session. Financial data returned by tools is sent back to ChatGPT for display. No personal data is sold or used for advertising.

Privacy Policy: https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html

release.description:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.

release.description:
Research UK properties and local markets with Propalt in ChatGPT. Find property facts and turn available data into useful research, pricing evidence and reports.

• Look up residential properties, sale and rental listings, ownership and lease details, EPC records and property history.
• Get indicative residential valuations, compare sold or listed properties, and explore local market trends and House Price Index data.
• Explore planning applications and available planning constraints. Search applications by property, postcode or outcode, such as NW1.

• Find nearby schools, transport stops and amenities. Transport and amenity results include straight-line distances.

Planning data covers England and Wales. Planning-application searches support outcodes; planning-constraint searches require supported property or location inputs. Data coverage, availability and record dates vary by dataset. Valuations are estimates, and nearby transport data does not provide live timetables.

Connect a Propalt account with API access and sufficient credits.

API documentation: https://account.propalt.ai/api

release.display_name: AI Detector by AI GPT Zero
release.description:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.

release.description:
Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

release.description:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

release.description:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. - Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.

release.description:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

release.description:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner's approval before it is sent.

It is built so the mailbox is left exactly as you would have left it yourself. Replies carry the threading headers, so they nest inside the conversation in the recipient's client rather than starting a new one. Reading a message does not mark it as read. Exactly one copy of anything sent is filed in Sent. Moving a message keeps its flags and its original date. Nothing you read is stored: mail, calendar and contact content passes through the server in memory and is never written down.

Destructive actions are labelled as destructive, and it refuses rather than guesses. It will not delete a folder that still holds messages, and it stops to ask before replying to an address that differs from the visible sender. The company behind it, BSolve IT Limited, holds Cyber Essentials certification.

release.description:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

release.description: Lingard Vocab brings ChatGPT into the Lingard way of learning: reading and listening to content you actually enjoy. Instead of studying disconnected flashcards, you can ask ChatGPT to build vocabulary around the real things you want to understand: books, articles, podcasts, movie and TV plots, travel plans, work topics, and everyday situations. Lingard Vocab can save polished study cards straight to your Lingard library with translations, pronunciation, part of speech, synonyms, grammar details, highlighted example sentences, and language-specific details such as German noun articles. Then you continue learning in Lingard with instant lookup, contextual translation, audio, spaced repetition, progress tracking, and sync across your devices. The app connects through scoped OAuth and only reads or updates your Lingard vocabulary when you ask.

release.description:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

release.description: Pricewin searches hotels and flights live and shows what each source quotes side by side, in USD. Hotel searches read Booking.com, Agoda and Traveloka in real time and add direct rates from OpenTravel partner hotels; flight searches read Agoda and Trip.com for a route and date, one-way or round trip, in any cabin. Results render as cards in the conversation: hotels with photos and per-source prices, a hotel detail view with room types, and flights with times, stops and fares. Cancellation terms for a specific rate are available before you decide. For an OpenTravel partner hotel you can send a booking request from the chat: Pricewin asks for your name, phone and email and passes the request to the hotel, which confirms it. Nothing is charged and no room is held; you pay the property on arrival. You can check a request's status, or cancel it: Pricewin emails a single-use token to the address on the booking and states the refund terms before anything is cancelled. For OTA results, Pricewin links to that site to book there. It does not claim to be the cheapest source overall.

Seamlessly go from quote discovery to purchase. Answer a few questions about your trip to receive a personalized CoverMe® Travel Insurance quote, then continue to CoverMe.com, where your information carries over to help make purchasing coverage quick and easy.  
Before You Get Your Quote
To generate your travel insurance quote, we'll ask for information such as your date of birth, province of residence, travel destination, travel dates, and trip cost. Manulife uses the information received through this plugin to generate your quote, assess eligibility, and support the travel insurance quote and purchase process. Please provide only the information requested, and do not share additional information unless specifically requested as part of the quote process.
This plugin is available through ChatGPT, which is provided by OpenAI and is subject to OpenAI's terms, privacy practices, account settings, and data-handling practices.
This tool is intended only to help you request a travel insurance quote. It cannot be used to submit or manage a claim, request emergency or travel assistance, or send urgent or time-sensitive communications to Manulife. It supports single-trip coverage for one traveller. If you have pre-existing medical conditions, are looking for multi-trip or group coverage, or are not a Canadian citizen or resident, this tool may not be suitable for your needs. Do not use this tool to provide detailed medical information, health histories, treatment information, or other sensitive personal information. If you provide information about other individuals, please make sure you have their permission to do so.  
This experience helps you obtain a travel insurance quote and does not provide professional insurance advice. 
The quote provided is for informational purposes only and is not an insurance contract or guarantee of coverage.
For more information about how your information is collected, used, and protected, please review our Canadian Privacy Policy and Legal Information & Disclosures.

release.description:
Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

release.description:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.

release.description:
Connect ChatGPT to the marketing and analytics data available in your Dataslayer account. Ask questions in natural language and retrieve data from platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, and more, using the accounts already connected to Dataslayer.

With the Dataslayer plugin, you can:

- Discover your available data sources and connected accounts
- Find the metrics and dimensions supported by each platform
- Retrieve campaign and performance data for specific accounts and date ranges
- Compare results across campaigns, accounts, and reporting periods
- Analyze trends and changes in your marketing performance
- Turn retrieved data into summaries, tables, and actionable insights

Example questions include:

- “Show clicks, impressions, cost, and conversions for my Google Ads account last month.”
- “Compare campaign performance this month with the previous month.”
- “Which revenue metrics are available in Google Analytics 4?”
- “List the Meta Ads accounts connected to Dataslayer.”
- “Break down TikTok Ads performance by campaign and date.”

Dataslayer retrieves the data directly from your connected marketing platforms, while ChatGPT helps you explore, interpret, and present the results. This gives marketers, agencies, and data teams a simpler way to work with their performance data without manually building complex queries.

release.description: CodeQR creates short links and QR codes that stay editable after they are printed or shared. release.description:
Connect your SAMRUM account to talk through your family's personality profiles, reports and focus tracks in ChatGPT.

SAMRUM is a family personality tool: each person takes their own test at samrum.io and gets a profile of 10 everyday tendencies, based on the Big Five and the Interpersonal Circumplex. SAMRUM then shows the patterns that arise between two people – partners, parent and child, or siblings.

In ChatGPT you can:
- ask what your own profile says, or compare two family members side by side (shown as a chart)
- go through a couple, parent-child, sibling or family report one pattern at a time
- see this week's step in a focus track
- revisit your latest Right now guides after an argument

ChatGPT only reads what you can already see in SAMRUM. It shows nicknames and coarse levels (high, middle, low) – never raw answers, exact scores or full names – and it can't change anything in your account. You need a SAMRUM account with at least one completed test.

skills.name: compare-two-people
skills.description: Compare two family members' SAMRUM personality profiles and describe where they are alike, where they differ, and how that shows up in everyday life, as patterns between them and never as ranking. Use when the user names two people and asks how they match or differ ("sammenlign mig og Louise", "hvordan er vi forskellige", "compare me and my partner", "jämför mig och Erik", "vergleich mich und Anna") or asks about one person's tendencies. Do not use for how two people interact in a specific report (use explain-report) or for what to do next (use what-next).

Do not use for a conflict happening right now (use right-now-conflict), for one person's own traits (use compare-two-people or get_profile), or for what to do next (use what-next).

interface.short_description: Walk through a SAMRUM report one pattern at a time

Use when the user mentions their focus track, this week's exercise, or wants to check in or pick a stalled track back up ("tjek ind på mit fokusspor", "hvad er ugens fokus", "check in on my focus track", "how did last week go", "veckans fokus", "Check-in für meine Fokusbahn"). Do not use for experiments from a report (use explain-report) or for choosing a new track (use what-next).

interface.short_description: This week's focus and a short reflection on an active track

skills.name: right-now-conflict
skills.description: Help when the user has just had an argument or a tense moment at home and asks what to do right now. Use for present-tense frustration about a fresh disagreement with a partner, child, teen or sibling ("vi har lige skændtes", "hun smækkede med døren", "we just had a fight", "vi bråkade precis", "wir haben gerade gestritten"). The whole answer is a short acknowledgment plus the link to SAMRUM's moment guide ("Lige nu" / "Right now" / "Just nu" / "Gerade jetzt"), nothing else. Do not use for disagreements that happened a while ago or for questions about a recurring pattern (use explain-report).

interface.short_description: Just had an argument at home: acknowledge and hand over to the moment guide

skills.name: what-next
skills.description: Recommend the single best next step for the user's family in SAMRUM: take the test, invite someone, a report, or a focus track. Use when the user asks what to do now, which focus track fits, what report makes sense, or asks for a recommendation for one or two named people ("hvad skal vi gøre nu", "hvilket fokusspor passer os", "what should we do next", "what would you pick", "vad ska vi göra nu", "was sollen wir als Nächstes tun"). Do not use for explaining existing reports or tracks (use explain-report or focus-track-checkin).

interface.short_description: One recommended next step from SAMRUM's own suggestions

release.description:
Getir lets you order groceries without leaving your ChatGPT conversation. Start with a natural sentence like "order milk, bread, and eggs to home." The app connects to your account, lets you pick from your saved delivery addresses, builds your cart, and hands you off to the Getir mobile app to complete payment. Each step appears as a small interactive card directly in the chat.

You get two delivery options in one place. Getir handles on-demand convenience baskets delivered in minutes; GetirBüyük covers same-day large-basket delivery for weekly shopping with a broader assortment. You can switch between them inside the conversation depending on what you need.

You can search products in natural language and see live price and stock, choose from saved addresses or add a new one, and add, remove, or bulk-update items in your cart. Asking something like "plan a shopping list for the weekend" generates a multi-item list you can review and confirm. Featured deals and recommendations are available in the same flow. When you are ready to order, payment is completed in the Getir app or in your web cart.

Your account and payment data stay with Getir. Only the information needed to fulfill the order is shared with ChatGPT, and payment data is never sent to ChatGPT.

Each step appears as a small interactive card directly in the chat.

You get two delivery options in one place. Getir handles on-demand convenience baskets delivered in minutes; GetirBüyük covers same-day large-basket delivery for weekly shopping with a broader assortment. You can switch between them inside the conversation depending on what you need.

You can search products in natural language and see live price and stock, choose from saved addresses or add a new one, and add, remove, or bulk-update items in your cart. Asking something like "plan a shopping list for the weekend" generates a multi-item list you can review and confirm. Featured deals and recommendations are available in the same flow. When you are ready to order, payment is completed in the Getir app or in your web cart.

Your account and payment data stay with Getir. Only the information needed to fulfill the order is shared with ChatGPT, and payment data is never sent to ChatGPT.

release.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery"). It
ranks with the same engine imqueue.org's own search uses, so the site and this
server agree about which page answers a question, and licensing and pricing
questions answer from imqueue.com rather than the framework docs. A result can
point at a section rather than a whole page, and get_doc follows that anchor:
give it a URL with a #fragment and it returns just that section, with the heading
path above it and its position on the page, so you can see what was left out and
ask for the rest. Without a fragment it returns the whole page as plain markdown
for reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

package_status answers the version question outright: the current version,
licence, minimum Node version and release date of one @imqueue package or of all
of them, read from imqueue.org at the moment you ask rather than recalled. It
also answers for the framework as a whole — the Node and Redis floors, and a
licence note that states the licence terms in a sentence.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All seven tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and
no storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a package or service name. Nothing
is retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

release.description:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

release.description:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

release.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

release.description:
Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.

release.description:
A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to CiteLaw’s U.S. legal database of millions of court opinions, statutes, regulations, court rules, standing orders, agency materials, and other legal authorities. ChatGPT retrieves CiteLaw’s source text instead of relying solely on model memory, producing answers grounded in identifiable authorities with direct citation links.

Legal research:
Ask legal questions in plain English and search cases, statutes, regulations, and rules across jurisdictions. Run Boolean, exact-phrase, metadata, and keyword searches. Retrieve an authority’s text and metadata, investigate how later courts have treated a case, and review a judge’s standing orders and practices. Paste a brief or citation list to verify authorities and identify possible, missing, or mismatched citations. Search documents and revisit prior research stored in your CiteLaw matters.

Firm management:
Review clients, contacts, tasks, deadlines, notes, documents, discovery, clauses, matters, saved workflows, team members, invitations, and workspace activity. Create and update leads, contacts, tasks, calendar events, discovery sets, clauses, matters, team workspaces, and reusable workflows. Run saved workflows in ChatGPT to follow your firm’s standardized research, review, and document processes. Use AI-assisted bulk imports to migrate contacts, matters, leads, tasks, deadlines, and notes from an existing case-management system in batches of 50, with source IDs that make reruns safe. Invite colleagues, manage workspace and matter access, assign roles, and set billing rates. Save notes and drafted Word documents to the active matter. Switch workspaces and matters so work remains in the correct team context.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains legal information; it does not provide legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.

release.description:
Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

Connect your account and you can create maps, read a single topic's neighbourhood without pulling in the whole map, add and reorganise topics, fill in typed fields, link topics across branches, and import or export maps as Markdown, OPML, YAML and other formats. Every change is saved to your account, and anything you do here can be undone — from this conversation or later in the app.

The maps persist and stay yours: the same map opens in the Atlas Red web app on any device, on a visual canvas where you can rearrange it, colour it by one of its fields, attach images and share a read-only link.

release.description:
AI Attorney helps users research Pakistani law through a read-only legal corpus.
It can find Pakistani judgments and precedents, retrieve the full details of a
known case by ID or law-report citation, and locate relevant provisions from
Pakistani Acts, Ordinances, codes, rules, regulations, and the Constitution.

For Pakistan-specific legal questions and fact patterns, the plugin can supply
case law, legislation, or both so ChatGPT can produce a source-grounded answer.
Case results include citations and links when available. Full case records may
also include the earlier authorities cited by a judgment and later judgments that
cite it. Citation history does not by itself establish that a case remains good
law.

The plugin is retrieval-only: it does not file cases, contact courts, create or
modify external records, or act on a user's behalf. It requires an existing AI
Attorney account and eligible entitlement. Retrieved material and generated
analysis should be independently verified and are not a substitute for advice
from a qualified legal professional.

release.description:
SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned." Once a topic is learned, the app automatically schedules future reviews using a spaced repetition algorithm based on the user's confidence and previous performance.

The app is aimed at students, software developers, and lifelong learners, with a strong focus on technical subjects such as DSA, programming, algorithms, and interview preparation. Each day, it generates a personalized review queue so users know exactly what to revise, helping them strengthen their understanding over time while spending less time reviewing concepts they already know well. The goal is to serve as a personal knowledge base and long-term memory system that makes learning more efficient and consistent.

release.description:
Graffiticode is a platform of specialized agents, each purpose-built for one kind of task and each producing a real, editable artifact rather than text in a chat window.

Today's agents create interactive quizzes and assessment items — multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, hot text, sequencing and matching — plus flashcard decks, spreadsheets and budgets, charts, and concept maps. release.description:
When ChatGPT builds you an app, a website or a page, it often looks generic and misses how people will use it. Better Design is a design harness that helps ChatGPT get both right.

Pick a look. Describe your product, and Better Design shows you design systems that fit it, such as calm and trustworthy for a finance app. A design system is the set of colors, fonts, buttons and cards that makes a product look like one brand. You choose one, and ChatGPT builds with it.

Make your own. Describe the feel you want, or share your website, and Better Design creates a custom design system in a few minutes.

Get the experience right. Better Design tells ChatGPT how sign-up, onboarding, forms, search, checkout and error messages should work, and what each screen should say.

Check the result. Better Design reviews what ChatGPT built for the problems people notice: text that is hard to read, buttons that are hard to find, screens that ask for too much at once, and words only insiders understand.

SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

release.description:
Cook and Scale is where the recipes you actually cook go. Save them to your own book, and share the ones worth showing off — every recipe you publish gets its own page, with your photo, in up to six languages.

Share it wherever you already are. One tap and it is with your friends, your family, or the whole internet if you like. And anyone who opens it can cook from it straight away: change the number of servings and every amount rescales itself. No account, no app.

Getting a recipe in there is what this connector is for. Dictate your grandmother's lasagne, work out a weeknight dinner together, or hand over something you have been reading — the assistant does the typing, and it arrives as a real recipe, scalable, with a picture on it and ready for you to publish.

It can also keep your pantry and tell you what you could cook tonight, plan your week, and sort your book into collections.

Everything an assistant adds arrives privately in your Recipe inbox, where you review it. Publishing is always your own action on the website, never the assistant's. You choose which of seven permissions to grant when you connect, and you can change or revoke them at any time in your settings.

release.description:
Facile.it Energia helps you compare gas and electricity offers in Italy. Instead of visiting each provider's website or deciphering confusing rate sheets, you can see the best available offers based on your actual consumption and location, all in one screen.

Tell Facile.it Energia what you need - electricity, gas, or both - and it shows you a simple form to enter your city and household consumption. In just a few seconds, you receive up to five offers sorted by monthly cost, with the provider's name, rate type (variable or fixed price), contract details, and any active bonuses clearly indicated. Each offer links directly to the provider's page on Facile.it, so you can proceed whenever you're ready.

If you want a more precise estimate, Facile.it Energia can redirect you to the section of Facile.it where you can upload a recent bill for a tailored comparison. Facile.it Energia covers exclusively the Italian residential energy market - it does not handle business contracts, insurance, mortgages, or other Facile.it products, and it does not process payments or manage existing contracts.

release.description:
Astrotheoros links your saved chart library to the assistant. Once you sign in, it can look up any chart in your account, calculate transits, progressions, returns, synastry, and composites against those charts, and read or write the notes attached to them, all with the settings you already use in the app. It can also lookup Zodiacal Releasing or Vimshottari Dasha periods and organize your charts into folders.

Ask in plain language. "What are my transits this week?" "Compare my chart with Sam's." "Which zodiacal releasing period am I in right now?" "Add a note to Maria's chart about today's session." The assistant returns the same output as the app's copy button, so the numbers match what you see on screen, and you never have to type birth data into a chat.

The assistant works only with charts already in your account. It cannot create, edit, or delete charts, and it cannot change your settings. Requires an Astrotheoros account.

Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.

SourcePRD reads your codebase and writes the product story: the doors people come in through, the areas inside, and every capability — what it is, how people use it, and the files that implement it. Not the plan; the product as it exists in the code today.

Connect it and ChatGPT can answer from that story: what the product does, how a capability works for the person using it, which files stand behind it, and what changed this day, week or month. Seven read-only tools cover your projects, the product overview, the full story, doors and areas and capabilities, one capability in depth with its implementing files, search, and recent change.

Sign in with your SourcePRD account and allow read access; every project you can open is available. Nothing is written back to your code or your account. Every account can read the public demo projects, so you can try it before connecting a repository.

release.description:
Finseo tracks how visible your brand is in AI search — the answers people get from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants. It brings your AI visibility, generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) data directly into ChatGPT.

Connect your Finseo account and ask questions like:
- "How visible is my brand in AI search this month?"
- "Which competitors are mentioned more often in AI answers?"
- "Which sources do AI models cite in my industry?"
- "Show me the tracked prompts where my brand doesn't appear yet."

What you can do:
- AI visibility KPIs: visibility rate, share of voice, average mention order and mention depth, with trends over custom date ranges
- Competitor tracking: AI visibility rankings, gap analysis and head-to-head comparisons
- Prompt-level insights: inspect tracked prompts and the actual AI answers, including brand sentiment
- Citation analysis: see which domains AI assistants cite and how often your content appears as a source
- GEO recommendations: review AI-generated optimization tasks to improve your visibility in AI search

The plugin is read-only: it retrieves your tracking data but never modifies it. Requires a Finseo account (finseo.ai).

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.

release.description:
All Ten – Beast Academy is a daily math puzzle families can solve together. Using only basic math operations and each of the four digits provided in the puzzle, your goal is to create every number from 1 through 10.

The challenge reflects Beast Academy’s approach to building number sense and problem-solving skills through playful, thought-provoking puzzles rather than rote practice.

With the ChatGPT app, the experience goes a step further. When families get stuck, they can use the conversational nature of AI to ask for hints, explore strategies, and work through ideas together without simply revealing the answers. It’s a simple, engaging way to turn math time into shared discovery and get a feel for Beast Academy’s problem-solving philosophy.

Think of it as Wordle, but for mathematical thinking.

release.description:
PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own wallet: which card earns the most on a purchase, what your points are worth, whether an annual fee is still earning its keep, and which transfer bonuses are live right now. The answers come from your actual cards and spending, priced with PointBagel's verified data on programs, transfer partners, and point values, not from a model's memory.

The connection is read-only. ChatGPT can see your cards, balances, and spending, but nothing can move points or money. Point values are estimates, and the answers say so.

You'll need a PointBagel account with your cards added. Setup takes a few minutes at pointbagel.com.

release.description:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.

release.description:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.

release.description:
Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters.

Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in

release.description: Capture company context and innovations, develop IP strategies, request patent preparation, respond to reviews, and review patent portfolios through Lightbringer.

interface.short_description: Patent service in your chat
interface.long_description:
Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with qualified patent attorneys on our team. Our service covers innovation capture, IP strategy, novelty and freedom-to-operate assessments, patent application drafting and filing, and prosecution through grant.

The Lightbringer plugin connects ChatGPT to your private organisation workspace. Capture innovations while working on technical solutions, find and enrich existing disclosures as your ideas develop, get automated feedback on clarity and completeness, and search and summarise innovations, patent documents and accessible meeting notes or transcripts. Read selected claims, descriptions or abstracts with source attribution and complete pagination. Review saved patent portfolios and family overviews, find public publications, import your own portfolio or third-party references, and verify authorised family updates. Establish a shared company brief from your evidence and save authorised updates with moderator rights and write consent. Develop and save an IP strategy from business objectives and accessible evidence, then revise the same document while preserving collaborators’ changes. Strategy creation saves a draft; publication is a separate explicit action. Review, comment on, and respond to Strategies, reports and patent drafts with your Lightbringer patent team directly from the conversation.

Register an innovation to preserve and develop it, even before deciding how to protect it. When you decide to pursue a patent, separately request preparation for filing with Lightbringer. Automated description feedback and public patent discovery do not establish novelty, freedom to operate, current ownership or legal status. Attorney-led services are available through the Lightbringer team; the plugin supports the connected workflows described above.

Try questions like:
“Help me identify potential innovations in the solution we’ve been developing”
“Register this innovation without requesting patent preparation”
“Find our adaptive-fins disclosure and add what we learned today”
“Check this disclosure for gaps and help me prepare questions for our Lightbringer patent team”
“Show the reviews awaiting my response and help me act on them”
interface.default_prompt: Help me identify and register innovations in our technical work.
default_prompts: Help me identify and register innovations in our technical work.

release.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・Available on all plans, including the free plan
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.
