release.description:
Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

release.description:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.

release.description:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.

release.description:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.

If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.

release.description:
VoyageHacks brings a multilingual travel library into ChatGPT: about 680 fact-checked guides in each of 11 languages, covering flights, airline reviews, hotels, destinations, car rental, trains, airport transfers, eSIM and travel gear.

Ask a travel question and ChatGPT can search the library and quote it with a real source URL and a real last-updated date, instead of relying on training data that may be a year stale.

Ask what to pack for a specific trip and it builds a kit from the VoyageHacks travel gear catalog: roughly 320 products picked across about 50 published buying guides, one per category, each with the published reason it was chosen and a link to the guide that reviews it.

Every guide exists in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese, each written independently rather than machine-translated, so a reader gets sources in their own language.

All tools are read-only. The app returns published guides and product recommendations: it has no live fares or room rates, does not check availability, and cannot make a booking or take a payment. No account or sign-in is needed.

Some links are affiliate links. VoyageHacks may earn a commission from qualifying purchases at no additional cost to the user.

Something in your life keeps coming back to the same place — the same argument, the same work you have outgrown, the same feeling of carrying everyone and being unseen. You know the loop. You cannot see it from inside it.

Leela opens a board in this chat and puts a Guide beside you. First the Guide helps you say the one question you actually came with, not the polished version of it. Then you throw the die once, and the square you land on answers a piece of that question — in your own words, not a horoscope.

Leela (Gyan Chauper) is a real Indian game of self-knowledge: seventy-two squares with snakes and arrows, played for centuries before it travelled west and became Snakes and Ladders. The full walk across all seventy-two, with the Guide on every square, continues on the site.

release.description:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.

release.description:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so ChatGPT asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.

release.description:
Socra Cortex helps people and teams stop repeating the same preferences, requirements, and decisions to ChatGPT and Codex. It keeps that knowledge and its reasons in a single source of truth that agents can retrieve before acting, across conversations and tools.

Modules record what should be and why, with a responsible owner and version history. Dependencies link the knowledge required to understand it. Flash loads the relevant Module and all its Dependencies, foundations first and each Module once.

Team members can own different subjects while their knowledge works together. For example, a product requirement Module created in ChatGPT can depend on architecture and security Modules maintained by their owners. Codex can Flash that requirement before implementing it and receive those decisions together.

As conversations and work reveal new knowledge, agents propose changes to existing Modules, so the knowledge always stays up to date. The suggested workflow asks them to show exact Before and After content and Dependencies for the owner's approval before saving. Updates become available on later Flashes, while version history preserves earlier knowledge and records changes.

Issues connect tasks to the Modules governing them, with assignees, work dependencies, comments, and evidence. Inboxes show unblocked work to its responsible person or agent; completed Issues preserve the outcome and history.

People and teams own the knowledge in their Socra Account, with Module permissions for people and groups. Review Modules, the knowledge map, and work at https://cortex.socra.com. Connect ChatGPT, Codex, or any other AI provider to that same Account with Cortex access.

Setup and agent instructions: https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md

release.description:
Ask about your product analytics, and get answers you can verify.

Fullstory MCP connects Codex and ChatGPT to your product's behavioral data. Ask how many users adopted a feature, where checkout is leaking, or whether yesterday's release broke something, and Codex and ChatGPT build the segment, computes the metric, and explains the result with a link back to Fullstory.

Analytics connectors can give you numbers. Fullstory shows you what happened. Metrics unpack into real session replay, so "conversion dropped 12%" becomes "the coupon field errors for logged-out users."

And because Fullstory autocaptures clicks, page views, errors, and frustration signals, many questions need no instrumentation at all. Ask about rage clicks on pricing or errors in checkout without shipping a single event.

What Codex and ChatGPT can do:
(1) Build and save segments and metrics.
Describe the users or behavior you care about in your own words; Codex and ChatGPT create segments or metrics in Fullstory where your whole team can reuse it.

(2) Compute on demand.
 Counts, rates, trends, and breakdowns by device, browser, geography, or user property, over any time window.

(3) Speak your product's language. 
Codex and ChatGPT discover your pages, named elements, and defined events, so questions map to your real product vocabulary instead of guessed selectors.

(4) Analyze conversion.
Read your saved funnels and measure where users drop and why.

(5) Back every number with sessions.
Retrieve the sessions and events behind any metric, including frustration signals like rage clicks and dead clicks.

(6) Read sessions at scale.
Ask Codex and ChatGPT to review dozens of sessions behind a drop-off or an alert and report the patterns, including failures that never reached your error tracker.

Teams use it to let PMs, support, and engineers self-serve answers that used to queue behind an analyst, and to settle "why did this number move?" with evidence instead of theories.

release.description:

All trail data is open (CC-BY-4.0) and read-only — the app stores no personal data. Place data comes from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; the trail route is published by the Stockholm Archipelago Trail under CC-BY-4.0.

release.description:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

You will see Kenso appear in the chat when it is really being used. If an answer arrives without it, say "check Kenso".

Charted analytics — strength score, muscle volume against training landmarks, recovery detail, and fitness vs fatigue — require Kenso Pro.

release.description: Create and publish forms and one-page websites with FormEdge from ChatGPT: forms with payments, submissions, notifications, landing pages and workspace settings.

interface.short_description: Forms and one-page websites
interface.long_description:
FormEdge is a no-code form and one-page website builder for small businesses. This app lets you use it from ChatGPT.

Describe what you need — an inquiry form, a job application, an event sign-up, a landing page for a campaign or a simple homepage — and FormEdge creates it as a draft, gives you a preview link, and publishes it on your own FormEdge URL when you say so. Published forms are protected against spam, and published pages are live on the web with no hosting to set up.

What you can do from ChatGPT:
- Forms: create forms with text, email, phone, address, date, choice and file upload fields, set required fields, add a completion message and an automatic reply email, control the acceptance period and the number of responses, turn on duplicate-submission checks and AI screening, duplicate an existing form, and publish or unpublish.
- Payments: add a payment step to a form so that respondents pay by card through Stripe right after they submit — event fees, trial lessons, booking deposits — with a fixed price per form and an optional quantity. The payment happens on the public FormEdge form, not inside ChatGPT.
- Submissions: list and read responses, download them as CSV and check attached files.
- Notifications: send new responses to email, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, LINE or a webhook.
- Landing pages and websites: start from templates for events, inquiries and business one-pagers, edit the text and images, place your form on the page, duplicate a page, and publish. Saved versions let you go back to an earlier page.
- Workspace: custom domains, the public subdomain, branding, the language and time zone used for emails, members and invitations, and storage usage.

Who it is for: shop owners, freelancers, clinics, schools, event organizers and small teams who want a form or a page online today without a web developer.

Sign in with your FormEdge account (OAuth 2.1). The permissions ChatGPT gets follow your role in the workspace; if you belong to several workspaces you choose which one to connect. You can narrow the permissions or disconnect at any time from "External app connections" in the account menu of the FormEdge dashboard, and you can also disconnect by asking ChatGPT.
capabilities: Build one-page websites and landing pages
Add a Stripe payment step to your forms

release.description:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch

release.description:
Intellistrata connects ChatGPT with the Intellistrata strata management platform, allowing authorised users to securely access and work with information relating to the properties and owners corporations they manage.

Depending on the user’s Intellistrata permissions and the tools enabled for their organisation, the plugin can help users locate property, lot, owner, financial, task, maintenance, document and other strata management information. It may also support approved operational workflows through conversational requests.

Access is restricted to authenticated Intellistrata users and is governed by the permissions configured for their organisation and account. Users can only access information and perform actions they are authorised to access within Intellistrata. Important financial, legal, property and administrative information should be reviewed and confirmed by an authorised user before it is relied upon.

release.display_name: OPEN - what is open right now
release.description:
OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.

Opening hours tell you how a place usually is. OPEN tells you what is true at this moment, because the answer comes from the business owner, who updates it from their phone. A shop that closed early today says so. A place with no fresh information reads UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN is never presented as CLOSED.

Ask in plain language - "what is open near Machane Yehuda right now?", "find a coffee shop that stays open at least another hour" - and the answer arrives with an interactive map inside the conversation. Service professionals are covered too: plumbers, electricians, handymen and locksmiths report whether they are available for work right now.

Four read-only tools: open_now, search_businesses, get_business and list_categories. No sign-in, no writes, no personal data, no advertising.

Coverage: OPEN is in pilot in Jerusalem, Israel, and the catalogue grows through in-person recruitment of business owners. A query about another city will return little or nothing. Hebrew and English.

release.description:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.

release.description:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.

release.description:
BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.

Designed for sales teams, consultants, service providers, agencies, and growing businesses, BROSH MCP enables AI to work with real business context—including leads, contacts, opportunities, projects, tasks, invoices, contracts, support tickets, and marketing activities. Users can ask questions in natural language, generate insights, automate repetitive processes, and execute CRM actions directly from their AI environment.

Key capabilities include:

Secure MCP-based access to CRM and business data
AI-powered querying, reporting, and data analysis
Lead, contact, account, and opportunity management
Project, task, and workflow automation
Marketing automation and customer engagement workflows
Document generation, e-signatures, quotes, and invoicing
Custom business objects, fields, dashboards, and reporting
Real-time interaction between AI agents and operational systems

BROSH MCP transforms AI assistants from simple chat interfaces into business operators capable of understanding your organization, retrieving information, updating records, and helping teams move faster with less manual work. Built on the open MCP standard, it provides a secure bridge between AI and the systems your business relies on every day.

  - Check results afterwards: session KPIs and recent team activity

release.description:
WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.

Connectors provide access. Catalogs and semantic layers provide definitions. The WisdomAI harness applies both at runtime by selecting the right context for each question, enforcing row- and column-level security for the person asking, optimizing execution for the underlying platform, verifying results, and repairing failed queries.

Business context strengthens continuously as WisdomAI learns from documents, query logs, catalogs, semantic layers, dbt, and BI metadata, proactively identifies where it lacked sufficient context, and routes proposed changes through expert review and versioning. Corrections become governed organizational knowledge rather than one-time fixes buried in individual conversations.

WisdomAI works across data platforms, sources, and deployment environments, including fully on-premises for regulated data that cannot leave your environment. The harness, the context, and query execution stay behind your firewall; only the answer crosses.

Every answer is grounded in governed definitions, enterprise data, and visible sources making it trustworthy enough to run your business on.

Use WisdomAI in ChatGPT to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plan in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last 4 quarters"
- Investigate an open-ended question end to end: "We missed plan in EMEA last quarter. What drove it, which segments and accounts moved most, and what should we watch going into Q4?"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?"
- See what's available to you: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"

release.description:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

release.description:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search

release.description:
Din Bostad helps users search the Swedish real estate market from inside ChatGPT. Use it for any prompt about finding, searching or browsing Swedish properties for sale: apartments (lägenheter, bostadsrätter), houses (villor, hus), townhouses (radhus), cabins (stugor), plots (tomter), or any for-sale property in Sweden.

The assistant resolves place names the user mentions to specific administrative locations (län, kommun,
area, place, street), then queries the listings index with structured filters such as price range, property
type, room count, living area, plot area, facilities (pool, balcony, garage, fireplace), energy class, viewing
windows, nearby points of interest (water, parks, schools, transit), publication recency, and sort order.
Constraints from earlier turns are carried forward, so users can refine or change direction without
restating everything.

Matching for-sale listings render on an interactive map widget with a sidebar list and a fullscreen
inspector for individual properties. Each listing links to the full advert on dinbostad.se, where the user can see all photos and viewing times, book a viewing, or contact the agent.

Example prompts: "Villor i Lund och Malmö med minst 5 rum, tomt över 800 kvadratmeter och
energiklass C eller bättre", "Radhus under 5 miljoner i Helsingborg och Lund, minst 4 rum", "Hus nära
vatten i Bohuslän med pool", "Three-bedroom villas in Malmö under 8 million SEK", "Cabins for sale in
Värmland", "Newest listings in Umeå".

release.description:
Vocaneo connects ChatGPT to the French careers and training reference data: over 1,000 job profiles (missions, skills, salaries, labour-market tension, AI exposure), RNCP diplomas and certifications, and more than 135,000 training programmes with the establishments that deliver them across France.

Ask career questions in plain language: « how do I become a nurse in Lyon? », « I am a developer, which jobs could I move to? », « which jobs are hiring without long studies? ». ChatGPT queries the reference data, cross-references jobs, entry routes, training programmes and providers, and cites the matching public vocaneo.com page for every answer.

Vocaneo is a French mission-driven company (SAS, ESUS-accredited) building career guidance tools on open data and psychometric assessment.

release.description:
Guest-Ready Score is a 12-question assessment that measures how ready a short-term rental is to welcome guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, and owners of cottages, cabins, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny homes, furnished rentals and holiday rentals.

The assessment reviews twelve core areas of the guest stay: arrival and check-in, beds and sleeping comfort, bathrooms, kitchen readiness, lighting, temperature and climate comfort, Wi-Fi, cleanliness, restocking, guest communication, safety, and local information. It takes about two minutes and provides a Guest-Ready Score showing the areas already working well and the areas where attention will most improve the stay.

Use Guest-Ready Score to check whether a property is ready to list, prepare for a first guest, audit an existing rental, benchmark against hospitality standards, or find the areas most likely to lift guest reviews.

The standards come from The Guest Before The Rest by Valerie Balderson and Greg Hoover, drawn from seventeen years of furnished rental management in Ottawa, Canada.

release.description: Go! lets you play Go against AI directly inside ChatGPT, with no separate login required. Games use the professional and international tournament standard 19×19 board by default, while 13×13 and 9×9 boards are available whenever you request a shorter match. Choose to play Black or White, select from three AI difficulty levels, and use a handicap of 2 to 9 stones when you want to balance the game. Go! handles legal move placement and captures while enforcing the prohibition on suicide, ko, and repeated positions. During a game, you can pass, resign, or undo a move. When play ends, the board is scored using Chinese area scoring. The result clearly identifies the winner and uses standard notation such as B+12.5 or W+R. A detailed breakdown shows stones, territory, komi, and totals, with territory marked directly on the board so you can understand how the result was calculated. The complete interface is presented in English. Whether you search for Go, Baduk, Weiqi, or simply want to play Go without leaving ChatGPT, Go! provides a convenient, rules-aware way to start a match at your preferred board size and difficulty.

release.description:
Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer engagement. 
 
The solution combines comprehensive Moody’s entity intelligence, including global company profiles, hierarchies, and ownership linkages, with augmented signals such as news, market activity, and risk indicators. This integrated view helps organizations gain additional visibility into total addressable markets, identify whitespace opportunities, and align sales and marketing strategies around high-value prospects. 
 
By bringing together structured company data and contextual insights into a single interface, Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP helps streamline data-to-insight workflows and supports improvements in targeting precision, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes. 
 
Data includes: 
- Global company firmographics and identifiers 
- Corporate hierarchies and ownership structures 
- Industry classifications and segmentation 
- Financial indicators and company scale metrics 
- News, market signals, and company events 
- Risk indicators and early warning signals 
- Economic data and research 

 Use Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP for: 
- GTM Planning – define and size target markets with comprehensive company coverage  
- Account Prioritization – identify and prioritize high-value prospects and customers and support more sophisticated opportunity scoring by combining company-level data with market-level indicators. 
- Territory Design – support geographic and account planning by highlighting industries, regions or countries with stronger growth prospects 
- Pipeline Acceleration – surface in-market signals and help support timely engagement based on macroeconomic trends, investment activity, hiring trends or sector-level forecasts 
- Cross-Sell & Upsell – help identify whitespace within existing customer portfolios and support AI-generated account briefs that incorporate industry outlooks, economic scenarios, and strategic talking points 
- CRM Enrichment – enrich account and lead records with company data and insights 
- Marketing Segmentation – develop data-driven audience segments using company, market, and relationship insights

interface.long_description:
Create and edit finished videos without leaving ChatGPT.

Describe what you need, like a product launch, a stylised explainer or a team update, and Synthesia Syren builds the whole video while you chat: the script, generated visuals, motion graphics, music and an AI presenter if you want one. To match your brand, include links to your logo and brand assets, or describe the look you want. If your brief leaves a choice open, Syren asks a quick question.

Your video plays right in the chat. To change it, just say so (“tighten the intro”, “make it moodier”, “swap the second scene”) and Syren updates the same video. When you’re happy, export it as an MP4 to download and share. You can also find and replay any of your earlier Syren videos.

Syren is in beta, makes videos up to 3 minutes long and uses your Synthesia credits.

Want a classic Synthesia video instead? Ask for one. Paste a script or give a prompt, pick your workspace and template, then open the draft in the Synthesia editor.

Requires a Synthesia account. New videos are private to you, and Synthesia only accesses the workspaces and videos your account already can. When it’s ready, publish it to a Share page to get a link anyone can watch.

release.description:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

release.description:
Spacebring connects ChatGPT to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.

Spacebring helps coworking space operators deliver superior member service through automated operations, built-in AI, and an admin mobile app. The platform helps operators serve customers faster, reduce admin chores, and streamline operations, while delivering a seamless branded customer experience to sign up, book, pay, and get support with ease.

This plugin lets ChatGPT query your live Spacebring data directly in conversation, so you can ask questions, get answers without switching tools or building reports manually.

Key features:
• Pull details on your network and every location you operate, including configuration and status.
•  Look up members and companies in your network, including their details and account status.
•  Access contracts and the templates behind them, useful for audits, renewals, and legal review.
•  Review active subscriptions and the membership plans tied to them.
•  Retrieve invoice records for billing checks, reconciliation, and reporting.
•  Query benefit categories, individual benefits, and member benefit applications.
•  Look up shop categories, products, and orders for on-site retail or add-on services.
•  Access member-facing guides and resources published in your network.

This plugin is read-only today: it's built for retrieving and analyzing data, not making changes to your Spacebring account. Future updates will expand coverage further and eventually support write actions (like updating records or triggering workflows) directly from ChatGPT.

Built by the Spacebring team for the Spacebring family.

release.description: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types. Ratings carry the most signal: they are sparse and deliberate, so a 9 means considerably more than a like. Reactions are not interchangeable either — "meh" means you consumed something and felt nothing, while "skipped" means you passed without engaging and carries no opinion at all. With your permission it can also record reactions and ratings, so you can keep your library current without leaving the conversation. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and a consent screen listing exactly what you are granting, and you can disconnect at any time. Results render as interactive cards showing cover art, with one-tap buttons that record a reaction or save something for later without leaving the conversation. Plot summaries and adult titles are never sent, and every card links back to app.interestnaut.com. Nothing here is locked to this conversation. Everything ChatGPT reads or writes is your own Interestnaut account, and the same library is open in the app on the web, iPhone and Android — where you can review what was saved, change or remove any reaction, add things ChatGPT never saw, build lists, and watch your taste profile update. Ratings are recorded through the assistant and feed the same taste profile. Start something here and finish it there, or the other way round; the account is the same either way, and it outlives this connection.

release.description:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.

release.description:
O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e
aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.

Consulta de ativos: fichas completas de ETFs brasileiros e globais, ações, BDRs,
FIIs, fundos CVM, debêntures, renda fixa pública e privada e índices,  custos,
patrimônio líquido, retornos históricos, alocação e composição. Screener com
filtros por classe, look-through da carteira de ETFs (inclusive ETFs de ETFs) e
lookup reverso ("quais ETFs carregam NVDA?").

Análise de carteira: seus portfólios salvos no OnePro, ou uma carteira informada
na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,
IFIX, IMA-B e S&P 500. Inclui ranking entre carteiras, consistência em janelas
móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

Motores de simulação: fronteira eficiente e carteira de máximo Sharpe;
probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

Todos os resultados vêm de um snapshot diário de dados, com a versão do dado
declarada em cada resposta, e os motores raciocinam em termos reais (R$ de hoje e dólar).
O conector é somente leitura: nenhuma operação altera dados da sua conta, e
nenhuma ordem de compra ou venda é executada. As análises são informativas e não
constituem recomendação de investimento.

release.description:
GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold this month and get the real figure. Ask what is running out and get the items below their reorder level with a suggested quantity. Ask about one IMEI and get that exact handset: in stock or sold, its cost and its price, when it arrived and when it left, and the warranty left on it. Ask what is on the repair desk and get every claim with its status, customer, device, days open and estimate. Ask whether a customer's phone is still under warranty and get the determination from the sale date — or, where no warranty period was ever recorded, that fact stated plainly instead of a guess.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: ring up a sale — a real invoice with a receipt number that takes the payment and moves stock (the assistant confirms the devices and the amount with the owner first; voiding or refunding a sale stays in the app, behind a manager PIN); open or close a branch's cash drawer against the cash counted; create a device, change a price, a rack location or a reorder level; add a product photo through a single-use upload link, or arrange and remove product photos; receive stock or one serialized unit; log an expense; add a supplier; raise a draft purchase order; record a customer's payment against what they already owe; book a device in for repair; and move a claim along to inspecting, estimate pending, approved, repairing, ready or delivered.

Only two actions can reach anyone outside the shop, and only if the shop has switched SMS on (it is off by default): a sale that names a customer can send that customer one receipt SMS, and a claim moved to ready or delivered can send the claim's customer one SMS. No tool accepts a phone number or message text from the chat.

It searches a shared reference catalog of phones, laptops and accessories, so adding a product inherits the right brand, category, specifications and official image rather than starting from a blank row.

Everything is scoped to the single shop the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data.

Rejecting or refunding a warranty claim needs a manager PIN, and there is no tool for it — that stays in the app on purpose.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

release.description:
Ad Superpowers connects ChatGPT to the advertising and analytics accounts a marketer already runs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.

Read workflows: pull campaign results across platforms and compare them, find which creatives are fatiguing, check why a campaign stopped spending, reconcile conversion numbers that differ between a platform and GA4, compare paid keywords against organic Search Console queries, and audit a Tag Manager container before a release.

Write workflows: pause or adjust a campaign that is overspending, fix a wrong landing-page URL on a live ad without losing its social proof, duplicate a winning ad into a new variant, upload creative assets, and build a new ad. Write tools that publish are gated behind an explicit plan-and-confirm step, so the user reads what will change and confirms it before anything is created.

Every account is connected by the customer through OAuth in the Ad Superpowers dashboard. The app only reaches accounts that customer has connected, and tools for platforms they have not connected are not offered at all.

release.description:
Decionis is an execution-authority layer for AI agents. Before an agent takes a consequential action, Decionis evaluates the proposed action against organization policy and determines whether it may proceed, must be held, or requires additional authority.

When human approval is required, Decionis can request verified approval through Presence and re-evaluate the action using the resulting signed evidence. Every evaluation produces a verifiable Decision Dossier and cryptographic evidence for audit and accountability.

Use Decionis to govern agent-initiated payments, refunds, commerce operations, enterprise workflows, infrastructure changes, and other high-impact actions.

Decionis authorizes execution; it does not perform the downstream action. Payments, transfers, trades, orders, and system changes remain the responsibility of the connected executor.

release.description:
pickthehotel is an answer engine for hotels. Instead of a wall of results, ask for the one hotel that fits your intent in a city and get a single confident pick, a few alternatives, and a booking link.

Choose an intent:
• iconic - the standout in town
• value - great, and fairly priced for what you get
• budget - cheap, clean, and genuinely central
• family - one room that actually sleeps two adults and the children

Every hotel is judged the same way - value (punching above its price), location (closeness to what you actually came for), and reviews (weighted by confidence, not just averaged) - with no paid placement. You can anchor "central" to a landmark ("near the Louvre") or to your live location, and you can ask for a curated list of long-established hotels around the world.

Live in Zürich, Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Bangkok, Dubai, Singapore, Istanbul, and Hong Kong, with more rolling out. Prices are indicative and confirmed at the booking site; booking links are affiliate and disclosed.

release.description:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

release.description:
Sphere is a calorie and nutrition tracker for iOS. Connect it here and you can log what you ate, check your calories and macros, and search a verified food database without leaving the conversation.

Describe a meal in plain language and it becomes real entries with real nutrition data. Ask how many calories you have left, what your protein looks like today, or what you ate last Tuesday. Change a portion, move an item to a different meal, or delete something you logged by mistake.

If you are new to Sphere, it will walk you through a few questions and calculate your calorie and macro targets using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, the same one the iOS app uses.

Everything writes to the same account as the Sphere iOS app, so a meal logged here appears on your phone and your streak keeps counting. Your food log persists across conversations.

Sphere is free to use for logging. A paid subscription is available in the iOS app for premium features and is not required to use this connector.

release.description:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.

release.description: Espresso dialing: log a shot, say how it tasted, get one change in your grinder's own clicks.

interface.short_description: Track and dial in espresso
interface.long_description:
ShotPulled is a brewing log and dial-in assistant for home espresso. You record each shot you pull, and it suggests one change to try on the next one.

Register your coffee, grinder, espresso machine, and scale. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled reads the shot together with the coffee’s age and your grinder setting, then gives the likely causes in ranked order and one adjustment to try next, with the reasoning behind it.

It tracks your coffee. Each logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining, an estimate of the shots left at the dose you use, and where the bag is in its rest and peak window. Coffees and bags are separate records: register a coffee once, then each bag you buy of it, and your recipes and notes stay with the coffee.

It tracks equipment maintenance. ShotPulled holds maintenance information researched for 190 grinder and espresso machine models, drawn from the manufacturers’ manuals where available, for tasks such as descaling, backflushing, burr cleaning and water filters. Ask what is due, log a task when you do it, set your own intervals, and read step-by-step guides where one exists for your model. A task the maker advises against is not listed as due.

When a recipe works, lock it and look it up later. ShotPulled handles grinder settings given as clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, and includes specifications for 66 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 17 scales.

What you record here is saved to your ShotPulled account, which the ShotPulled web dashboard and iPhone app also use.

Diagnoses from taste, recommends one change at a time, and records both so the advice stays consistent. Requires the ShotPulled connector.

release.description:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

release.description:
Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.

Sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT can search and hydrate your org context so you do not repeat who you are, what the project is, or what you already decided.

What you can do:
• Look up a specific fact about your company, a past decision, or a current task.
• Ask a synthesis question across decisions, notes, and related records.
• Create or update a Bitsweave record from the conversation when you want the result stored.

Connect GitHub, email, and other tools through Bitsweave brokers when you enable them. Claude calls Bitsweave. Bitsweave uses the permissions you granted. The agent does not hold the upstream credentials.

Sign-in is required. The connector URL is https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp.

Setup: add Bitsweave, complete the OAuth sign-in, then ask ChatGPT to search your context or create a record. Public docs: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents

release.description:
Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history. Trace how memories connect and follow full causal chains from decision to consequence.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.

release.description:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.

release.description:
The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.

What Chatgpt can do with it:
• Create - build a project from a prompt, a screen recording, a slide deck, or a document
• Compose - place text, callouts, shapes, images, motion graphics and stock footage across a timeline
• Narrate - write scripts and generate voiceover from a library of 350+ voices, synced to on-screen action
• Edit - make targeted changes to any clip, element or word without rebuilding the project
• Preview - render any frame as an image to check the result mid-conversation
• Publish - export the finished video, and build the written article from the same source
• Reuse - save any project as a template so the next video inherits its structure and branding

Because it runs through your assistant, it composes with whatever else you have connected pull a script from meeting notes, a feature list from a project tracker, or account detail from a CRM, and build the video from material that already exists.

Typical uses: product and feature walkthroughs, customer education libraries, internal training built from existing decks, launch and changelog videos, help-centre articles paired with video.

Everything the connector creates opens in the Clueso editor and stays fully editable.

release.description: Understand proteins with ESM: explore mutation landscapes, interpret learned features, predict and view structures, and discover relatives.

interface.short_description: Understand proteins with ESM
interface.long_description: Biohub ESM helps you understand proteins from a name, sequence, or file: explore mutation landscapes, interpret what ESMC sees, predict and view all-atom structures, and discover related proteins. It chooses the right ESM workflow, preserves confidence and provenance, and presents results automatically. It also supports MSA-guided and modified-complex workflows, and private or large-scale compute routing. Supported protein sequences use the Biohub MCP viewer. Complexes and exact prediction files use a separate molecular viewer when available, with an agent-generated static rendering as a last resort where local rendering tools are available. Managed inference requires a Biohub API key and may incur usage charges. Predictions support research hypotheses, not experimental conclusions.

Cargo is GTM infrastructure for AI assistants. Connect this MCP server and ChatGPT can operate your Cargo workspace: discover and run actions across 130+ integrations, execute tools and agents, query CRM and revenue models, and read the playbooks and ICP context your team already wrote.

release.description:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and ChatGPT will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.

release.description:
Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

What you can do

- Enrich rows you already have. Paste a list or point at a saved enrichment and get the new columns back. Up to 10,000 rows per run.
- Build a list from a description. "Every lawfirm in Indiana", "every YC W24 company in healthcare", "competitors of Stripe". Riveter generates the rows, and can enrich them in the same run.
- Scrape a page. Clean text or markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Search the web. One-shot search results, or a research agent that answers a question with a structured, schema-shaped response.
- Extract records from a site. Define the fields you want and pull them from listings, directories, or catalogs as JSON.
- Monitor for changes. Run a saved enrichment daily, weekly, or monthly and get alerts or webhooks when values change.

How it works

Long runs are asynchronous. Claude starts the run, checks status, and fetches results when they are ready. Every run has an id you can come back to later, and results stay available in your Riveter account.

release.description:
Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you. Where a visa needs an in-person appointment, it also shows the visa centres with published availability and the dates they were last showing as open, so you can see roughly how soon is realistic before you commit to anything.

Visa rules, fees and processing times change constantly and differ by the passport you hold, so remembered or published figures are routinely out of date for the person asking. Every answer here comes from the catalogue that prices Musafir.com's own bookings, and each one names the market it applies to.

Ask about a destination, compare several, or check what paperwork you need and how each document is handed over, whether that is uploaded online, taken to a visa centre or couriered. When you are ready to apply, you are handed the matching page on Musafir.com with your details already carried across, and Musafir.com books the appointment for you once your application is in.

Musafir.com currently serves travellers applying from the UAE. If you live somewhere Musafir.com does not yet cover, the connector says so rather than quoting you a price for a process you cannot use.

This connector is read-only. It cannot access your account, view or change an order, hold or book an appointment, or take a payment. Appointment availability is what the visa centre was last publishing, not a reservation and not a guarantee. It tells you what Musafir.com can process, which is not the same as what a government requires, and it never predicts whether a visa will be approved.

skills.name: sql-optimization
skills.description:
**Required reading before writing or running any SQL.** Patterns for Snowflake
query performance and chain-specific pitfalls.

Covers: default time ranges, partition-pruning rules, CTE filtering, `QUALIFY`
for dedup, `UNION ALL` over `UNION`, `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` for exploration,
pre-aggregated `*.metrics.*` tables vs raw aggregation, EVM address lowercasing
(and when not to), per-chain vs `crosschain.*` tables, verifying guessed
categorical filter values with `SELECT DISTINCT`, and Solana voting/non-voting
optimized views.

Call `get_skill(name="sql-optimization")` before writing SQL —
especially for large tables, long time ranges, or crosschain queries.

release.description:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.
