release.description:
Health memory helps you save and manage personal health notes directly through ChatGPT. You can create topics, organize information, and keep track of things like symptoms, medications, and questions for your doctor—all in one place.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to save, and it will securely store it in your health memory account on Triangle Health. You can also ask to retrieve or update your notes whenever you need them.

Health memory is designed with privacy and control in mind. You decide what information is shared, and all actions are performed only with your explicit permission.

This app is intended solely for personal note-taking and organization. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations.

release.description:
Booking Wolf helps travellers find and book hotels, tours and activities. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, your dates and how many people, and you get real options with prices, photos, ratings and what's included.

For a hotel you see the rate for your dates, and alongside it the prices publicly listed for the same room on other travel sites, so you can see what the room costs before deciding. First-time guests also see the credit their booking earns towards a future stay.

For tours and activities you see the price, what the day involves, and whether the tour actually runs on the date you asked about.

When you pick something, the booking link takes you to bookingwolf.com to finish on our secure checkout.

release.description:
Rosey is an independent verification layer for documents, decks, or other content that has been drafted, edited, or summarized by AI — financial reports, scientific writing, technical documentation, and any other content where factual precision matters.

Rosey checks Accuracy: every claim, number, and citation in a document is verified against its source materials, with findings delivered as traceable evidence rather than a bare confidence score. It also applies optional expert personas — a CFO reviewing for financial coherence, an adversarial analyst stress-testing claims, an operating partner checking operational plausibility — to surface weaknesses before an output reaches its intended audience.

Why it matters for agentic workflows: an agent that generates important outputs for users or agents downstream cannot reliably verify its own output. Verification benefits from a separate system checking claims against ground truth, the same way external audit is separate from the finance team it reviews. Rosey is built for end-users, agents, and agentic pipelines so that errors can be caught before they propagate – either to another agent or to someone who will make decisions based on the output. 

Findings are returned with in-line judgement on each factual claim, so work can move from draft → verified → finalized quickly.

Typical triggers: a document contains numerical claims, financial figures, or factual assertions; a document was generated or substantially edited by an AI model; a document is headed to a client, regulator, or decision-maker and needs a pre-send accuracy check; an agent is creating important output that will be consumed as inputs by another agent in a workflow and requires reliability.

Not for: scenarios where there is not an underlying source-of-truth that can be provided directly to Rosey.

release.description:
Die Immobilienprofis is a modern real estate company specialising in the regions of Hof an der Saale, Bad Steben, Plauen, Dresden, and Dénia (Spain). The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties across these diverse markets.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surroundings at a glance, creating a faster and more transparent property search experience.

With extensive regional market expertise and personalised service, Die Immobilienprofis combines local knowledge with modern digital solutions to support buyers, sellers, and investors in Germany and Spain.

Key Benefits
Interactive map-based property search
Faster orientation across Hof an der Saale, Bad Steben, Plauen, Dresden, and Dénia
Better understanding of neighborhoods, infrastructure, and local amenities
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
Easy comparison of different cities and regions
More efficient property search through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for an apartment in Dresden, a family home in the Hof region, a retirement property in Bad Steben, or a holiday home in Dénia on Spain's Mediterranean coast, Die Immobilienprofis offers a modern and transparent way to explore exceptional real estate opportunities.

interface.long_description: Create App Store screenshots, Google Play screenshots and banners, and portfolio mockups from your own images. Choose phone, tablet, desktop, multi-device, or linked panorama templates, including fixed isometric device poses. Export opaque RGB PNGs, a preview, files organized by language, and an editable .henscreenshots project for the web studio. Includes iPad 11-inch and additional Apple device sizes with matching frames, Google Play large-screen presets up to 7680 px, and consistent editing capacity of 50 slides. Store export limits still apply. Imported projects preserve typography and custom background images. To reuse a personal template, download a .henscreenshots project from the studio; the plugin does not access your browser library or import .hentemplate files directly. Requires Node.js 22.12+ and one-time dependency setup with internet access. Rendering then runs locally offline. Hen does not upload captures or require an API key. Your agent provider’s data policies still apply. Supports PNG, JPEG, and still WebP inputs. Review captions, crops, and store requirements before publishing.

Gloria Palace Assistant helps guests explore the chain, find hotel information, and manage reservations through chat.
Users can discover the properties in the chain and ask about rooms, amenities, services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can check availability, compare room and board options, and list optional extras.
Guests can create a reservation after explicitly confirming their selection and providing the required guest details. Existing reservations can be retrieved using the required booking credentials, and date changes or cancellations require explicit confirmation.
Example questions:
“Which Gloria Palace properties can I choose from?”
“What room types does Gloria Palace San Agustín offer?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me my booking details.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”

Turn ChatGPT into a secure, natively multilingual workplace with LILT—enterprise infrastructure for verified translation, custom AI models, and expert human review.

LILT connects your chat interface directly to your brand’s language assets, automated quality gates, and enterprise translation workflows via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Generate verified, policy-compliant content, enforce corporate glossaries, and route high-stakes assets to professional human reviewers without ever leaving ChatGPT.

Key Capabilities:
- Real-Time AI Verification: Automatically validate translations for accuracy, terminology, and brand voice using built-in AI QA agents.
- Calibrated Quality Gates: Run instant AI validation for daily communications, or trigger expert human review for mission-critical content.
- Custom Enterprise Models: Translate using domain-adapted LLMs tuned specifically to your company terminology and style guides.
- Live Terminology Sync: Access corporate glossaries and translation memories directly inside your chat thread.
- In-Chat Project Management: Launch translation jobs, track pipeline progress, and pull completed assets straight into your conversation.
- Enterprise Security & Governance: Enforce data isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), and full audit trails.

release.description:
Runs the two checks most first-time towers skip: the trailer's loaded weight against the tow rating (with an 85% comfort line) and the payload budget, meaning tongue or pin weight plus passengers, cargo and the hitch against the door-sticker payload. Looks up published tow and payload ranges for about 55 common US trucks, SUVs, vans and crossovers with the configuration notes that explain the range, estimates loaded trailer weights by type and length, and lists the required gear (hitch class, ball size, brake controller, weight distribution, mirrors). It always tells you which number failed.

Typical requests: can my truck tow this trailer, how much can a Ford F-150 tow, towing capacity of a Toyota Highlander, how much does a 25 foot travel trailer weigh, do I need a weight distribution hitch, what payload do I need for a 7000 lb trailer, tongue weight calculator, fifth wheel pin weight, half ton vs three quarter ton for a camper, do I need a brake controller, towing mirrors, best SUV to pull a camper.

Every result is shown as a card with the verdict, the numbers that passed or failed, the gear list and links to the matching hitch, brake controller, scale and mirrors (physical goods) and to camptow.com. No account needed.

release.description:
Suitoly is a simple income and expense tracker with cloud sync. Connect it to ChatGPT to search, record, and summarize your finances in natural language.

What you can do:
- List the ledgers you have allowed ChatGPT to use
- Search entries by keyword, date range, amount, or category
- Record a new income or expense entry
- Generate a report with monthly and category breakdowns

You stay in control of your data. When you connect, Suitoly asks you to sign in and choose exactly which ledgers ChatGPT can access, and whether it can only read or also add entries. You can review and disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Settings > API Tokens in the Suitoly app, and access stops immediately.

Suitoly also supports multiple ledgers for different purposes, sharing with family or friends, and receipt scanning.

A Suitoly account is required. Get the app:
- iPhone / iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790985695
- Web: https://app.suitoly.com

release.description:
Automo helps you get work done across your business from one workspace. Create content, designs, videos and documents; research information across your files, brand assets and knowledge base; manage customers, projects and support; and work through mail, meetings, calendar and tasks.

Instead of switching between tools, you can tell Automo what you want to accomplish and it carries the work out in your workspace. Everything it makes is a real Automo project. Open it in the editor, hand it to a colleague, keep going.

Your workspace admin decides what it can reach. Permissions are set per workspace and apply to everyone already connected, so a permission can be withdrawn without anyone reconnecting. Anything that touches personal mail, customer records or confidential folders starts switched off, and every tool call is logged.

release.description: A gated, lecturer-in-the-loop workflow with guided, course-adaptive evidence-grounded redesign.

interface.short_description: Gated evidence-led redesign
interface.long_description:
◆ LECTURER / TEACHER CONTROL • You retain every consequential decision. The Course Redesign Orchestrator is the sole lecturer-facing interface.
◆ SPECIALIST TEAM (10) • Course Mapper and Learning-Outcomes Auditor; Active-Learning Researcher; AI Integration and AI-Competence Researcher; Student Experience, Accessibility and Workload Proxy Critic; Assessment and Constructive-Alignment Designer. • Source Verification and Citation Auditor; Evidence and Feasibility Red Team; Learning Designer; Learning Material Designer; Artefact Accessibility and Visual QA Auditor. The student-experience role is a design-review proxy and never authorises identifiable student data.
◆ GATED WORKFLOW • Gate 0A: verify ownership/processing authority, sensitivity, student data, protected assessment and environment before any source path or content. • Gate 0: confirm sources, rights, tools and egress. Gate 1: confirm the course brief and a fresh run. • HITL 1: approve focus after preliminary mapping. Research, source verification, cross-specialist synthesis, assessment integration and red-team review lead to HITL 2. • Gate 3: approve the integrated blueprint and file plan. Material production creates only approved working copies, followed by evidence, accessibility, visual, alignment and assessment-security QA. • Verify production handoff before HITL 3; accept, revise or reject each artefact. • Request or decline final system review; the accepted run becomes complete and dormant until a later manual or separately approved scheduled trigger creates a fresh run.
◆ DECISION DIALOGUE • One unresolved question at a time. • Use a card only if the live host can show the complete option set plus custom answer. Verified current Codex in Plan mode: 2–3 explicit choices plus automatic Other. • If capacity is unknown, unavailable or exceeded, use ordinary chat with every valid numbered option plus Other, then wait. Never prune, hide or combine valid options to fit a card. • Long sets may use dependency-based chunks with every option visible; the lecturer may split, merge, reorder or rename them. • Preserve custom answers verbatim, show editable recaps, never preselect recommendations and fail closed on uncertainty.
◆ BOUNDARY • The plugin does not register schedules, start runs, publish content, add connectors or change permissions.

release.description:
JobMojito runs AI-led conversational sessions in three shapes: scored interviews for hiring, simulated personas that assess how someone handles a real situation, and self-serve coaching for practice. Connect this server and your assistant can set all three up, invite people, and read back transcripts, scores and reports — as you, with your own permissions.

Interviews. Generate one from a job description, or supply your own questions. Pick the modality: a voice-only interviewer, a live video avatar, or a pre-recorded one. Register candidates and each gets a personal link; when they finish you get the transcript, structured analysis and a shareable HTML or PDF report.

Simulated personas. Instead of a question list, the avatar plays a defined character in free-form conversation — a sceptical buyer, an angry customer, a difficult stakeholder — and the person is scored on how they handle it. These use the same invitation and result flow as an interview, so they land in the recruiter's result list alongside everything else.

Coaching. The same persona engine pointed at practice rather than assessment: learners start sessions themselves from a browsable catalogue, spend their own coaching credits, and their results stay private from recruiters. Organise the catalogue with directories, tag filters and your own Markdown pages.

Across all three: upload documents to a knowledge base the AI draws on, check credits and analytics, and search JobMojito's documentation without leaving the conversation. If you manage several accounts — an agency, a reseller, sub-brands — an interactive picker chooses which merchant you are acting as.

Everything JobMojito produces is decision support: input for a qualified human reviewer, never a hiring decision on its own, and candidates are told AI is part of the process. Read-only lookups run freely; anything that creates a session, mints a link or generates a report asks you first.

Sign in with your JobMojito account — no API key to manage.

Built for recruiters, talent teams, sales and service trainers, coaching providers, and the platforms that serve them. The same capabilities are available over the JobMojito HTTP API if you would rather integrate directly — this connector is for when an assistant should drive the work interactively.

release.description: Learn durable Codex preferences from session feedback and retain them as scoped, reviewable AGENTS.md improvements.

interface.short_description: Learn and retain preferences
interface.long_description: When using Codex, we often see it miss things that feel obvious to us: it may run far more tests than necessary or make assumptions about a project that simply do not make sense. Correcting it helps in the current conversation, but that lesson is often forgotten as soon as a new conversation begins. A good harness should keep learning a user's taste, preferences, and working style from these interactions. This Skill does exactly that: it analyzes Codex conversation history, extracts durable preferences, and writes them to project-level or global AGENTS.md files, giving Codex a form of continuous learning. You can think of it as a stripped-down version of Hermes. The project intentionally limits itself to preferences suitable for AGENTS.md rather than trying to generate Skills. We do not want to lock an agent into particular ways of working, since such constraints can become liabilities as models improve. User preferences, by contrast, are not learned simply by upgrading the model and are therefore worth preserving.
interface.default_prompt: Review my conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
default_prompts: Review my conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
Review new conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
Schedule a daily 10:00 AM task to mine new conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.

Research-based decision support only. It does not replace an independent mechanical inspection or official ownership, title, lien, recall, insurance, and registration checks.

release.description: Open-source full-SDLC framework with graph-native project knowledge for agentic development.

interface.short_description: Develop without IT-specialists
interface.long_description:
NaCl (reading as Natrium Chloride) is an open-source full-SDLC framework, and its core innovation is how it solves the hardest problem in agentic development: storing and retrieving project knowledge. Instead of markdown specs that agents must re-read every session, all project knowledge — requirements, architecture decisions, entities, rules, and their relationships — lives in a Neo4j knowledge graph as first-class queryable objects. The measured effect: planning a single use case takes ~550 tokens (one targeted Cypher query) instead of ~150,000 tokens (reading a ~70-file markdown spec, because the agent doesn't know in advance where the relevant facts live) — a 99.6% reduction in context per use case, repeated in every planning session.

Around the graph we've built the full tooling for agentic development and testing: 57 skills covering BA → SA → TDD development → review → QA → release, quality gates before production, and an autonomous goal orchestrator (/nacl-goal). The framework answers "how is this built and why" for any part of the system, regardless of project scale or iteration count. Benchmarked on a real production project (EV charging station management): a classical team was estimated at 5,831 person-hours; running fully on NaCl the same scope takes 1,480 person-hours — 4x fewer person-hours and 60% lower cost.

Famewall is a testimonial platform with which users collect written, video and audio testimonials from their customers, then display the approved ones on their website. 

This plugin connects ChatGPT to the testimonials you have already collected.

The value is having them where you are already writing. 

If you are drafting a landing page, a case study, or a sales email, ask for the quotes that mention pricing, or onboarding, or whichever objection you are answering. Real sentences from real customers, with names and job titles attached, instead of a placeholder you will fill in later.

release.description:
Voyscout publishes historical flight and package price observations for 47 destinations. Its five read-only tools let users browse destinations and measured spans, retrieve a destination's history (with resort aliases identified), compare latest measurements with their own histories, rank observed rails against their historical data, and compare 2–8 destinations side by side in the order requested.

These are observations, not live quotes or buy recommendations. Voyscout does not book trips or provide booking links. Prices use CZK, and the published dataset is reusable under CC BY 4.0 with attribution. Measured spans, price coverage and freshness details are given where each tool provides them; flight origins are reported as clusters that may not cover every published price. No account, authentication or API key is required.

release.description: AstraVerify checks whether a domain is trustworthy in the two places that matter today: the inbox and the AI answer. Ask about any domain and it returns two scores out of 100. Email Security covers MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, including whether DMARC is actually enforced, and every finding comes with the exact TXT record to paste. Discoverability covers what search engines and AI crawlers can actually get from the site: robots.txt rules for Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, whether the CDN blocks them at the edge, the sitemap, www/apex redirects, canonical tags, titles and descriptions, Organization and WebSite structured data, llms.txt, and whether the opening paragraphs define the brand. A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.

A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.

release.description:
Hedgr connects your accounting data to treasury-grade FX risk analysis. Ask ChatGPT about your own book and get answers from your authenticated Hedgr workspace: current FX exposure by currency, entity and due date, cash balances, recorded hedges and hedge cover, policy limits, market regimes, rate-shock scenarios, cashflow timing and forecasts, overdue drivers and data-quality checks.

- What is my largest FX exposure right now?
- What would a 3% GBP move do to my open invoices?

Works with Xero, QuickBooks Online, Sage, Google Sheets and CSV workspaces. Every tool is read-only. Hedgr does not execute trades, move money or give investment advice through this plugin; figures are indicative and decisions stay with you and your bank or FX broker.

release.description: Create and validate safety-gated operational runbooks.

interface.short_description: Create and resume runbooks
interface.long_description:
Create, review, dry-run, execute, resume, and audit operational procedures for releases, incidents, migrations, QA, beta launches, and recurring work.

Make the decision points explicit: an observable entry signal and verification check, a rollback or containment trigger, and the person or role responsible for the final go/no-go. Each procedure includes preservation requirements, atomic steps, expected results, verification, failure handling, and approval boundaries.

Version 0.4.0 adds separate draft and ready structural checks and a durable execution record. Preserve completed steps, consumed authorizations, uncertain outcomes, and the next authorized action across sessions. Reconcile uncertain external actions before retrying them, and bind evidence to the exact artifact, environment, observation time, and claim.

Structural validation does not grant authorization, enforce budgets, or prove live readiness. The plugin works with the host's available tools and permissions; it has no publisher-hosted service, MCP server, or publisher-side analytics.

release.description:
Seal Copilot turns your Sealmetrics data into decisions: a verdict first, the evidence with numbers, one action, and a date to check it.

It diagnoses drops down to the campaign that caused them, finds revenue left on the table, audits catalog friction per product, watches the cart during the day against a learned baseline, and reviews your tracking setup. Fourteen procedures over one methodology, with playbooks for ecommerce, hotels and SaaS that it picks from your own tracking.

Every figure comes from a tool result in the same session: it never invents a number, and it refuses to conclude when the sample is too small. Requires a Sealmetrics account.

release.description:
Kratons is a boutique destination management company and travel agency based in Madrid that designs and operates tailor-made private trips in Spain, Portugal and Morocco: hotels, private guides, drivers and transfers, rail and flight tickets, restaurants and experiences, with full itinerary design and on-the-ground operation.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can:
- Explain who Kratons is, where it operates, which languages it works in and how it prices trips (one package price per trip, prepared by a human advisor; no public price list).
- List the destinations where Kratons currently offers tours and tickets, and search those experiences by country, city or keyword.
- Browse published sample itineraries (destination, duration, day-by-day outline) to start planning from.
- Submit a structured proposal request on behalf of a traveller or a travel agent (destinations, dates, travellers, budget, interests) and return a reference.
- Check the status of a submitted proposal request by its reference.

Nothing is booked or paid inside ChatGPT. A proposal request goes to a human advisor at Kratons, who replies by e-mail within two business days. Prices and suppliers are never shown by the plugin.

release.description:
Check any UK-registered car, van or motorcycle's MOT using official DVSA test records. Give it a registration and you get whether the vehicle has a valid MOT and when it expires, when a newer vehicle's first MOT is due, and the result, mileage, advisories and defects from its latest test — plus the full MOT history going back through every recorded test.

The history check flags whether recorded mileage ever went down between tests, a common sign of clocking or a recording error, which is worth knowing before buying a used car. Advisories and failures come back in plain language rather than DVSA shorthand.

Data comes from the DVSA MOT History API, the official UK government record of MOT tests, with tax and MOT status from the DVLA. Every answer links to the vehicle's full record on motcheck.io.

No account or sign-in is needed. MOT records contain no personal information about a vehicle's keeper. UK-registered vehicles only (Great Britain and Northern Ireland).

release.description: Deley conecta a ChatGPT con las fuentes legales oficiales del Ecuador. Consulta el texto vigente de códigos y leyes artículo por artículo (con su estado de vigencia), busca jurisprudencia de la Corte Nacional y la Corte Constitucional, y explora los más de 6 millones de juicios provinciales (eSATJE) con filtros por materia, provincia, judicatura, fechas o empresa. Genera un resumen estructurado de cualquier proceso a partir de su número —estado, hitos y próximos pasos—, obtiene el texto íntegro de resoluciones y actos del Registro Oficial, y revisa las novedades normativas publicadas. release.description: Find which credit card in your wallet earns the most at a specific store.

interface.short_description: Which cards should I use here?
interface.long_description: Name a store and get the card in your wallet that nets the most on that purchase. Accounts for how the merchant actually codes (Target is a discount store, not a supermarket), spending caps you have partly used, categories you have not activated, what your points are really worth, and foreign transaction or fuel surcharge fees. release.description: Audit whether a website can be found and cited by AI answer engines, and return a ranked list of fixes.

interface.short_description: Check if AI search cites you
interface.long_description: Classic SEO asks whether you rank. AI answer engines do not rank - they retrieve a few sources and synthesize one answer, so a site can sit at the top of page one and still never be quoted. This plugin audits the second thing. It runs a citation baseline across buyer-intent prompts, checks whether the AI crawlers that control citations can actually reach your pages, reviews whether your content is written in a form that survives retrieval, and returns a fix list ranked by impact over effort. It also ships a fast robots.txt check for the crawlers that matter, because the single most common cause of total absence from AI answers is an accidental block - and the agent most teams block is not the one that controls citations. A single run is a snapshot; the skill also explains what it takes to turn one audit into a repeatable measurement you can re-run month over month.
interface.default_prompt: Audit whether example.com gets cited by ChatGPT Search and Perplexity.
default_prompts: Audit whether example.com gets cited by ChatGPT Search and Perplexity.
Check whether our robots.txt is blocking AI search crawlers.

crosswalk gives you an email address, username@crosswalk.to, that your AI reads. Newsletters and other mail sent there land as posts ChatGPT can catch you up on, search, and summarize. You also get private notes, a calendar, and crosswalks: groups where members' agents read and write short posts, each approved by its author before it goes out.

What it can do:
- Catch you up on everything new in your inbox and crosswalks
- Search and summarize your mail and posts
- Show what's on today and this week across every crosswalk you're in, including invites and bookings that arrive by email
- Save notes and calendar entries, after you approve the exact text
- Start a private crosswalk with friends, invite them, and post to it
- Find newsletters in a directory of hundreds and return their signup pages
- Unsubscribe from senders, and manage sections of your inbox

Limits: crosswalk only reads what is sent to your crosswalk address or posted in your crosswalks. It never reads your other email accounts, files, or chat history. Posting to public crosswalks is invite-only. Sign in with your email.
interface.default_prompt: Check my crosswalk inbox.
default_prompts: Check my crosswalk inbox.
What's on my calendar this week?
Save a note to crosswalk.

release.description: Offline, inert context migration across supported coding agents

interface.short_description: Resume past agent sessions
interface.long_description: Portable Resume migrates bounded context from your previous local coding-agent sessions into a fresh session. One resume skill per supported source (17 sources: Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Cline, Codex CLI, Crush, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, goose, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi CLI / Kimi Code CLI, OpenClaw, OpenCode, OpenHands, Pi agent, Qwen Code) reads that agent's own on-disk session store, selects the newest session recorded for the current working directory where the source records one (a session without a recorded directory may remain eligible, depending on the adapter, and OpenHands has no directory filter), and prints an inert, best-effort redacted markdown handoff that the destination agent reads as data and summarizes; during a skill invocation the host and its model provider receive that output directly. Everything runs locally with Python's standard library: the bundled reader never contacts the network, never invokes the source agent's CLI, never modifies the source store, and ships no MCP server, credentials, scheduler or background service. Recovered text is marked untrusted and stale, and redaction is best-effort rather than complete data-loss prevention. This is offline context migration, not live session restore.

interface.short_description: Query robot data in English
interface.long_description: Bagel lets you ask questions about robotics, drone, and IoT data (ROS 1/2 bags, MCAP, PX4/ArduPilot/Betaflight logs, CAN/MF4, live MQTT) in plain English. Every answer is computed by DuckDB SQL over the actual messages and the query is shown for audit. Bagel also has an intelligent edge data reduction pipeline: describe an event once, preview what would be kept, then run it on the robot. The plugin adds four skills that teach the agent the server's own workflows: triage, pipeline authoring, live sinks, and export to Rerun / Lichtblick / PlotJuggler / LeRobot. Bagel runs in Docker on your machine, so your data never leaves it: start the container, then connect Codex once with `codex mcp add bagel --url http://localhost:8000/mcp`.

release.description:
Boomerang finds the warmest introduction path to any buyer at any company, using the relationships your team already has.

Most sales outreach is cold because the network that could open the door is invisible: employees and executives, investors and board members, customer champions, and partners. Boomerang maps those relationships into a scored graph, then shows who on your side actually knows someone at the account you care about, ranks the paths by relationship strength, drafts the introduction request, and tracks it through to a meeting.

In ChatGPT you can ask things like "Who do we know at Snowflake?", "Find the strongest path to the CFO at Acme and tell me who should make the intro", "Which of our champions changed jobs this quarter?", "Show me the buying committee at Acme", or "What is my intro-to-meeting conversion this quarter?"

Boomerang connects to your CRM (Salesforce and HubSpot) and to calendar and email signals, so coverage is calculated against the accounts your team already works. A Boomerang account is required. You sign in with your existing Boomerang credentials, and every request is scoped to the workspace and permissions of the signed-in user.

release.description:
Check data against the standards, canonical models and policies it claims to conform to, and get back a graded, machine-readable result that says what was checked, what was not, and why.

dVeracity is a verification engine for regulated data. An agent can read a canonical data model at design time (entities, sectors, semantic codes and policy guardrails), validate a payload against a named standard before submitting it, look up approved regulatory compliance policies with their rules and provenance, and query verified datasets in natural language. Every result states its model version and the checks it ran, so it can be handed to a reviewer rather than pasted into a chat.

The first standard onboarded is Open Footprint (The Open Group), with O-DEF semantic codes, PACT product-footprint validation and verified emissions and methane datasets. The engine is domain-neutral; further standards are onboarded through the same path.

Eighteen tools, all read-only. Model, sector, semantic-code and standards-catalogue tools are free of charge. Natural-language queries and validation are metered per call in credits, with machine-readable HTTP 402 payment semantics: when an account runs out, the tool tells the agent to ask its human operator to top up, and never retries. Compliance-policy tools are available on paid plans.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; a human approves access on dVeracity's consent screen. Optional GLEIF-rooted vLEI verified-agent identity is supported for organisations that need attributable agents.

Built for compliance, ESG and reporting teams, standards implementers, and anyone whose data has to be checked before it is trusted.

release.description: Run several coding agents side by side on one repository. Each participant works in its own Git worktree, claims numbered issues before editing, announces advisory file reservations to the others, and hands work over explicitly with a summary and evidence instead of overwriting a peer.

interface.short_description: Coordinate agents on one repo
interface.long_description: Agent Parley lets several coding agents work on one repository at the same time without overwriting each other. Each participant runs in its own Git worktree. Before editing, a participant claims a numbered issue, and the claim is visible to every other participant. File reservations are announced over MCP and are advisory: peers see a conflict and stop, but nothing on disk is locked. Work moves between participants through an explicit offer and accept, carrying a summary of the commit, the checks that ran, and what remains. Outcomes are reported as agent claims with evidence, never as independent verification. The skill reads coordination state through the agent-parley command line tool, which must be installed separately.
interface.default_prompt: Codex and I are both free here. Split the open v2.1 issues, claim my half, and tell Codex which ones are its to start.
default_prompts: Codex and I are both free here. Split the open v2.1 issues, claim my half, and tell Codex which ones are its to start.
Codex stalled on issue 42 and my lane is free. Take the handoff with its commit and checks, then finish the work here.
Codex reports issue 42 ready. Check its commit and evidence from my lane, then land it or hand it back with what to fix.

release.description: Plugin du Continuum : maillage ouvert et spécialisé pour méthode, preuve, recherche, production, sécurité, artefacts, orchestration, fiabilité, Affaire et capacités Noyau/Android lorsqu’elles sont réellement disponibles.

interface.short_description: Le maillage complet
interface.long_description: Continuum est le composant côté ChatGPT du Continuum d’Axel et Azer. Une invocation @Continuum au début d’un tchat active le cadre pour ce tchat. Le Protocole canonique est lu intégralement une fois à l’entrée du tchat ; à chaque tour d’Azer, l’Entrée Protocole applique ensuite la copie de session déjà chargée, avec rechargement intégral seulement si cette copie est invalidée, incomplète, indisponible ou matériellement douteuse. Le plugin charge ensuite le contexte applicable et route vers des Skills spécialisés de preuve, recherche, diagnostic, tests, revue, sécurité agentique, Magistri Operis, artefacts, interfaces, Savoir, Continuité, fiabilité, Affaire et raccord local. Lorsque les capacités Noyau réellement autorisées sont disponibles, le maillage peut aussi router le pilotage Android sans confondre présence du plugin et disponibilité opérationnelle.
interface.default_prompt: Travaille avec tout le Continuum et applique ses exigences réellement applicables.
default_prompts: Travaille avec tout le Continuum et applique ses exigences réellement applicables.
Reprends ce travail avec la Continuité, le Savoir, les preuves et les capacités réellement utiles.

interface.short_description: Create games for Chromatic.
interface.long_description:
Make your own games for ModRetro Chromatic, directly in Codex. Turn your ideas into playable adventures. Create worlds, design characters and pixel art, write dialogue, and test your game as it takes shape. 

When you're ready,  flash your game to the compatible ModRetro Chromatic Game Cartridge. Then pick up your Chromatic and play what you created. Built on GB Studio and the Chromatic Firmware Updater, the plugin creates Game Boy and Game Boy Color games that remain fully editable in GB Studio.

Cartridge activation keys are exclusive to the ModRetro Chromatic: DevDay Edition. Each activation key is limited to two devices.

release.description: Codex-only PRD swarm orchestration with contract-preserving intake.

interface.short_description: Run PRDs as reviewed lanes
interface.long_description: Hand it a folder of PRDs and it builds them. Each PRD runs in its own git worktree, so lanes work in parallel without stepping on each other. When a lane finishes, a separate reviewer model checks it in a read-only process, and delivery is gated on the checks the PRD itself asked for. The model that writes the code is never the model that approves it. You get a report of what shipped, what is blocked, and the command to resume anything unfinished.

release.description: Automatically guards supported Codex tool calls with Atbash safety judgments and provides secure local setup guidance.

interface.short_description: Guard tool calls with Atbash
interface.long_description:
Atbash Safety checks supported Codex tool calls against your Atbash agent's safety policy before execution. The package includes a local PreToolUse hook, the bundled production Atbash SDK, and a setup and troubleshooting skill; it does not use an MCP server.

Requires a supported local Codex environment, Node.js 22.13 or newer, an Atbash account with a registered agent, and network access to Atbash services. Configure your agent private key and exact organization name in the local Atbash configuration file, then explicitly review and trust the hook in Codex. Never paste private keys into chat.

Once configured, enabled, and trusted, the hook sends tool-call details through the SDK to Atbash for a judgment. ALLOW permits the pending call; HOLD, BLOCK, and handled configuration or service errors deny that attempt. Coverage is limited to tool calls exposed to Codex's PreToolUse lifecycle; ordinary Chat, plain-text replies, and tools outside that lifecycle are not protected.

Source and setup instructions: https://github.com/Atbash-Ai/atbash-chatgpt-plugin
interface.default_prompt: Use $atbash-setup to configure Atbash without sharing my private key.
default_prompts: Use $atbash-setup to configure Atbash without sharing my private key.

release.description: An interactive, non-legal assessment that helps emerging companies sanity-check document readiness before fundraising.

interface.short_description: Assess financing readiness
interface.long_description:
Prepare for financing with a clearer picture of your company's records and a practical plan for what to organize next.

ECVC Financing Readiness helps founders and emerging-company teams turn scattered information into a structured preparation checklist. See which records appear accounted for, which need attention, and which questions remain unanswered before initial investor diligence.

Start with guided questions, review of documents you choose to provide, or both. An optional pitch deck can help prefill company context; its claims are flagged for confirmation, not treated as proof.

The seven-step assessment covers company and governance records; capitalization; people, intellectual property and digital assets; financial and tax organization; commercial agreements, privacy and regulatory records; disputes and investigations; and data-room organization.

Get a provisional process-readiness score alongside assessment completeness and reviewed-evidence coverage, so the result shows both your preparation and the limits of the information available. A category summary and prioritized action plan help your team decide what to organize first.

When requested, create an editable readiness report, workbook, or data-room index and action plan in a format supported by your environment. A data-room index is an organizational aid, not a hosted data room.

Provided by Pillsbury Winthrop Shaw Pittman LLP. Workflow author: Steve Ryan.

This plugin provides general information and organizational guidance, not legal or investment advice. It does not determine legal validity, ownership, enforceability, compliance or investment suitability, or predict whether financing will succeed. Use does not create an attorney-client relationship. Share only materials you are authorized to provide and remove unnecessary sensitive information.
interface.default_prompt: Help me assess my company’s financing readiness.

release.description:
Connect ChatGPT to your Avoma workspace and get meeting intelligence, including call transcripts, AI-generated notes, scorecard results, and usage analytics. Ask ChatGPT to summarize calls and action items, review scorecard results, or walk into your next call with the context from past meetings.

Read capabilities:
- Meeting transcripts, structured notes, and AI summaries
- Scorecard evaluations and team usage / engagement metrics
- CRM deal stages, CRM associations, meeting outcomes, meeting types, and team listings

Write capabilities:
- Update meeting outcomes
- Set meeting privacy — private, organization, public, or team-scoped
- Assign meeting types / purposes

You can use the Avoma connector to:

- Review calls and action items:
 "Summarise my calls from last week and list open action items"
- Check rep scorecards:
 "Show me scorecard results for jane@example.com from the last 30 days and identify the three criteria with the lowest average scores."
- Find meetings by deal stage:
 "Find meetings from the last 90 days linked to deals in the Closed Won CRM stage and summarize the common buying signals."
- Update meeting outcomes:
 "Set the outcome of my demo call with Acme Corp from June 15 to Qualified"
- Manage meeting privacy:
 "Make my most recent Globex onboarding call visible only to the Customer Success team."
- Create a playbook:
 "Analyze meetings from the last week linked to Closed Won and Closed Lost deal stages and create a coaching playbook with examples of effective discovery questions, objection handling, and closing techniques."

Access is controlled by your Avoma permissions and OAuth 2.1 credentials. Avoma does not grant ChatGPT any permissions beyond your own. Meeting details included in a ChatGPT response may be retained in your saved chats, and connected-app information may be used by Memory depending on your settings; manage these in ChatGPT's data controls.

release.description: JuicyLucy's paid-media ad production: /video-ad-production and /static-ad-production, with the composition, motion and media skills a video run reads, the platform and workspace conventions both engines share, the brand facts they resolve, and /juicylucy-setup for the local toolchain.

interface.short_description: Make video and static ads
interface.long_description:
Create video and static ads from a brief or your existing creative, adapt them for Meta, Instagram and TikTok, and localize them for different markets.

Two entry points:
• /video-ad-production — a new ad from a brief or, more often, a variation of a reference creative ("copy this ad, change the hook"). It generates the first frame and then the footage, cuts to the placement spec, checks the copy against Meta's advertising policies, and exports under a filename an ads-manager report can be traced back to.
• /static-ad-production — iterate your own winning statics into a batch, write policy-compliant copy, localize into every approved language, and QA the batch before upload.

Behind them: the composition, motion and media skills a video run reads, the placement specs and copy-rejection taxonomy both engines share, the naming and foldering conventions that make exports traceable, and /juicylucy-setup, which gets your Mac ready. Product facts, the claims a brand may not make, and its colours and type come from a brand skill the engines resolve at the start of every run.

What you need
• Codex on macOS. Ad production renders video and images on your Mac. The plugin is not usable from ChatGPT on the web or on a phone; asked there, it says so and points you to Codex.
• A JuicyLucy account for image and video generation. Composition, cutting and export work without one. /juicylucy-setup signs you in with a code sent to your email, and creates the account the same way if you have none.
• Nothing else. The first time you ask, /juicylucy-setup installs everything the plugin needs on your Mac, with no administrator password, and asks before each download.

Your data

interface.long_description:
Blink turns a description into a working app, with a database, sign-in, a backend and hosting, and publishes it to a live link. You do it all from this conversation.

What you can do:
• Build an app by describing it: a client portal, a booking site, an internal dashboard, a landing page or a mobile app.

• Answer Blink's questions right in the chat when it needs a decision, like which kind of app or which look.
• See the finished app right in the chat, with a screenshot and what changed, then publish it to a live URL.
• Look inside any project: list your projects, read the source at any saved version, compare two versions, query the database, and read backend logs when something fails.
• Restore an earlier version if a change went wrong.

How it works: connecting is a normal sign-in, and you choose which Blink workspace to grant. Code changes always go through Blink's agent, so your app's source and its saved versions stay in step. You can disconnect at any time from Blink Settings, Access Tokens, Connected apps.

release.description: Safe Unix, Linux, macOS, and shell command workflows.

interface.short_description: Safe shell commands & scripts
interface.long_description: Unix Copilot helps you write, understand, debug, and safely run shell commands and scripts across Linux and macOS. It can translate plain-language tasks into copy-ready commands, explain pipes and redirection, troubleshoot shell scripts, handle files and text safely, prepare CSV and delimited data, and provide OS-appropriate package and environment guidance. It distinguishes POSIX, Bash, zsh, GNU, BSD/macOS, and Linux behavior, uses dry-runs and validation for risky operations, and avoids unsafe patterns such as unverified recursive deletion, broad permission changes, secret exposure, and brittle filename parsing.
capabilities: Turn plain-language tasks into safe, copy-ready Unix and shell commands
Explain and debug Bash, zsh, POSIX shell commands, pipelines, quoting, and redirection
Distinguish Linux, macOS/BSD, GNU, Bash, zsh, and POSIX command behavior
Preview risky file, permission, process, package, and system changes before execution
Write and review shell scripts with argument checks, cleanup, errors, and safe quoting
Handle find, grep, sed, awk, xargs, sorting, and bulk file operations safely
Work with CSV, TSV, encodings, and command-line data preparation without corrupting data

release.description: Rules for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech.

interface.short_description: Clear Czech technical writing
interface.long_description:
Controlled Czech is an open specification for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech, packaged as a skill. Use it when writing, editing or reviewing Czech documentation, specifications, ADRs, issues, pull request descriptions, runbooks and AI agent instructions.

Every rule has a stable identifier (CCxxx), so the agent can load a single rule instead of the whole specification and every suggestion can be traced back to it. Only the skill description enters the context up front; the full rules load when Czech text is actually being written.

The repository also ships a deterministic linter written in Go (controlled-czech check). It runs offline, uses no LLM and never rewrites text, so the same rules can gate documentation in CI with --fail-on-warning.

Not intended for marketing copy, fiction, personal communication or brand voice.

interface.short_description: 対話から、論考・指示・レビュー・掲載を育てる
interface.long_description:
Dialogue Skillsは、人間とAIの対話を文章や実行用の指示へ育てる、4つの独立したスキルです。

・Essay：人間の着想をまとまって伝え、AIによる検討と総括を別の部分に置いた論考を作ります。
・Prompt：人間の制作動機を残し、エージェントに託す目的と実行条件を備えたプロンプトにします。
・Checker：制作意図と完成条件に照らしてレビューします。必要な修正、確認不足、任意の拡張を区別し、目的を満たす成果物には完成を伝えます。
・Publisher：完成原稿を利用者が選んだ媒体・言語・公開形態へ整え、利用環境で操作できる場合に掲載や更新を進めます。

各スキルは必要なものだけ単独で使えます。本文と付属の事例は日本語です。掲載先への接続や認証情報は同梱していません。掲載やファイル保存などの実行範囲は、利用するChatGPT・Codex環境のツールと権限に依存します。

論考とレビューでは、本文に加えて紹介するリンクや添付も対象とし、読者への有用性と会話の参加者にとっての適切さを確かめます。AIによるレビューは、誤りが一切ないことの保証ではありません。

Formulate research questions, trace literature claims to primary sources, draft and minimally edit technical prose, and examine security arguments under their stated definitions and assumptions. For implementation work, use separate workflows for protocol correspondence, benchmark accounting, evaluation writing, and reproducible artifacts.

release.description: Follow-ups, matter updates, meeting briefs, and prospect signals for law firm partners, sourced from the inbox you already have and the public web.

interface.short_description: Partner inbox intelligence
interface.long_description:
Most business development support tools want your data and tell you what to do. Maeve Lite reads the inbox you already have, keeps everything inside your ChatGPT workspace, quotes rather than guesses, and never touches a deadline.

Five skills for the partner who runs relationships out of email: Follow-up Radar finds what you owe, what you're waiting on, and which prospect threads have gone quiet. Matter Pulse turns recent mail into update-ready litigation and deal updates for your business development or operations team. Meeting Brief gives you the one page you read before a call, built from your own history with the people in the room. Week Ahead lays out what's scheduled, what's due, and what needs preparing. Client News Monitor finds recent public developments about a named prospect or client and their company, with an opened source behind every fact.

Built for how relationship-owning lawyers actually work. The mailbox is treated as the record because the CRM rarely is. Every line, date, client scope and output cites the email it came from, so you can verify it in one step. The output is a reading of your mail, not a floating recommendation.

Nothing leaves your workspace. The mailbox skills use the Gmail or Outlook account already authorized in ChatGPT and are read-only by default; Follow-up Radar and Matter Pulse can create one unsent draft on explicit request, and no skill ever sends email. Client News Monitor uses public web search only and never touches email or other connected data. Maeve operates no server behind these skills: no analytics, no callbacks, and no transfer of prompts, outputs, mailbox content, or credentials to Maeve. Confidential matter details never go into a web query.

Intended for ChatGPT Business or Enterprise workspaces, where terms exclude training on your content. Maeve Lite does not provide legal advice. Maeve Lite runs on one partner's mailbox; Maeve brings the same signals firm-wide across matters, people, and clients — for enterprise product contact www.maeven.ai.

release.description: Skills for the Mergify CLI: merge queue, stacked pull requests, CI Insights, merge protections, and configuration.

interface.short_description: Run and debug your merge queue
interface.long_description:
Mergify serializes merges through a queue that runs CI on temporary merge commits, so a pull request that only breaks in combination with another one gets caught before it reaches your default branch. These skills drive the Mergify CLI so an agent can work that queue with you.

Ask why a pull request left the queue and get the engine's own dequeue reason, the checks that failed, and a link straight to the job log. Read the activity log for one pull request or for the whole repository. Validate a .mergify.yml against the schema before you commit it, or simulate what your rules would do on a real pull request. Set up merge protections such as dependencies between pull requests or scheduled freezes for a release window. Turn a branch of commits into a stack of one pull request per commit and keep them rebased.

Six skills ship in the bundle: mergify-merge-queue, mergify-events, mergify-config, mergify-merge-protections, mergify-ci, and mergify-stack.

It runs on the Mergify CLI, a single static binary with no runtime to install, so it needs a local execution environment: Codex, or ChatGPT desktop with local execution. You need a GitHub repository with Mergify enabled. Install the CLI with 'brew install mergifyio/tap/mergify-cli', sign in once with 'mergify auth login' or set MERGIFY_TOKEN, then ask for what you want in plain language.
interface.default_prompt: Why did pull request #1234 leave the merge queue?

release.description: Sports video analysis: measures speed, distance and joint angles from your own phone videos and replays the motion in 3D.

interface.short_description: Measure your moves in 3D
interface.long_description:
Autelica is a sports video analysis app. It measures human movement from ordinary phone videos: how fast you ran, how far you went, your knee and hip angles and your left-right balance, with a 3D replay of the motion.

Attach a video of your sprint, jump, cut or swing and ask how fast you were. Autelica measures the whole motion, not a few frames: top speed, distance, knee and hip angles and left-right balance, with a 3D view you can orbit. One video gives an estimate, clearly labelled. Two to four videos of the same moment, filmed at the same time from different sides, give a measurement: Autelica lines up the clips, works out where each camera was from the athlete's own body and rebuilds every joint in 3D. While it processes, the card shows your place in the queue; when it's done, ChatGPT explains what the numbers mean and what to work on.

No video yet? Open an example: a real athlete filmed by three drones or three tripod cameras, rebuilt as a photoreal replay you can freeze and fly around, with its measured numbers. Or ask how to film: Autelica gives a setup for the number of phones you have.

Beat the sprint is a game built on the same motion: tap on each footstrike to race a real athlete's captured run, then send a friend a link to race your ghost.

Each result carries a grade that says how well the cameras agreed, and nothing about the athlete is generated. No account needed. Numbers are measurements from video with stated accuracy, not medical advice.

release.description: Persistent AI memory, saved context, tasks, and local relay tools.

interface.short_description: Persistent memory for your AI
interface.long_description:
BetterContext provides persistent memory for AI tasks that have local computer access. Save and recall project decisions, preferences, notes, and tasks; register chats with MEM message counters; and relay messages between registered chats sharing one database.

This Directory release contains skills and local Python commands. It does not register BetterContext callable MCP tools. Memory and relay work through the assistant's local command execution and require Python 3.10+ plus access to your chosen persistent folder. Ordinary hosted ChatGPT chats cannot access your computer's memory database by installing this plugin. Hosted ChatGPT Work may run these commands in its own execution environment; persistence and sharing between hosted chats are not guaranteed. This is separate from storage on your computer. The full local package provides direct MCP tool integration separately.

To choose or move storage, ask: "Show my memory location" or "Move my existing BetterContext memory to [absolute folder]." To share a store between computers, enroll each installation in the same permanent shared registry using that computer's mount path. Migrations preview the change, create a verified backup, preserve records and counters, and update enrolled installations. Keep the registry outside the moved folder and reachable by every host. Public and private editions stay separate.

MEM counters reconcile available visible assistant-message history; prefix display depends on the assistant following the skill. A counter is not a complete transcript archive. Cross-chat recall covers saved/imported content and accessible history, not every conversation in your account.

Relay queues messages; it does not itself wake another chat. An optional helper can wake selected local Codex tasks when the destination computer is running and has a compatible Codex CLI. Windows helper installation is tested; new Linux/macOS installers and reboot behavior remain unverified. Hosted ChatGPT wake is unavailable.

Records stay in your chosen local or shared-filesystem database. Unknown Digital LLC operates no storage backend or telemetry for these records. Retrieved information enters your assistant conversation under that platform's data settings. No measured chat-wide token-savings claim is made.

release.description: Carry useful work across Codex chats with local memory you control

interface.short_description: Local memory for Codex
interface.long_description:
Eggshell helps independent Codex chats reuse relevant prior work. It saves requests, tool results, and conclusions in local .egg files, then supplies selected findings when a related task begins. Codex can reuse supported findings, check changed facts, and explain what remains unverified.

Memory organization and retrieval run locally without generative LLM calls. Ordinary Codex task and handoff tokens still count toward model usage. Eggshell has no hosted memory service or telemetry.

This plugin provides local setup, inspection, and memory controls. First use requires macOS or Linux on ARM64 or x86-64, Python 3, downloads of the runtime and search model, project initialization, and review of Codex command hooks. Automatic memory requires those local hooks; this plugin does not provide automatic memory in ChatGPT.

Inspect the delivered handoff with !egg graph and its selection with !egg why. Tool observations can be saved while a turn is running. !egg drop clears the active turn but retains saved observations and queued commits. Use !egg off to disable recording and handoff delivery.
interface.default_prompt: Set up Eggshell for this Codex project.

interface.short_description: Build and edit websites
interface.long_description:
Beste builds and runs websites. Connect your Beste account to create a new site from a short brief, or to work on one you already have, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Start a site: describe the business in a sentence or two and watch the site being built, page by page, in a live preview next to the chat. You get three finished pages, a live link and a link to edit them.
- See every change: the live preview shows the draft exactly as it will look once published, updates the moment something changes, and opens any page in Beste Studio in one click.

- Go multilingual: add a language and translate pages in place.
- Write blog posts, manage products and forms, and set SEO titles and descriptions.
- Measure: put GA4 or Meta pixel events on the links that matter, as a funnel.
- Review: list what still reads like demo content before you share the site.

Every change is saved as a draft. Nothing goes live until you ask for it to be published.

You need a Beste account. Images can be generated with AI credits from your Beste account.

release.description:
Glow is WordPress maintenance and management software for agencies: updates, uptime and SSL monitoring, backups, vulnerability scanning, client reporting and support tickets, for every site an agency looks after, in one dashboard.

A vulnerability is published most weeks and the first question is the same: which of my sites are exposed? release.description:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.

interface.long_description:
Bring your Parrot Spanish level, streak, and vocabulary into ChatGPT, and save words you learn back to Parrot.

Parrot is a Spanish learning app. Once you connect your Parrot account, ChatGPT can see your Parrot level and the matching CEFR level, your day streak, and the Spanish words you are learning and already know. It uses them to pitch explanations, conversations, and quizzes at your level and around your own words.

When you ask, ChatGPT can save new Spanish words to your Parrot dictionary as learning or known, and count a real practice session toward your Parrot streak.

Who it's for: Parrot learners who want to practice Spanish in ChatGPT with the same level and vocabulary they use in the app.

Limitations: requires a Parrot account. Spanish only. ChatGPT cannot change your Parrot level, and it never sees your email, password, payment details, or listening history. You can disconnect at any time in Parrot under Settings, Connected Apps.

release.description: Data engineering plugin - warehouse exploration, pipeline authoring, Airflow integration

interface.short_description: Build and debug Airflow DAGs
interface.long_description:
Astronomer's toolkit for Apache Airflow and the data it moves. Ask for a pipeline, a fix or an answer from your warehouse, and the plugin follows the steps an Airflow engineer would.

Build and test DAGs. Write new DAGs, extend existing ones, and test them locally before you deploy. Covers dbt with Cosmos, DAG Factory, Blueprint, human-in-the-loop tasks, Airflow plugins, and tasks written in Go or Java.

Debug failures. Find out why a DAG fails to parse or a task keeps failing. The plugin reads the logs, finds the root cause, and fixes the code.

Run Astro. Set up an Astro project, run Airflow locally, deploy, and troubleshoot Astro deployments.

Migrate. Move DAGs from Airflow 2 to Airflow 3, or move a Dagster project to Airflow.

Query your warehouse. Answer business questions with SQL against Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres and other SQLAlchemy databases. Profile tables, check how fresh the data is, and generate a schema reference so later questions go faster.

Trace lineage. See what feeds a table and what breaks downstream if it changes.

Most skills run local tools such as the Astro CLI and uv, so they work best in Codex. Warehouse skills read connection details from ~/.astro/agents/warehouse.yml.

O Topo de Bolo Express transforma a foto de um topo de bolo em um arquivo digital pronto para imprimir e cortar, no estilo Silhouette Studio.

Como funciona:
• 1. Envie a foto do bolo com o topo.
• 2. Aguarde a imagem ser gerada: todos os elementos do topo aparecem separados, com linha de corte branca ao redor, sem encostar uns nos outros, em fundo branco e no formato vertical.

O arquivo final remove o bolo, os palitos, o glacê e as sombras da foto, mantendo as cores e o estilo da arte, para facilitar a impressão e o corte.

Uso exclusivo para alunas: o acesso é liberado com a senha entregue nas aulas. Desenvolvido por fazendoanossafesta.com.br

release.description:
WODone turns the gym whiteboard into a training log you can talk to.

Upload a photo of the day's WOD and ChatGPT reads it, then WODone saves it as a structured record: workout type, movements with reps and loads, your score, and the original text exactly as written. Weights and distances are converted to consistent units, and movement names are normalized, so "T2B", "toes to bar", and "Toes-To-Bar" all land on the same movement in your history.

Ask for your records and WODone shows them newest first, or filters by date or movement — "show my thruster workouts from last week". Open one and you also see how you performed each of its movements before, so you can tell whether today was heavier or faster than last time.

Got something wrong? Tell WODone what to fix and it corrects the record, or delete it.

WODone never receives your photos — ChatGPT reads them and passes along only the text.

interface.short_description: Wallets, tokens, rug checks
interface.long_description:
Look up any Solana wallet address to see its SOL balance, every SPL and Token-2022 holding with live USD values, and recent activity. Paste a token mint to get supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, top-holder concentration and a plain-English risk read. Paste a transaction signature to get it explained. Read-only: nothing to connect or sign.

Tools:
• inspect_wallet — Return SOL balance, all token holdings with USD values, total tracked value and the 10 most recent transactions for a Solana wallet address.
• check_token — Return supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, metadata mutability, top-20 holders with concentration, and a heuristic rug-risk score for a token mint.
• explain_transaction — Decode a transaction signature: status, fee, programs invoked, SOL and token balance changes, and the last log lines.

Targets questions like: “check solana wallet”; “solana wallet balance”; “what tokens does this wallet hold”; “is this token a rug”; “solana token holders”; “solana transaction explained”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/wallet-inspector

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.

release.description: Compare, use, and tune original Soul Kit personalities in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.short_description: Compare and tune AI voices
interface.long_description:
Give your AI a voice of its own.

Compare Flint, Lantern, and Moss on your own question, then choose the personality you want to work with. Flint gets to the decision, Lantern explains with a concrete example, and Moss offers a measured view with occasional dry humor. You can also import a Soul Kit from Honorary Human.

Adjust the selected voice as you work: less humor, warmer wording, shorter answers, or writing only. Ask which voice is active, pause and resume it, reset your adjustments, or switch personalities. These choices apply to the current conversation. Your instructions, facts, and requested format take priority.

When you ask to save lasting changes, Soulware can prepare a revised portable Soul Kit. With file execution available, its bundled helper validates and versions the file while preserving the original. Otherwise it can provide manually inspected JSON to save yourself. Reimport the revised kit to use it in another conversation.

In local Codex, you can also export a reusable voice skill, install it for yourself or a project, and choose whether to make it a default. Inspect, update, or remove installed kits when needed.

The plugin requires no Soulware account or API key. Its bundled helper makes no network requests and does not send your kit or conversations to Honorary Human. ChatGPT and Codex still process the content you give them under their own settings and policies.

Find more Soul Kits or create an original personality at honoraryhuman.com. A personality is a designed communication style. It does not impersonate a real person or change account-wide ChatGPT preferences.
interface.default_prompt: Compare Flint and Lantern: should I rebuild my whole website because one page is confusing?
default_prompts: Compare Flint and Lantern: should I rebuild my whole website because one page is confusing?
Import my attached Soul Kit and use its voice for writing only.
Try Moss with less humor and help me choose a manageable first step for a new project.

interface.default_prompt: Use $soulware to compare Flint and Lantern on whether one confusing page justifies rebuilding a website.

release.description: Fastio workspaces for agents and the people they work with: files, shares, comments, metadata and AI search through the Fastio MCP server, plus the agent guide as a skill.

interface.short_description: Files, workspaces, AI search
interface.long_description:
Fastio is a workspace and file-storage platform for teams. This app connects a signed-in Fastio account to ChatGPT: browse and search workspaces and files, read file text and metadata, organize folders, upload files, manage branded shares, read and add comments, and manage workspace and share members.

Sign-in uses OAuth in the browser; the app acts with the permissions of the signed-in account. No tool accepts a password, API key or verification code, and no tool returns one.

Each operation is its own tool (for example `storage_search`, `storage_create_folder`, `share_create`). Read tools only retrieve data. Tools that change data are marked as writes, and tools that delete or overwrite data are marked destructive, so ChatGPT can ask the user before running them.

Search finds files by keyword or semantic match within one workspace or share and returns ranked results with short excerpts; a separate tool returns a quoted passage from a specific file.

The app does not display plans, start subscriptions or handle payments.
capabilities: Search files in a workspace or share
Create, move, rename and delete files and folders
Upload files and import files from a URL
List, add and remove workspace and share members
Get time-limited download and ZIP links

release.description:
Tailor lets ChatGPT read Tailor Platform's public documentation and answer questions about building on it, grounded in the published docs rather than training data.

Tailor Platform is a headless ERP platform: define your data model, workflows, and permissions in code with the Tailor SDK, and get a GraphQL API, TailorDB, StateFlow workflows, Pipelines, Auth, and an App Shell for building business applications.

What this plugin does:
- search_knowledge: find documentation pages whose body text mentions a term, with an excerpt and a link for each hit
- list_knowledge: browse the table of contents by source or section
- fetch_knowledge: read a page as Markdown, or one section of a long page

Every answer can cite the exact page on docs.tailor.tech.

No account, sign-in, or token is required. The plugin only reads Tailor's published documentation; it cannot access any customer's application, data, or workspace. All tools are read-only.

Good for: developers evaluating or building on Tailor Platform, teams writing tailor.config.ts, and anyone asking how to do something in TailorDB, StateFlow, or the Tailor SDK.

release.description: Design custom map posters of the places that matter, as wall art or a personalized gift: where you met, got engaged or married, a first home, a hometown, a city someone is leaving or a trip. Pick any city, address or landmark and one of 50+ styles, add names, a date and a heart on the spot, then open the poster in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it or, in the drawn map styles, order it as a print.

interface.short_description: Map poster gifts and wall art
interface.long_description:
MapPoster turns the places in your life into a map poster: a personal gift for someone you love, or wall art for your own home.

Tell ChatGPT the occasion and the place, and MapPoster designs the poster right in the chat. Make a map of the street where you met as an anniversary or Valentine's gift, or of the venue where a couple got married as a wedding gift. Give friends a housewarming gift of their first home with a heart on their new street, or give someone who is moving away a map of their hometown. You can also map the city of a honeymoon or a road trip, or a baby's birthplace in soft pastels for the nursery.

Every poster is a map of a real place: a city, neighborhood, street address or landmark, in one of 50+ styles. Add your own title, names, a date, coordinates or a short message in 14 fonts, a heart or marker on the exact spot and a driving route on the map. Make it a heart-shaped, round or hexagon map, or add a gallery mat. One poster can also hold up to three places, each with its own map and label: where you met, got engaged and got married, or two cities for a long-distance couple.

You see a preview of the poster in the conversation and can try other styles and move the map right there. Screen-size designs in 15 of the styles can be downloaded as a PNG (up to 1080 px, with a small watermark). Every design opens in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it, and posters in the drawn map styles can be ordered there as a printed poster (from A4), a framed print or a canvas, up to 18x24 in, plus square sizes, shipped to you or straight to the person it's for.

What you can ask for:
- Map wall art for a living room, home office, dorm or nursery
- Styles from minimalist black and white and vintage-style to blueprint, dark, neon, pastel and rose gold
- Sizes for prints, square frames, Instagram and phone or desktop wallpapers

Limits: up to three places per poster; a poster with several places is rectangular, with the markers and route on its first map. Routes are driving routes. The chat preview leaves out street names; the classic city map styles show them in the editor. Prints ship to 20 countries, including the US, Canada, the UK, much of Europe, Australia and Japan.

Street maps are drawn from OpenStreetMap data. MapPoster needs no account and doesn't store your posters or your conversation.

Makes map posters of places tied to a moment: where you met, a wedding venue, a first home, a hometown or a trip
Puts up to three places on one poster, each with its own label: met, engaged and married, or two cities

release.description:
AiEngage CRM connects ChatGPT to your own AiEngage CRM workspace so you can ask questions about your sales and marketing data in plain language instead of building a report.

Ask how many contacts you have, what is in the pipeline and at which stage, which campaign performed best last quarter, who on the team logged the most meetings, how a workflow or web form is converting, or what your advertising spend returned. ChatGPT reads the answer directly from your live CRM and explains it.

The connection is strictly read-only. There is no tool that can create, edit, delete or send anything, so nothing in your CRM can be changed from ChatGPT.

You sign in with your own AiEngage login and choose exactly which areas ChatGPT may read - records, reports, analytics, campaigns, segments, lists, workflows, advertising, web forms and more - and which modules within them. Every read runs as you, so ChatGPT sees only the records your CRM permissions already allow you to see, and nothing from any other organization. You can change what is shared, or disconnect entirely, at any time from Settings > API & Connections.
