release.description: Noon is an AI recruiter. Source candidates for a role, review who Noon found, edit the outreach it sends, and diagnose how a role's search is going.

interface.short_description: AI sourcing and outreach
interface.long_description:
Noon is an AI recruiter. Connect it to ChatGPT to source candidates for a job, review who Noon found, shape the outreach Noon sends, and find out why a role's search is or isn't working, all from a conversation.

What you can do
• Source candidates: describe a role or paste a job description, and Noon creates the role and starts searching for matching people.
• Review the feed: see the candidates Noon surfaced for a role, with its reasoning for each match.
• Accept or reject candidates: accepting adds someone to the role's project (and starts outreach when auto-contact is on); rejecting with a reason teaches Noon what to avoid.
• Give feedback on the feed as a whole ("too many consultants", "more fintech backgrounds"): Noon re-scores the current candidates and adjusts future sourcing.
• Read and rewrite outreach sequences: LinkedIn invites, InMails, emails and follow-ups.
• Diagnose a role's search: funnel counts, top rejection reasons, which single requirement is blocking otherwise-qualified people, and what loosening each filter would add.
• Look up a candidate's profile and the evaluation behind Noon's decision.

Who it's for
Recruiters, sourcers and hiring managers who use Noon.

Requirements and limits
• You need a Noon account (www.noon.ai). You sign in with your Noon login when you connect, and ChatGPT only sees the roles and candidates in your Noon workspace.
• Outreach goes out from the email and LinkedIn accounts connected in your Noon portal.
• Noon can't delete roles, change billing, or access other companies' workspaces from ChatGPT.
• Everything done here also shows up in your Noon portal.
interface.default_prompt: List my open Noon roles and show the newest candidates for the most recent one.
default_prompts: List my open Noon roles and show the newest candidates for the most recent one.

release.description:
GrowByData Compass helps teams track share of voice, search rankings, and visibility across both traditional search engines and AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, and Perplexity.
Common tasks include monitoring keyword rankings and position history over time, comparing share of voice against competitors, and identifying keyword gaps where competitors rank but a domain doesn't. Users also track how their brand is mentioned and cited within AI-generated search answers, including sentiment, and analyze SERP feature ownership such as featured snippets and above-the-fold placements. On the advertising side, it supports monitoring competitor text ads, shopping ads, and ad placements within AI search results.
Example prompts a user might type:
 "How is our domain ranking for our top 20 keywords this month?"
 "Show me our share of voice versus our top 3 competitors over the last quarter."
 "Are we being mentioned in ChatGPT or AI Overviews for our category, and what's the sentiment?"
 "What keywords are our competitors ranking for that we're missing?"

release.description:
Klap turns long videos into short vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, right from ChatGPT.

Share a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or Vimeo link, or any public video URL, and ask for shorts. Klap finds the most engaging moments, reframes them to 9:16 around the speaker, adds animated captions and ranks every clip by virality score. Clipping runs in the background: a live card shows its progress, then turns into a gallery of shorts you can play right in the conversation.

From the gallery you can:
• Watch each short with its captions
• Download a short as an MP4
• Schedule a short to your connected YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn or Facebook accounts, at the time you choose
• Open a short in the Klap editor to fine-tune captions, layout and length

You can also guide the clipping ("the funniest moments about pricing", "15-second clips", "5 clips at most"), set the spoken language, and ask for your recent projects.

Using Klap in ChatGPT requires a Klap account. Exports and scheduling follow your Klap plan. Social accounts are connected on klap.app, and ChatGPT never receives their credentials. Klap only publishes a post after you confirm the short, the accounts, the time and the caption.

release.description: Brain Rot Index, Focus Room and a 7-day plan to use your phone less.

interface.short_description: Check your brain rot level
interface.long_description:
Nobrainrot shows you how much of your life your phone is taking, then helps you take it back.

The Brain Rot Index is a 2-minute self-check: two sliders (daily phone hours and age) and 10 questions adapted from the Smartphone Addiction Scale – Short Version (Kwon et al., 2013). You get a score out of 100, one of eight habit types (like Night Scroller or Phantom Checker), and an estimate of the years you would spend on a screen before 80 at your current rate. You can share your result with a link.

Then do something about it:
• Focus Room: name the task, pick 25, 45 or 90 minutes, put the phone away. A live timer runs in the chat and you get a short receipt at the end.
• 7-day detox plan: one offline action a day, built around your habit type or what you want to fix (nights, work, social media).
• Screen time receipt: share your daily screen time and see what it adds up to per week, per year and per decade.
• Shift: a physical NFC puck you tap with your iPhone to lock distracting apps. Works with the Shift app for iOS.

No account, no email. We store your score, type, hours and age so your share link works, never your name. A self-check, not a medical diagnosis.
interface.default_prompt: Am I addicted to my phone? Run the Brain Rot Index.
default_prompts: Am I addicted to my phone? Run the Brain Rot Index.

ASOScan is an ASO skill and plugin for ChatGPT: App Store Optimization (ASO) software for iOS and Android apps, built and run by one app developer. Use ASO with ChatGPT: connect your ASOScan account and ask about your own apps in plain words.

What it does:
- App store ranking and Google Play store ASO. ASOScan reads your ASO score and its recommendations and tells you what to fix first, like an app store optimization checklist for your own listing.
- App keywords. App store keyword research with search volume and difficulty, keyword opportunities you could rank for, and tracking for the ones you pick.
- App store rank tracker. See where you rank for each tracked keyword and how the rank moved day by day, so you can see why your app is not showing in search.
- App store category ranking. See your app's chart position in its category over time.
- ASO audit. Check your app title and subtitle, keywords and description, see what changed over time, and draft listing text for other languages.
- App competitor analysis. Add a competitor by its store link and see the keywords it ranks for, its category rank and its rating history.
- App review analysis. See sentiment, top topics, bugs and feature requests, and get AI drafts of review replies. A reply goes to the store only after you approve the exact text, and only for apps connected to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.

Why teams use it: one set of app store optimization tools for the whole ASO job on both stores, with your real numbers right in the chat. Good ASO improves organic rankings, and ASOScan helps you rank better. It does not promise a rank.

What it does not do: it does not publish listing text to the stores, and it has no download or revenue data. Drafts stay in your ASOScan account.

You need an ASOScan account to see your own numbers. Without an account, the built-in skills still answer general ASO questions.

release.description:
You know the problem. A deadline slips, another fire drill ensues, and it turns out the team knew weeks ago. The information was there. An easy channel for surfacing it wasn't.

Conventional status reporting is painful and often inaccurate as reports get sanitized on the way up. By the time a project is obviously red, the good options have gone.

Genchi opens a different channel, straight to the people actually doing the work. Team members are prompted for a regular two-second check-in: one click, answering how confident they are their initiative will hit its goal by the deadline. Individual answers are anonymous, which is what makes them honest. Aggregated, they become a confidence score you can track over time.

This plugin puts that score into the conversation, rendered rather than described. Ask how your projects are tracking and your whole portfolio appears as color-coded cards. More complex project structures unfurl with a click, and clicking any card opens the confidence chart — the current score, the trend over the last fortnight, the anonymized individual check-ins, and any blockers or comments that add context.

Things rarely go wrong all at once. Seeing a team's confidence begin to slip is an opportunity to intervene while there is still time to change the outcome.

Replace the status meeting, and the incessant "so, how's it going?" calls, with a crisp and honest view.

Inspired by the Toyota Production System's genchi genbutsu — "go and see for yourself" — Genchi does the same for software teams: a picture built by the people actually doing the work, at minimal reporting cost.

Each connection is authorized by one person and shows only what they can already see in Genchi. Individual check-ins are never attributed. Check-ins are cast in Slack, or by email.

Genchi also imports initiatives from Jira and Asana, and is free for teams under 10.

release.description: Parametric CAD for 3D printing, by chat: design and edit 3D parts, explore them in a live 3D viewer, then download STL, STEP or 3MF files from PartForge.

interface.short_description: Parametric CAD by chat
interface.long_description:
PartForge is parametric CAD for 3D printing that you drive by chatting. Ask ChatGPT for a 3D-printable part, such as a bracket, a cable clip, a phone stand, an enclosure or a replacement knob, and it writes the part as parametric CAD code in your PartForge account, builds the 3D model, and checks it before telling you it's done.

The part opens in PartForge's live 3D viewer right in the chat. Orbit it, adjust its dimensions with the sliders, and press Keep Settings to save the values you like. Open it in PartForge to download an STL or 3MF for your 3D printer and slicer, or a STEP file for other CAD software.

Every model is parametric: change a length, a wall thickness or a hole size and the whole part updates, so one design fits the screw, the shelf or the printer you actually have. ChatGPT can render the part from any angle, check details that matter for printing, such as wall thickness and whether it fits the print bed, read PartForge's documentation, and build on designs from the public PartForge library of 3D-printable parts.

When you're happy, ChatGPT can publish the part with a name and description, or make it private again. PartForge never sees your conversation, only the requests ChatGPT makes to your account.

release.description:
Intuizi connects ChatGPT to the Intuizi data platform, where marketing teams turn de-identified signal data into audiences and deliver them to their marketing destinations. The plugin queries the Large Behavioral Model, Intuizi's flagship LQM, trained on de-identified, real-world behavioral signal. Responses include counts, statuses, and metadata. Audience data never enters the chat and is sent only to destinations configured in the Intuizi console.

What you can do:
- Look up reference catalogs: POI categories and brands, apps, web domains, CTV channels, Transactions merchants, demographic and profile attributes, countries, and signal providers.
- Estimate how large an audience would be before you build it, then create audiences from POI visits, app usage, web domains, CTV viewing, Transactions, demographics, profile attributes, home location, or your own cohorts, alone or combined with AND, OR, and NOT IN.
- Grow a completed audience with a lookalike model and follow the model run.
- Preview a frequency range, then activate the audience to a delivery destination your team has already set up in the Intuizi console.
- Create cohorts from your own files or from an existing audience, and manage projects, POI categories, brands, and location submissions.
- Check your organization's data-scan usage against its limits.

Every tool wraps a documented Intuizi API v2 endpoint, so validation, permissions, and rate limits match the API exactly. Read-only tools are marked read-only and delete tools are marked destructive. You need an Intuizi console account: connect with one-click OAuth, approve access in your browser, and the plugin sees only the projects and data your account can see.

release.description: Audit AI coding sessions and assistant configs with the locally installed skarn CLI: leaked credentials and risky hooks or MCP servers, reported on this machine with every secret masked.

interface.short_description: AI session security scanner
interface.long_description:
Skarn is a command-line security scanner for AI coding sessions. The audit skill, skarn-audit, teaches the model to run the skarn CLI on this machine and act on what it reports.

The skill runs two passes. skarn assess reads the session transcripts that AI coding assistants have already written to disk and reports leaked credentials, prompt injection, exfiltration attempts, and the chains that connect them; each finding carries the standards mappings that apply to it, drawn from MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025, the OWASP Agentic Top 10, and CWE. skarn vet reads the assistant configuration files on the same machine and reports risky declarations: hooks, MCP servers, and permission grants that could run remote code or send data off the machine.

Both passes run entirely on this machine and make no network call. Neither modifies a session transcript or a configuration file, and every credential value in the output is masked, so a finding names a rule and a masked preview and never the credential itself. Skarn surfaces findings and does not rotate a credential or edit a configuration on its own: the skill proposes, and the user decides. The one thing the skill can write is a baseline entry recording a finding the user has explicitly confirmed as a false positive.

The skill runs a local shell command, so it is offered in Codex. It does not carry the skarn binary, which is installed separately:

npm install -g @skarn-security/skarn
Release binaries: https://github.com/skarn-security/skarn-dist/releases/latest

When the binary is not installed, the skill says how to install it and stops rather than inventing a result. skarn assess and skarn vet need no account and no license.

Skarn also ships a hook that inspects a tool call before Codex runs it, and a skill that reconstructs recent work from session history. Both are distributed through the plugin marketplace at https://github.com/skarn-security/agent-guard.

release.description:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form, schedules an appointment or starts a chat on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to ChatGPT Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

It can detect conversions in 100+ tools, including Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Typeform, Jotform, Webflow Forms, Wix Forms, Squarespace Forms, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Cal.com & more.

It can send conversions to 20+ destinations, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and more.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.

release.description: Drive Bird from your coding agent: operate the Bird API from the terminal with the `bird` CLI, send across email, SMS, and WhatsApp, and audit a domain's email authentication.

interface.short_description: Operate Bird from your agent
interface.long_description:
Bird is the communications infrastructure AI agents operate. Every agent eventually has to reach a human — verify a sign-up, confirm an order, chase an invoice, answer an inbox, place a call. Connect Bird and Codex does all of it for real: email, SMS, and WhatsApp on Bird's own sending infrastructure and carrier connections, calls on Bird SIP trunks, live events to every open browser and app over Bird Realtime — with a delivery timestamp or the exact failure reason instead of a guess.

And Codex doesn't just send through Bird — it can own the endpoints. It claims its agent a durable email address in one call and answers what arrives there. It buys a phone number, gets it verified for texting, and registers the 10DLC campaign behind it. It sets up a SIP trunk and proves the caller ID with a real verification call. Addresses, numbers, trunks, and the compliance behind them — acquired in conversation.

Whatever your account can do, Codex can do here. The tools are generated from Bird's live API — the same surface Bird's own dashboard runs on — so the list Codex shows is always the current one and grows as Bird does. Some of it works before you even connect: grade any domain's live email authentication, analyze headers and DMARC reports, or search Bird's docs, no account needed.

You sign in with Bird when you connect, so there is no API key to paste and no secret sitting in your config.toml. Codex gets only the permissions you already hold, and you can revoke them from your Bird profile.

A good first ask: "Send me a test email and tell me the moment it's delivered." Building an agent? "Claim yourself an email address and reply to whatever arrives."

release.description: Pressure-test a startup idea in a live voice interview with Alex, then get a GO / NO-GO verdict.

interface.short_description: Pressure-test startup ideas
interface.long_description:
GoNoGo validates startup and business ideas: a live voice interview with an AI startup mentor, market research, and a GO or NO-GO verdict on whether the idea is worth building.

Ask ChatGPT to pressure-test your idea and Alex, GoNoGo's AI startup mentor, appears right in the chat as a live talking video. Press Start and talk to him out loud. Alex asks the questions founders tend to skip: who exactly has this problem, what they do about it today, who would pay and why now. Progress bars under the video show which parts of the idea he has covered: founder, problem, solution and market. The interview takes about 15 minutes, and you can go full screen to keep the chat beside you.

When Alex has what he needs, GoNoGo researches the market behind your answers and gives a GO or NO-GO verdict with a score and the reasons. Ask ChatGPT for the result of any of your projects, or open the full reports on gonogo.team.

What you can do:
- Run a live voice interview with Alex about your idea, in the language of your chat
- See your GoNoGo projects and whether their research is still running
- Get the verdict and score of a project right in the conversation

GoNoGo works with your GoNoGo account: you connect it once, and your interviews and projects are saved there. Your voice is used only to run the conversation and is not recorded.

interface.short_description: Make films, videos and images
interface.long_description:
Cadabra AI turns what you say in ChatGPT into finished images, videos and short films. Describe an idea in one sentence, attach a photo or a recording if you have one, and Cadabra designs it, generates it and hands back the result right in the chat.

What you can do:
- Images: create new images or edit your own photos, including text inside the image in English and Hebrew.
- Videos: animate a photo or write a shot from scratch, with camera moves, effects and looks chosen for you or by you.
- Short films: go from one idea to a cut film with scenes, voice, music and captions.
- Voice and sound: narration, dialogue between characters, custom voices, music and sound effects.
- Characters: keep the same character across many shots.
- Finishing: lip sync, captions, translation, video upscaling and background removal.

How it works:
1. Connect your Cadabra AI account.
2. Ask for what you want in plain words. Cadabra picks the right engine and writes the craft prompt for you.
3. Before anything is made, you see exactly what will run and approve it.
4. Your result appears in the chat and is saved to your Cadabra gallery.

Cadabra AI works in English and Hebrew. Your creations stay in your own account at livinginmovie.com.

release.description:
Foodzilla is the nutrition platform dietitians, nutritionists and health coaches use to plan, track and run their practice. This plugin puts that work in the conversation.

Ask ChatGPT for a recipe and it is written, costed for macros and saved to your library. Ask for a week of meals to a calorie and macro target and you get a template ready to review and assign. Add a food to your own database from a label or a link. Draft an intake form, set your booking hours, publish a post to your clients, or check where your subscription stands.

Your clients can connect too, if you let them. A client asks their own assistant to log a meal, water, a workout, their sleep or their weight, and to read the plan for the day. Everything they log lands in their diary, where their coach already looks.

Your client data is not reachable from your connection. A coach connection cannot see a client list, a client's diary, their notes or their record, and it cannot message anyone. It works on the coach's own material only: recipes, foods, meal plan templates, collections, forms, booking hours, content, the store and the subscription. A client connection reaches that one client's own record and nobody else's, and cannot change the plan or the targets their coach set for them. Names and email addresses never go into our server logs.

You need a Foodzilla account. Foodzilla Autopilot is included with the Professional plan and above. Client access is a switch the coach controls, for one client or for everyone.

release.description:
Uptimely is an uptime monitoring and incident management platform. The Uptimely plugin lets ChatGPT work across your projects: read a project overview, list and open monitors along with their status history and targets, list and open incidents, list alerts, list maintenance windows, see who is currently on call, list status pages, and list telemetry services. With write access enabled it can also create a monitor, run an on-demand monitor probe, declare an incident, change incident or alert state, save a postmortem, and create an alert.

You connect by signing in to your existing Uptimely account over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, granting a subset of thirteen granular scopes at the consent screen; project API keys work for non-interactive clients. Every call names the project it acts on — there is no ambient current project — and access is checked against your real Uptimely membership, so one connection cannot reach a project you are not a member of. All seven write tools stay inert until a project owner turns on Allow AI write operations, which is off by default, because some of them page real people or change what a public status page shows. Connected assistants can be reviewed and revoked at any time from Connected AI apps in your user settings.

Twenty tools over Streamable HTTP: thirteen read-only and seven write. The six tools that dispatch outside Uptimely are marked as such in their metadata. The plugin processes no payments, generates no images, video, or audio, and serves no ads.

release.description:
SuperBooks is bookkeeping for freelancers and small teams: bank transactions with AI categorisation, invoices, customers, a receipt inbox and document vault, a time tracker, and financial reports. The SuperBooks plugin lets ChatGPT work your books from your own account: list and inspect transactions, fix a category or workflow status, find unpaid or overdue invoices, draft a new invoice for a customer (drafts are never sent until you say so), look up customers and add new ones, search receipts and documents, match a receipt to a transaction, start and stop time tracking, and pull profit & loss, burn rate, runway, spending by category, revenue, balances, top customers and recurring expenses.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; you approve read and write scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered. Destructive operations — deleting transactions, customers, categories, tags, documents or inbox items, and voiding invoices — are hidden behind a team-level "Destructive AI tools" switch that is OFF by default, on top of the credential's own scope. Every credential is rate-limited (120 calls a minute) and can be revoked at any time from Settings → Developer.

The plugin never moves money: bank connections, payments and billing are only reachable in the app. Sending an invoice e-mails it to your customer, and nothing else leaves your account. No purchases are made in-tool, no images, video or audio are generated, and no ads are served.

release.description: Keep track of a vegetable garden: what is growing where, everything done to it, and what to sow, harvest and water next, timed for where the garden is.

interface.short_description: When to sow, where you garden
interface.long_description:
Gardener's Almanac keeps track of a vegetable garden: what is growing where, everything done to it, and what comes next. Connected to ChatGPT, the garden can be worked by describing it. Say the beds were watered before breakfast and it goes in the log; ask what needs doing this week and the to-do list comes back; ask whether tomorrow is worth watering and ChatGPT checks the same forecast the app does.

Sowing, planting and watering times are worked out for your own ground. You say where the garden is, once, and the timing comes from that place's own climate, anywhere in the world. Every plant is stored as numbers: the warmth a seed needs to germinate, the days from sowing to a first picking, the cold it will and will not take. The same plant gives the right answer in Palermo and in Luleå.

Each growing area keeps its own soil moisture estimate, fed by the forecast where the garden is. Pots dry in hours where open ground takes days, and a greenhouse never waters itself.

Sowing, planting out, watering, weeding, harvests and notes are kept as a permanent record that spans years. It answers "when did the garlic go in last year?", and it is what makes next season's advice better than this season's.

A garden can be shared with a writer, who can log, plan and edit, or a reader, who sees everything and changes nothing. ChatGPT acts as you, with your role in each garden, and can do nothing you couldn't do yourself in the app.

Signing in is by a code sent to your email address, and a new address creates an account.

No ads, no advertising profiles, no third-party analytics. Made by one person in Sweden, on servers in the EU.

interface.short_description: International parcel delivery
interface.long_description:
SAMOS e-commerce helps online retailers that ship from the UK manage international parcel delivery with SAMOS, a UK parcel delivery company that handles customs clearance, duties and taxes, tracking and returns for e-commerce orders to the EU, North America, the Middle East and beyond.

Retailers and their customers can use it to:
- Track a SAMOS parcel by tracking number and get a link to track it with the local delivery company once it reaches them.
- Estimate the cost of sending a parcel from the UK, or returning one to the UK, by destination country and weight, based on SAMOS's published rates.
- See which countries SAMOS delivers to and which support returns.
- Get answers about international shipping with SAMOS, such as IOSS, customs, labels and returns, from the SAMOS help centre.
- Estimate the import duties and taxes a customer may pay on an item shipped from the UK.

No SAMOS account is needed. Parcels can weigh up to 20 kg. Duty and tax figures are estimates, and duties estimates are limited to a few a day. Tracking results never include street addresses or postcodes. The app is read-only: it cannot create shipments, print labels or change anything in a SAMOS account.

release.description:
Stratify backtests Indian index option strategies on a year of real 1-minute NIFTY options data. Describe the trade in plain words — the legs, when to enter, how to manage it while it is open — and the server runs it against every trading day in the window and returns what actually happened.

Every result carries P&L after real charges (brokerage, STT, exchange and SEBI fees, GST, stamp duty) and modelled slippage, return on margin from a SPAN calibration, and an honesty panel: an out-of-sample split, walk-forward folds, a bootstrap interval, and a deflated Sharpe that accounts for how many variants you have already tried. No ratio is reported below 30 trades. Every backtest gets a shareable report page with the equity curve, the rules card and every trade.

The open strategy protocol covers any number of legs on any expiry; strikes by delta, premium, points or percent; per-leg stops and targets; rolling a tested side; entry gates on VIX, index RSI/EMA/SMA and combined premium; clock-time entries and exits; and portfolio rules such as pausing after consecutive losses.

Data never leaves the server — a backtest returns results, not rows. No trades are executed and no financial advice is given: the service never calls a strategy good. Free tier: NIFTY, one year, 100 backtests an hour. Requires a free Stratify account (sign in via OAuth).

Sanctuary is run by International Bible Ministries, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, with technology by WiscAI. It is free, it sells nothing, and it is not a church, counseling, or a crisis service: anyone in crisis is pointed to 988.

release.description:
C4C: Mortgage Industry Regulations gives ChatGPT the actual text of U.S. mortgage regulations and agency guides: HUD Handbook 4000.1, the Fannie Mae Selling and Servicing Guides, the Freddie Mac Guide, the Ginnie Mae MBS Guide, the VA Lenders Handbook (M26-7) and USDA HB-1-3555, plus the CFR and U.S. Code sections they rest on.

Ask a question the way you'd ask a colleague, in plain words or loan-file shorthand like "DTI" or "RSU income". ChatGPT finds the governing section, quotes it verbatim, and gives you the citation, the effective date and the dated source document it came from. It flags when a rule has two versions in force, a pending revision, or was changed by a later letter. It can also look up a citation you already have (B3-4.3-04, 4000.1 II.A.4.c, 12 CFR 1026.43) and check whether a passage, including one from your own draft, really appears in the regulator's text.

Four guided worflows: FHA, VA and USDA loan-file QC, and a review against Fannie Mae's AI Lender Letter LL-2026-04. Each check comes back with the rule it rests on, and your documents stay in your chat.

Read-only, with no sign-in or account. Questions outside mortgage regulation get "not found" rather than a stretch. Results are for research and are not legal advice: verify against the primary source.

interface.short_description: Normas y fallos del Ecuador
interface.long_description: Responde consultas jurídicas del Ecuador —tributarias, societarias, contables (NIIF), laborales y municipales— contra el corpus normativo de LexIA y la jurisprudencia contencioso-tributaria, y cita siempre la norma, el artículo y la fecha hasta la que llega el texto. No responde de memoria: busca el artículo, lo lee entero y lo transcribe literal, con sus erratas si las tiene. Cuando el corpus no tiene algo, lo dice y señala dónde mirar, en vez de reconstruirlo. Incluye la jurisprudencia de la Corte Nacional —tributaria, laboral, contencioso administrativa, civil, de familia y penal— y de la Corte Constitucional: buscar causas, leer una resolución, ver el expediente de un juicio. Y las consultas vinculantes del SRI con su PDF y su página. Está pensado para un abogado o un contador, que va a contrastar lo que se le diga.

The Shorty plugin lets ChatGPT run that library end-to-end: start a summary from a YouTube link, a web page, pasted text, or a file already uploaded to your account; transcribe a publicly accessible audio or video URL; generate subtitle tracks for a video you provide; then poll the job until it reaches a terminal state and pull the finished article or transcript back into the conversation. Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. You choose which scopes to grant on the consent screen — separate read scopes for articles, transcriptions, jobs, usage and docs, and separate write scopes for creating summaries and transcriptions — and any tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant at all. Consent is re-checked on every individual tool call, so revoking Shorty from Connected AI Apps in Settings stops the assistant immediately rather than at token expiry. Write tools are backed by an idempotency ledger, so a retried request will not create duplicate jobs, and no tool deletes or overwrites work you already have.

Summaries and transcriptions consume your Shorty plan's monthly quota; the assistant can check the remaining balance before starting a long job.

release.description:
Drag is a shared inbox for Gmail teams. The addresses everyone answers, like support@, sales@ and info@, become boards the whole team works together, with assignment, labels, a help center, WhatsApp and response-time reporting. It runs inside Gmail and Google Workspace, so nobody has to learn a new inbox.

Connect Drag to ChatGPT and you can run that team inbox by asking. Triage what arrived overnight, draft a reply grounded in your own help center article, assign a conversation to a teammate, or turn a customer email into a task with a due date.

47 tools across 12 categories, with full read and write access:

Triage: list, search and filter email threads by column, assignee or label, and find what has waited longest for a reply.

Reply: draft and send responses grounded in your own help center articles, and leave internal comments for teammates.

Organize: assign conversations to teammates, add and remove labels and tags, and move threads between columns or boards.

Plan: turn customer emails into task cards with due dates and checklists, and move work across columns as it progresses.

WhatsApp: read conversations and send messages or approved templates alongside email.

Report: first response times, average response time, daily volume and closed-conversation counts.

Setup takes about two minutes: add the plugin, then enter your Drag API key once on a secure connect page. The key never appears in a web address and the connect service stores nothing. ChatGPT inherits your Drag permissions, and every action is attributed to you inside Drag where the whole team can see it. Reading never interrupts you; sending email or WhatsApp always asks first.

Requires a Drag account with API access. Open source, MIT licensed.

release.description:
Algorithmic Ink turns your photos into geometric artwork directly inside ChatGPT. Transform a portrait, pet photo, object or landscape into spiral FM line art, scribble drawings, circle stippling or triangle art, then preview and refine the result in an interactive studio.
Start by attaching a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo to your conversation, or choose a photo through the studio’s file picker. Describe the style you want, select ink and background colors, and adjust the drawing controls to change detail, contrast, line weight and other style-specific settings. Optional background removal isolates the subject; turn it off to preserve the complete scene.
Continue refining your artwork through conversation or the studio’s controls. For example, ask to switch from spiral lines to scribble art, make the lines thinner, or change the colors while keeping the same photo. When the artwork is ready, download an SVG for further editing in compatible design software or a PNG for convenient viewing and sharing.
Image processing and artwork generation run locally in your browser while the studio is open. Algorithmic Ink does not maintain a server-side library of your photos or finished artwork. The ChatGPT integration processes photo references and drawing settings, and shares rendering status, settings and a small artwork preview with ChatGPT to support follow-up requests. Photos selected in the studio are uploaded to ChatGPT when its upload feature is available, and exports may pass through ChatGPT’s download feature. The privacy policy explains these data flows, recipients, retention and user controls.
No separate Algorithmic Ink account is required, and Algorithmic Ink currently charges no usage fee. The app creates artwork from existing photos; it does not generate images from text alone, produce videos, or provide printing and shipping services. Processing speed and download availability depend on your device, browser and ChatGPT’s supported features.

interface.short_description: Workouts, progress and coach

Longevity is a strength-training and longevity app for personal trainers and their clients (iPhone and Android). This plugin gives ChatGPT access to your own Longevity account, with your permission:

- Read your active routine (with this week's progress), your workout history and your progress on any exercise.
- Log a workout: free exercises, or the exercises of your routine with their check mark, for today or up to 7 days back.
- Correct or delete an exercise you logged wrong, on any day of the last year; the app shows it as corrected from your assistant.
- Change your active routine (swap, add, remove exercises) or save a new routine to "My Routines".
- See your habits and mark today's habits as done.
- See your Longevity Score and the recovery data from a wearable you have connected (HRV, sleep, resting heart rate).

Everything runs on your own account: ChatGPT never sees other people's data, never changes payments or passwords, and asks for your confirmation before logging, correcting or deleting anything.

You need a Longevity account to connect. Longevity is fitness training, not medical care.

interface.long_description:
LogMeIn Resolve is a unified endpoint management (UEM) and remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform for IT teams and managed service providers (MSPs). This connector brings your Resolve environment into ChatGPT, so you can ask about your fleet in plain language, connect it with your other tools, and act on the answer in the same place.

What IT teams use it for:

- See the whole estate at once — device health, alerts, and inventory across every account and tenant you manage, instead of clicking through them one by one
- Cut alert noise — review what's firing, spot the pattern, and acknowledge in bulk
- Automate the busywork — run scripts and Remote Execution jobs across the fleet, then check status without opening a separate console
- Move tickets forward — read the queue, draft updates, and open tickets with the right service and priority already set
- Answer hardware and software inventory questions on the spot — what's deployed, where, and on which version
- Capture what you learn — turn a resolved issue into a Knowledge Base article while the detail is still fresh
- Start remote support faster — set up a session and send the invitation without leaving the conversation
- Connect Resolve to your other tools — e.g., “Check this device's alert history in Resolve, then post a summary to our incident channel in Slack.” 

The connector is most valuable where endpoint data meets everything around it: correlating an alert with the ticket it produced, or turning device and ticket history into a report a client can read.

It acts on behalf of the signed-in technician and stays within that user's existing Resolve permissions. Read actions never change data; creates, updates, and session actions are yours to approve.

Requires a LogMeIn Resolve account. Learn more at logmein.com/products/resolve

interface.short_description: Create WordPress sites with AI
interface.long_description:
UiChemy lets you create a website with AI by chatting. Build and edit WordPress-ready sites without starting from a blank page. Describe a business or paste a client brief, and we draft a multi-page site from the UiChemy section library: sitemap, layouts, copy, colours and fonts. The result is a real project in your own UiChemy account that you keep editing on the UiChemy canvas.

What you can do:
- Build a new multi-page site from a brief, with layouts chosen from the UiChemy library and copy written to fit each slot.
- Edit an existing project: palette, fonts, buttons, cards, spacing, headings, body copy, logo, sections and pages.
- Import a site you already have (HTML, CSS and JS, or a zip) into a UiChemy project.
- Run responsive and validation checks before you hand a site over.
- Mark a finished project as exported so the UiChemy WordPress plugin can pull it into Elementor or Gutenberg.

Who it is for: freelancers, agencies and site owners who build on WordPress.

Good to know:
- You sign in with your own UiChemy account. This app only reaches projects in the account you connect, and some accounts need access to creation features before the tools work.
- We ask for your confirmation before anything that deletes a page, section, post or project, and before publishing or unpublishing a site.
- You can publish a finished project as a live site on a UiChemy address, check its status, list your sites and take one offline. It does not connect your own domain, change your hosting or log in to your WordPress site. You can also pull the project into WordPress with the UiChemy WordPress plugin.
- Use your own content and images, or content you have the right to use.

Send a photo of a textbook page or a handwritten word list, attach a document, paste your notes, or just say what you want to practice. You get one short link that opens the quiz in Learn It, where you see every question before you add it.

Learn It is an app for practicing vocabulary and quiz questions on iPhone and iPad, used by more than 300,000 students, most of them in Sweden. Practicing there is different from being asked questions in a chat. For a decade, since 2016, the app has been refined around what you see, hear and feel at every answer: animation, sound and haptic feedback tuned to keep practice short, focused and rewarding. That is particularly helpful for students with learning challenges, who often find it hard to get started and to keep going. You practice with multiple choice, by writing the answers, or with flashcards.

Learn It also keeps track of what you have learned. It keeps a record of every word you practice and uses spaced repetition to show which words are due for review, at growing intervals, so you go back to them before you forget them.

There is no account and nothing to sign in to. On a device without the app, the link shows the quiz on trylearnit.com. Ask for changes at any time and you get a new link.

To make the link, the quiz (its name, questions and answers) is sent to Learn It and stored there under a quiz code, the same way a quiz shared from the app is. Anyone who has the link or the code can open the quiz, so leave personal information out of it. Nothing else from your conversation is sent to Learn It.

interface.short_description: Prop firm rules, with sources
interface.long_description:
Prop Trading Intelligence answers questions about prop trading firms' evaluation rules from a hand-checked dataset. Every rule value comes with a quote from the firm's own website, a link to that page and the date it was verified there.

Use it to:
- see which firms and programmes are covered
- find programmes that meet conditions such as news trading allowed, weekend holding, no consistency rule, a drawdown type, a minimum profit split, no time limit or a fee refund
- look up a programme's evaluation fees by account size, in the currency the firm lists
- read one firm's rules: profit targets, daily and maximum drawdown, time limits, minimum trading days, consistency, payouts and more
- get plain definitions of prop trading rules
- calculate a position size from account size, risk and stop loss, or the gain needed to recover from a drawdown

It is for traders researching prop firm evaluations and anyone learning how prop firm rules work. No sign-in is needed.

Limitations: the dataset covers forex and CFD programmes, and firms are added over time. A rule that has not been verified is reported as not yet verified, which means unknown, not absent. Firms can change their rules between checks, so every value shows its verified date and is flagged once a re-check is due. Fees are never converted between currencies. Results are listed alphabetically and are not a ranking or a recommendation. The plugin does not give trading advice, place trades, access trading accounts or sell anything.

The data is Pipster Research (CC BY 4.0), published by Data Vantix Ltd, which trades as Pipster, a prop firm. Pipster's own programmes are included and are checked by the same method as every other firm's.

release.description:
Insourcia gives your assistant direct access to French company data: 30 million registered entities, 17 million of them active, with 32 million director mandates, 7 million filed annual accounts and 20 million legal events.

The connector covers five things.

Discovery. Search in natural language on sector, geography, size, directors or financial aggregates (revenue, EBITDA, debt, cash, whether a fund sits on the cap table). Match a CRM export or a spreadsheet to the right SIREN numbers in bulk; the tool declines to guess when the identification is ambiguous rather than returning a plausible wrong answer.

Profile. Identity, activity, headcount, directors, industry codes for a single company in one call, plus a directed map of its group: holdings, subsidiaries, sister companies, shared directors.

Financials. Income statement, balance sheet and ratios across consecutive fiscal years (cash, net debt, working capital, margins, payment terms, dividends). Credit risk grade from AAA to D with default probability at 3, 6 and 12 months and the main contributing factors.

Legal monitoring. Business transfers, insolvency proceedings, account filings, capital increases, public procurement awards, subsidies, strike-offs and incorporations, searchable across all companies or as a timeline for one.

Watchlists. Save a search or put a company under watch from the conversation, then read back what changed and mark signals as handled. These objects are the same ones the Insourcia web app uses: whatever your assistant saves, you find in your account.

Data comes from the French public registries (INPI/RNE, INSEE, BODACC, DECP) and sector sources, consolidated and reconciled by us. An Insourcia account is required

release.description: Persistent memory for ChatGPT: remember facts and documents into your Cognee workspace, recall them with graph-aware search, and forget what you no longer need.

interface.short_description: Long-term memory for ChatGPT
interface.long_description:
Cognee gives ChatGPT a memory that lasts beyond one conversation. Everything you ask it to remember goes into your own Cognee Cloud workspace, where it is turned into a knowledge graph: entities, relationships and summaries, not just stored text. Later, in any conversation and from any client connected to the same workspace, ChatGPT can recall it with search that uses that structure, so answers draw on how facts connect rather than on keyword matches alone.

Four tools:
- remember: store text, or a file up to 10 MB, into a dataset. Cognee ingests it, extracts entities and relationships, and builds the graph.
- recall: search your memory with a natural-language question. Cognee routes it to the right retrieval strategy and returns an answer with the supporting memories, or the raw matching passages if you ask for them.
- forget: delete one item, one dataset, or everything you own.
- cognify_status: check on ingestion that was started in the background.

Memories are organised into datasets. By default ChatGPT writes to a dataset of its own, so what ChatGPT remembers stays separate from what your other tools remember, while recall searches across all of them. Name a dataset in the conversation to use a specific one.

You sign in with your Cognee account; no API key is pasted anywhere. Each call runs against your workspace with your own identity and permissions. Workspaces that have been idle go to sleep; the first call after a quiet period wakes one and can take about a minute.

interface.short_description: Build and share forms by chat
interface.long_description:
Formloop is an AI form builder that works inside ChatGPT. Describe what you need to collect, and Formloop builds a complete form with the right question types, required fields, pages and follow-up logic. You watch a live preview fill in as it's written.

Refine it in plain words ("make the phone number optional", "only ask why if they score us 6 or lower"), or open the editor beside the chat to jump to any question, test the form and ask ChatGPT to change exactly that question. Every change is a version you can undo, and edits to a live form stay in a draft until you publish again.

When you're ready, publish to get a share link, a QR code and an embed code. Respondents only need a browser: no account and no ChatGPT. As responses arrive, ask what they say and get real numbers and charts: response counts, completion, NPS and a breakdown for every question. You can also browse responses and download them as CSV in the web dashboard.

Question types: short and long text, email, phone, number, website, date, single and multiple choice, dropdown, yes/no, star rating, opinion scale and Net Promoter Score, plus statements and page breaks. Layouts: step by step, all on one page, or one question at a time.

Privacy: responses reach ChatGPT only when you ask about them, and names, email addresses, phone numbers and links are never sampled into AI summaries. Forms can't ask respondents for passwords, PINs or payment card details.

release.description: Plan structured workouts in conversation, for your athletes or for yourself, then analyse the sessions you completed.

interface.short_description: Plan and analyse your workouts
interface.long_description:
Coach to Wrist is a training platform for structured workouts: sessions are built block by block, run on a smartwatch or phone, and the results come back automatically, planned vs performed.

It works for two kinds of people:
- Coaches plan sessions for the athletes they follow. ChatGPT drafts the workout; the coach saves it to their library or puts it on an athlete's calendar.
- Athletes can also train on their own, with or without a coach: ChatGPT drafts the workout and it goes straight to their own calendar, ready to run.

With this app, ChatGPT can:
- Create workout drafts. Describe a session (running intervals, strength sets, hybrid or ergometer work, rest and loops) and ChatGPT turns it into a structured workout in your account. Nothing is saved until you open the link ChatGPT gives you and confirm the draft in the app; mention a day ("for tomorrow") and the calendar opens on that day.
- Analyse your own training. If you allow it, ChatGPT can read the sessions you completed: planned vs performed per block, heart rate, pace, loads, session RPE and readiness. Use it to spot trends, review a hard week or plan the next one.

Your data stays under your control. ChatGPT only ever reads your own training data, never other athletes' data, even if you are a coach. Reading requires a separate, revocable consent you give when connecting or from your Profile, and every read is logged. Sharing is unavailable to users under 14.

New to Coach to Wrist? Create your account while connecting: choose whether you are a coach or an athlete, and finish your profile later in the app.

release.description:
GitDiagram shows how a public GitHub repository is built. Ask about a repository, for example "Show me the architecture of fastapi/fastapi", and you get its architecture diagram: an interactive map of the main components and how they connect, which you can pan, zoom and open full screen, and where every component opens its source code on GitHub.

With the diagram, ChatGPT also receives GitDiagram's written explanation of how the codebase is organized, the list of components with the paths they live in, how they connect, and the Mermaid source, so it can answer follow-up questions about the code and point you to the right files.

You can also search GitDiagram's library of diagrams by owner or repository name, and get a repository's narrated explainer video and its transcript when one exists.

It's for anyone getting to know an unfamiliar codebase: onboarding to a project, evaluating an open-source dependency, preparing a first contribution, or explaining how a project works.

Limitations: GitDiagram covers public GitHub repositories only. The plugin reads diagrams GitDiagram has already made; when a repository has none yet, it gives you a link to gitdiagram.com, where the diagram is made in about a minute, and after that the plugin can read it. Diagrams are AI-generated from the repository's files and can miss details, so check anything important against the code. The plugin is read-only, never changes anything on GitHub or elsewhere, and needs no account.

release.description: Room layout planner for home redesign, remodel and decorating projects. Plan where furniture goes, check that it fits against clearance rules, and estimate flooring, paint and baseboard.

interface.short_description: Home redesign room planner
interface.long_description:
Plan a room layout for a home redesign, remodel or decorating refresh. Roomwise works out where furniture goes in one room, to scale, then checks the arrangement against clearance rules so you can see whether it will work before you move or buy anything.

What you can ask:
- Furniture layout and floor plan: give the room size, where the doors and windows are, and the furniture you want to use (living room, bedroom, home office or dining room). Roomwise returns each piece's position and facing, and a link to a to-scale plan you can edit on the web by dragging pieces around.
- Will it fit? Give an arrangement you already have, or a sofa, bed or table you are thinking of buying. Roomwise checks walkway width, door swings, sofa-to-coffee-table distance, dining chair pull-back and whether every piece can be reached, with the measured value for each rule.
- Remodel and renovation planning: how much flooring, paint and baseboard a room needs, with waste allowances, and a cost if you supply prices.

Who it is for: homeowners and renters planning a home redesign, a room refresh or a remodel, and anyone working out house decor layouts such as where the sofa, coffee table or dining table should go.

How it works: you describe the room in words and measurements. Roomwise does not need a photo. Results are rules of thumb for comfort and access, so measure twice.

What it does not do: it does not redesign a room from a photo, choose styles, colours or decor, order furniture, or give building-code, structural or safety advice. One rectangular room at a time.

Privacy: saved plans are private links, deleted 90 days after the last edit. No account is needed.

release.description: DFINITY's official ICP ecosystem connector for apps whose operators opt in, with separate Internet Identity user authorization for account access and actions.

interface.short_description: Chat with your ICP apps
interface.long_description:
Internet Computer (ICP) is the official ICP ecosystem connector, provided and hosted by DFINITY Stiftung. Work with participating apps in conversation: discover their services, inspect interfaces and documentation, read public or account-specific data, and request supported non-financial changes.

App operators explicitly opt in. By publishing a valid participation manifest at their app's origin (/.well-known/ic-architecture), they accept the ICP MCP App Operator Terms and declare which canisters belong to the app. The connector retrieves canister metadata and submits queries or updates only to canisters declared in that valid manifest. Removing it ends participation once the connector observes the removal. Operator terms: https://internetcomputer.org/icp-mcp/app-operator-terms/

Users authorize access separately. To act as you or access your account data, connect through Internet Identity and choose the session duration and permission level. Questions only permits reads; Actions & questions also permits supported changes. The connection can be used across participating apps you direct the assistant to, using your app-specific identity and the app's existing access controls. Operator opt-in does not grant access to a user's account.

The connector supports Candid interfaces and calls, efficient OQL queries where apps expose them, and app-specific account and identity lookup. Available data and actions depend on the participating app and your permissions. Financial operations, token transfers, and direct canister funding or deployment are outside this connector's supported functionality.

Finanse to aplikacja do wspólnego budżetu dla osób i rodzin. Jedno połączenie obejmuje wszystkie Twoje projekty budżetowe — możesz zapytać o bieżący albo wskazać inny po nazwie. Zapytaj, na co poszły pieniądze w danym miesiącu, jak wygląda podział na kategorie, czy mieścisz się w budżetach, jak zmieniało się saldo, ile możesz bezpiecznie wydać do końca miesiąca i jakie stałe płatności są przed Tobą — odpowiedzi pojawiają się jako czytelne karty, nie ściany tekstu. Możesz zapisać wydatek lub przychód, kilka naraz albo cały paragon podzielony na kategorie, ustawić płatność cykliczną i śledzić cele oszczędnościowe. Zmiany, usunięcia i paragony zawsze pokazują podgląd do zatwierdzenia, zanim cokolwiek się zmieni. Finanse zapisuje transakcje, które już się wydarzyły — nie przelewa pieniędzy, nie łączy się z bankiem i nie prosi o dane karty.

Finanse is a shared budget app for individuals and families. One connection covers all of your budget projects — ask about the current one or name another. Ask where the money went in a given month, how it split across categories, whether you are inside your budgets, how your balance moved, how much is safe to spend until the month ends and which recurring payments are coming up — answers come back as readable cards rather than walls of text. You can record an expense or income, several at once, or a whole shop receipt split into categories, set up a recurring payment and track savings goals. Edits, deletions and receipts always show a preview you approve before anything changes. Finanse records transactions that already happened: it does not move money, connect to banks, or ask for card details.

Search combines keyword and semantic matching, so an exact string like an error message, a config key or an ID is findable, not just something similar. Notes are encrypted at rest with a per-user key. Sign-in is OAuth, and you can revoke access from your account.

release.description: Email automation for a company's transactional and marketing email: create and send on-brand react.email templates, build event-triggered automations, manage contacts and segments, set up sending, and track delivery, from chat.

interface.short_description: Email templates & automations
interface.long_description:
Send & Retain is an email automation service. It creates, sends and tracks a company's transactional and marketing email — order confirmations, welcome emails, abandoned-cart reminders, win-back campaigns — and this plugin lets you run all of it from a conversation: the templates, the automations that send them, the contacts they go to, and the sending setup behind them.

Stand up a company's programme from its business type: a brand kit, starter templates and the matching automations (welcome, abandoned cart, order updates, win-back), created paused. Write and revise react.email templates in the company's own brand and voice, render them with sample data, and publish when they are right. Design event-triggered automations with delays, send windows, branches and A/B variants, preview every email in an automation, and check what would block it before it goes live. Manage contacts, attributes and segments, read delivery and engagement metrics by template and by day, search the message log, and triage bounces and complaints.

Built for founders, marketers and agencies running email for one company or a portfolio of them.

Safety by design: there is no bulk send. Every message has one recipient, and mail reaches many people only through an automation a person explicitly enabled. Automations are always created paused, and enabling one is a separate, confirmed step. Each company has a send kill switch and an optional daily cap. Bounces and complaints suppress addresses automatically, and complaint suppressions can never be removed. Provider API keys are entered only on the Send & Retain settings page, never in chat.

Limitations: email only (no SMS, push or social posting). Sending needs a connected provider or platform sending and a verified domain, which a person sets up once per company. Connecting requires a Send & Retain account.

interface.short_description: Entreprises, droit, immobilier
interface.long_description:
Pappers donne à ChatGPT accès à la donnée légale française, issue de plus d'une centaine de sources officielles mises à jour quotidiennement.

- Entreprises : recherchez des sociétés par nom ou par critères et consultez leur fiche (SIREN, dirigeants, bénéficiaires effectifs, documents déposés, comptes annuels, cartographie capitalistique).
- Conformité : vérifiez les personnes politiquement exposées (PPE) et les listes de sanctions internationales.
- Justice : explorez la jurisprudence et la législation françaises, et obtenez des notes de recherche juridique sourcées.
- Immobilier : interrogez les données cadastrales et immobilières (parcelles, propriétaires, ventes, bâtiments, diagnostics de performance énergétique).
- Politique : suivez l'activité parlementaire française et européenne (parlementaires, votes, amendements, projets de loi) et les documents des collectivités locales.

Conçu pour l'analyse financière, le screening commercial, l'investissement et le M&A, la conformité et la due diligence (KYC, KYB, LCB-FT), la recherche juridique, l'immobilier, la veille territoriale et les affaires publiques, le tout depuis un seul connecteur.

Limites : la couverture se limite aux entités françaises et aux registres publics français et européens. Un compte Pappers est requis et l'accès aux bénéficiaires effectifs nécessite une habilitation (intérêt légitime). Le plugin lit uniquement des données : il ne peut ni effectuer de formalités, ni modifier les registres, ni accéder à des informations privées comme les comptes bancaires. Les résultats sont fournis à titre informatif et ne constituent pas un conseil juridique, financier ou de crédit.

release.display_name: TTS Studio: AI Text to Speech
release.description:
TTSStudio is an AI text-to-speech generator and AI voice generator that converts user-provided written text into natural-sounding MP3 speech. It gives ChatGPT users an interactive workspace for turning scripts, articles, documents, lessons, stories, notes, and other written content into clear spoken audio without recording a voice manually. Use TTSStudio to create narration, AI voiceovers, read-aloud audio, podcast segments, audiobook passages, e-learning lessons, training materials, presentation audio, social media voice tracks, advertising voiceovers, and accessible audio versions of written content.
When a user asks ChatGPT to turn text into speech, TTSStudio opens the workspace with the supplied text prefilled. The user can review the source text, choose how it should sound, and start generation only when ready. The voice catalog can be browsed and filtered to find an appropriate AI voice for the language, style, audience, and use case. Users can preview voices, compare available options, and refine the delivery by adjusting emotion, speed, pitch, and volume before generating the final audio.
Each generation uses the applicable TTSStudio allowance and saves the result to the user's private audio history. The workspace can display recent completed or failed generations, replay completed speech, manage saved history items, delete a selected result, and show the download actions available for the user's plan. This makes it easier to return to previous voiceovers, review alternative versions, and keep generated audio organized.
TTSStudio focuses specifically on text-to-speech generation from text supplied by the user. By keeping text review, AI voice selection, speech customization, generation, playback, history, and downloads in one workflow, TTSStudio helps users convert written ideas into reusable spoken audio directly from ChatGPT.

interface.short_description: CFO peer answers & vendors
interface.long_description:
The F Suite is a members-only community of CFOs and their finance teams. Floyd brings the community's collective experience and knowledge into ChatGPT and Codex, so finance leaders can see what peers at comparable companies and in similar situations actually did before making a decision.

Floyd has two read-only tools:

get_peer_insights answers questions of practice and judgment: how CFOs structure a board package, what a normal burn multiple looks like at Series B, how teams handled a covenant breach or a restatement. It draws on 2,800+ discussion threads across eight CFO peer networks, shared models and templates, and F Suite event recordings.

find_vendors names specific software vendors; audit, accounting, and tax firms; service providers; and individual practitioners. Its recommendations come from 6,000+ peer mentions rather than analyst grids or vendor marketing.

Every response includes inline citations linking back to the original F Suite discussion threads, documents, events, and recordings, so answers can be checked at the source.

Floyd is called only when it is relevant to the question at hand; nothing is pushed into the conversation. Access requires an active F Suite membership. Every member connects to the same server URL and signs in with their F Suite account over OAuth 2.0, and each member's answers are scoped to the peer networks they belong to.

release.description:
Revenue Analytics by DataLabs.store connects your HubSpot data to ChatGPT. It continuously replicates your portal (custom objects, deals, contacts, companies, line items, engagements, email events) into a real relational Microsoft SQL Server database whose schema matches your portal, then lets ChatGPT query it in plain English and return answers backed by the exact SQL that produced them.

Why it exists
HubSpot is built to run your CRM at scale, and its reporting tools are genuinely good at what they were designed for. The limit is structural: standard reports are built one object at a time, so questions that need several tables joined together before the math even starts do not fit. Per-deal margin (deals joined to their line items), multi-hop paths (deal to contact to company to source), correctly weighted stats (SUM(clicks)/SUM(delivered), not an average of averages), cohorts, and window functions all need a real database underneath. That is the job this fills.

What you can ask
- "Rank owners by weighted pipeline (each deal's amount times its real stage odds) and their historical win rate."
- "Unique click-through rate by acquisition source, weighted by delivered volume, for contacts who became customers."
- "Which deals are aging past 90 days, and where does our ARR actually concentrate?"
Then keep drilling: "now split by pipeline... now only Q2... now show the trend."

What makes it different
- Real joins across any objects, expressed as one query.
- Every answer is auditable: the exact SQL ships with the number, so you can verify and reproduce it.
- You bring the model: full frontier ChatGPT reasoning runs over your own data.
- Complementary to HubSpot's own AI. Breeze works inside the CRM; this understands the data behind it.

A note on sensitive data
This app's HubSpot integration requests only standard, non-sensitive OAuth read scopes for CRM analytics. It does not request HubSpot's sensitive scope grants (for example, crm.objects.contacts.sensitive.read). Because HubSpot enforces this at the API level, any property a customer has explicitly marked as a "sensitive data" property inside their own HubSpot account is withheld by HubSpot and never delivered to our sync process. It cannot enter the customer's synced database, and therefore cannot be returned by any of this MCP's tools, regardless of the query executed.

skills.name: simulator-agents
skills.description: Simulator.Company digital-twin & actor-agent specialist — talk to an agent AS an agent and delegate work to it. An agent is ANY actor whose `description` holds an "# Agent" competency profile (what it does, what it knows, whether it fits a task). The common case is a person: every workspace user has a 1:1 twin actor (`systemObjType="user"`) carrying that profile. But any actor can be an agent — a service/bot twin, a team or department, an organization, a process. This skill discovers the agent (`findAgent`), loads its profile (`getAgent`), adopts it as the persona, then either does the task, finds a better-suited agent, or hands the decision to the user (for a person: a task or a p2p message; for a non-person: propose another executor or run/trigger it as an actor). release.description:
firmenliste.net gives you live access to B2B company address data for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland — about 12.5 million records across 6,400+ industry lists, maintained by Adresskontor GmbH, a German address publisher with 20+ years in the business.

Ask in plain language and get real numbers, not estimates: how many dental practices in Bavaria have an email address, what a list of freight forwarders in Hamburg costs, or how many pharmacies are within 50 km of a postcode. Every answer comes live from the same systems that power our shop.

What you can do:
- Search 6,400+ industry lists by keyword and compare size, field coverage (email, phone, website, contact person), and price
- Get exact record counts and prices for complete lists, email-only packages, per-state packages, and postcode-radius selections (1–200 km)
- Look up the machine-readable purchase and usage terms before you buy

The app is purely informational and read-only. It never sells anything and never completes a purchase: ordering, payment and delivery happen exclusively on firmenliste.net. Data there is delivered as CSV/XLSX download after payment. Prices are net, plus German VAT. B2B only.

release.description: The Heimster Pro workspace for Swiss real-estate agencies: listings, applications, viewings, owners, CRM and investment properties – within your organisation and role.

interface.short_description: Workspace for estate agents
interface.long_description:
Heimster Pro is the workspace of Swiss real-estate agencies – properties, listings, applications, viewings, CRM contacts, owners, new-build projects and investment properties. This app lets agents work with it in plain language, inside their own organisation and with their own permissions.

What you can ask:
• Daily work: "What's on today?", "Which listings need attention?", "Which e-mails still need a reply?"
• Lettings: rank the applicants for a flat by the Heimster score, check what is missing in a dossier, see where decisions are pending.
• Sales: the evidence-based selling points of a property, interested parties ranked by fit, the anonymous network demand.
• Owners: which owners to call this week (ready to sell, mandates ending, follow-ups due), owner reports and recurring report subscriptions.
• Investment properties: yield figures from the rent roll, the bidding process, the investor funnel and matching investors from the CRM.
• Marketing: social-post drafts from verified facts, mailing audiences with consent check, exposé dispatch plans, portal export preview and sync health.
• CRM: create and update contacts, log activities and follow-ups, draft e-mails into Outlook.

Safety built in: only members of a Heimster Pro organisation can connect, and the assistant acts within the signed-in user's organisation and role (read-only users can't change anything). E-mails, mailings and social posts are saved as drafts. Anything with an effect outside the organisation – price changes, owner reports, pre-market alerts, calendar invitations, applicant notifications, new viewings, publishing a listing – first returns a preview and only runs after an explicit confirmation.

Details and the full tool list: heimster.ch/developers/pro-ai. Privacy: heimster.ch/privacy#ki-assistenten-pro

release.description: Passive website security check for any domain: security headers, HTTPS and TLS, DNS, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), in seconds.

interface.short_description: Website security check
interface.long_description:
Ask whether a website is set up securely and get an answer in seconds. AttackerView checks a domain's security headers and Content Security Policy, clickjacking protection, the HTTP to HTTPS redirect, TLS configuration, DNS, DNSSEC and CAA records, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS). Each problem comes with its severity, the evidence observed and how to fix it.

For developers, founders and IT teams who want a quick read on a site's configuration, their own or one they depend on.

The check is passive: one request to the homepage plus public DNS and TLS lookups. It does not log in, crawl or send attacks, so it cannot find vulnerabilities in the application itself. No account is needed.

release.description: Interact with your Deltek ERP system through Dela.

interface.short_description: Industry-tuned AI for projects
interface.long_description:
Dela Powers your business with industry-tuned AI to accelerate successful outcomes with speed, clarity and control.

Project-based work is complex — deadlines shift, risks emerge, and manual tasks slow teams down. Deltek Dela is our AI orchestration layer, purpose-built to bring speed, clarity, and control across the entire project lifecycle: winning work, planning, execution, and analysis.

Dela embeds industry-tuned intelligence directly into the workflows project teams already use, working across a coordinated set of AI capabilities designed to surface risk earlier, cut manual effort, and keep teams focused on decisions that need human judgment.

Dela combines predictive machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI to deliver four core outcomes:
· Generate & automate content — turning project data into concise, decision-ready summaries.
· Enable intelligent exploration — ask questions in natural language and get answers or actions back through an AI-powered assistant.
· Predict outcomes — using historical performance and resource data to flag risk before it compounds.
· Streamline execution — automating repetitive work like timesheet entry, expense creation, and record generation.

Dela isn't a single application — it's an umbrella of AI-embedded capabilities across Deltek's industry-specific solutions, expanding with future releases. Available Dela features depend on which Deltek products a team uses today.

Security and trust are foundational, not an afterthought. Dela-enabled features are opt-in, we partner only with AI providers who commit to not training on customer data, and every integration is vetted against Deltek's security standards before release.

For government contractors, architecture and engineering firms, consultancies, and other project-based organizations, Dela is how AI becomes practical — embedded where the work happens, tuned to the industry, built to protect margin, timeline, and trust.
