interface.short_description: Word game solver & unscrambler
interface.long_description:
LetterLab Word Solver is a word game helper: it unscrambles letters, fills in crossword patterns and narrows down answers in 5-letter guessing games. It looks answers up in a real English dictionary (the ENABLE word list, 172,569 words, with slurs and obscenities removed), so every result is a real word from that list.

Unscramble: type your letters, with ? or * for blank tiles, and see the words you can make, grouped by length with counts and tile points (standard letter values, blanks score 0). Filter by exact length, minimum length, use all letters, starts with, ends with, or contains. Words that use all your tiles are called out.

Crossword and pattern search: type the letters you know and ? for each unknown one (C?T, _A_E_, ??ANGE), or * for any run of letters (S*ING). Add letters that must appear or must not appear. Common words are listed first, then rarer ones.

5-letter guessing games: enter your guesses and the green, yellow and gray feedback (G, Y and - or colored squares). The solver applies the repeated-letter rules, counts and lists the words that still fit, and ranks next guesses by expected information, with the average and worst-case number of words left. Hard mode and 4- to 8-letter variants are supported.

The interactive card shows your letter tiles, word groups with counts you can filter by length, a pattern search, and a tap-to-color guess grid that re-solves as you play.

Limitations: English words from the ENABLE list only (no proper nouns, abbreviations or one-letter words, and some newer words are missing); tile points are face values without board bonuses; it does not define words, solve clues by meaning, or know any game's daily answer.

아모레퍼시픽이 만든 라이프 뷰티 쇼핑몰, 아모레몰과 함께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요.

1. 아모레퍼시픽 브랜드 직영 쇼핑과 신뢰할 수 있는 배송
설화수, 헤라, 이니스프리, 에뛰드 등 아모레퍼시픽의 모든 브랜드를 가장 빠르게 만나보세요. 본사 직영 공식몰로서 100% 정품 보장은 물론, 신상품 단독 혜택과 안전한 직배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 본사가 직접 보증하는 신뢰도 높은 쇼핑 환경에서 안심하고 제품을 선택할 수 있습니다.

2. 풍성한 쇼핑 지원과 차별화된 멤버십 플러스
매월 업데이트되는 등급별 할인 쿠폰과 무료 배송/반품 서비스로 스마트한 소비를 도와드립니다. 특히 가입비 이상의 포인트 페이백과 프리미엄 사은품, 기프트카드를 제공하는 '멤버십플러스'를 통해 압도적인 체감 혜택을 누릴 수 있습니다. 활동할수록 높아지는 쇼핑 등급에 따라 제공되는 프리미엄 라운지 경품 등 다채로운 혜택을 경험해 보세요.

3. 스킨노트와 뷰티피드로 완성하는 맞춤형 피부 관리
단순한 구매를 넘어 개인화된 뷰티 루틴을 지원합니다. '스킨노트' 기능을 통해 매일의 피부 변화와 스킨케어 습관을 기록하고 관리할 수 있습니다. 또한, '뷰티피드'에서는 나와 같은 피부 고민을 가진 실사용자들의 진솔한 리뷰와 전문 에디터의 큐레이션 콘텐츠를 통해 나에게 꼭 맞는 최적의 솔루션을 발견할 수 있습니다.

4. 지속 가능한 뷰티를 위한 리사이클 캠페인
온라인으로 간편하게 참여하는 '아모레리사이클'을 통해 다 사용한 화장품 용기를 수거하고 플라스틱 재활용에 동참할 수 있습니다. 환경을 생각하는 작은 실천으로 나만의 디지털 숲을 가꾸며 건강한 뷰티 라이프를 완성해 보세요.

release.description:
Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) brings the ancient Korean art of Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) to ChatGPT, powered by proprietary AI trained with over 20 master fortune tellers from Seoul's most prestigious districts.

Simply share your birth date, time, and gender, and instantly receive a professionally analyzed birth chart — including your Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements distribution, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual Fortune forecasts (세운), all visualized in a clean, interactive card.

Trusted by over 1 million monthly users, Saju DoctorFortune is the world's leading AI-powered Saju service. Every reading is grounded in authentic Myeongrihak (명리학) principles, delivering the same depth and accuracy you'd expect from a top-tier in-person consultation — but available anytime, right inside your conversation.

Whether you're curious about career timing, relationship compatibility, or what the year ahead holds, ask ChatGPT with Saju DoctorFortune and get clear, honest insights rooted in centuries of Korean fortune-telling tradition.

release.description:
K-Fortune brings Korea's traditional Four Pillars (Saju) system to ChatGPT — built by the team behind the #1 Saju custom GPT on the GPT Store, used by over 4 million people.

Enter your birth date, time, and birth city — searchable from 160,000+ cities worldwide in any language — and instantly receive your full chart in a clean interactive card: Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements balance, Ten Gods, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual & Monthly Fortune.

What sets K-Fortune apart is True Solar Time correction: your Hour Pillar is calculated from the sun's actual position at your birthplace, not standard clock time — the method traditionally regarded as the most rigorous in Myeongrihak (명리학). Solar-term boundaries are resolved to the exact minute, so charts born near a seasonal transition stay accurate.

Explore your elemental balance, personality patterns, career and relationship themes, or the year ahead — as a framework for self-reflection rooted in centuries of Korean tradition. K-Fortune is a personal reflection app.

release.description:
특정 날짜의 스포츠 경기 데이터를 인터랙티브 위젯으로 즉시 불러와 제공하는 서비스입니다. 정확한 스포츠 데이터에 기반한 할루시네이션 없는 답변을 보장합니다. 오직 정확한 데이터에 기반한 답변만을 제공받게 되며, 이를 통해 ChatGPT와 본 서비스에 대해 더 높은 신뢰를 가질 수 있습니다.
현재 야구, 농구, 축구, 배구 데이터를 제공하며 확대 예정입니다.

1. 할루시네이션 방지 및 신뢰도 향상: 실시간 데이터를 직접 참조하여 정확한 답변을 생성합니다. 근거 없는 정보가 아닌, 팩트에 기반한 고품질의 응답을 경험할 수 있습니다.
2. 데이터 기반의 심층 추론 제공: 단순한 스코어 전달을 넘어 실시간 경기 상황, 팀 간 전력 비교, 선수별 세부 스탯 등 풍부한 데이터를 바탕으로 사용자에게 한 차원 높은 분석을 제공합니다.
3. 인터랙티브 위젯 연동: 각 스포츠 경기 데이터를 시각적 위젯으로 가져와, 텍스트만으로는 전달하기 힘든 복잡한 스포츠 정보를 직관적으로 확인하게 합니다.

이 앱은 다음과 같은 사용자에게 특히 유용합니다.

• 글로벌 마켓플레이스 입점을 준비하는 셀러와 브랜드
• Amazon·Qoo10·Shopee·TikTok Shop 운영 실무를 고민하는 판매자
• 쇼핑몰 운영 효율과 자동화를 고민하는 이커머스 실무자
• 상세페이지와 콘텐츠 제작 시간을 줄이고 싶은 운영팀
• AI 기반 마케팅과 운영 시스템을 도입하려는 기업
• 글로벌 판매와 크로스보더 운영을 체계화하려는 사업자

Commerce Studio의 목표는 단순한 대화가 아니라, 실제로 성장 가능한 커머스 운영 시스템과 실행 전략을 만드는 것입니다.

release.description:
Realistimo (Реалистимо) helps you find real property listings in Bulgaria — apartments, houses, offices, and more — directly in ChatGPT.

Describe what you're looking for in English or Bulgarian (city, neighborhood, budget, sale or rent). The app shows interactive maps with neighborhoods, photos, prices in euros, and links to the full listings on Realistimo.

Good for: 
• Searching for houses and apartments for sale or rent in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora and other cities; 
• Filtering by location and deal type (sale / rent); 
• Viewing details and opening the listing on Realistimo for more information.

Data comes from public listings on realistimo.com. The app does not show broker phone numbers or personal contact details — use the official listing page on Realistimo to get in touch.

release.description:
Search Gmarket, one of Korea's largest online marketplaces, right inside ChatGPT. Ask the way you normally would, such as "recommend a birthday gift for my girlfriend", "a wireless mouse under 30,000 won", or "iPhone 16 case", and compare the matching products in a swipeable card view with images, prices, discounts, star ratings, review counts, seller, and shipping details.

Refine as you chat. Search again with more specific keywords, set a price range, or ask to compare a few alternatives and get a separate set of results for each. Each search shows up to 10 products, and the "전체보기" (View all) link on the cards takes you to the full results on Gmarket. When you find the right one, tap the card to complete your purchase on Gmarket.

Gmarket offers a wide selection across fashion, beauty, home appliances, electronics, groceries, home & living, and more.

release.description:
サブスクラインは、LINEを活用したマーケティングCRMです。本コネクターを使うと、ChatGPTから自社のサブスクラインのデータを安全に参照し、各種設定や配信を「下書き・無効状態」で作成できます。

■ 参照（read）
・ユーザーグループ（配信セグメント）の一覧
・顧客基盤の概況（LINE友だち数・ブロック数、サブスク契約の継続/解約、直近の予約・来店）
・課金まわりの情報（販売中プラン、トライアル設定、支払い方法の区分）
・配信の下書き一覧／下書き詳細、送信済み配信の実績レポート（送信対象数・開封・タップ・各率）

■ 作成（write）※すべて安全な状態（下書き／無効／非公開）で新規作成します。既存データの更新・削除や、即時配信・即時公開は行いません。
・セグメント配信／ステップ配信の下書き
・ユーザーグループ（全員対象・条件付き）
・キーワード自動応答
・クーポン
・プラン
・リッチメニューの下書き

作成した内容は管理画面で確認し、人が有効化・公開・配信します。AIがLINEへ直接配信したり、設定を即時公開することはありません。

■ 安全性
・各接続は1つのテナント（契約ワークスペース）に固定。接続先はアクセストークンから決まり、AIクライアント側から変更できないため、テナント越境は起きません。
・認証はOAuth 2.1（PKCE／動的クライアント登録）。スコープ（read／write）はツール単位で制御。
・すべてのツール呼び出しは監査ログに記録。本コネクター経由で取得したデータを当社AIモデルの学習に使用しません。

対象：サブスクラインをご利用中の店舗・事業者さま。

Yuqi Video Home Tour helps you explore new construction homes across Southern California — including Irvine, Chino, Chino Hills, Ontario, Eastvale, Fontana and more — right inside ChatGPT.

release.description:
uNotes is a study library of university course materials — past exams, assignments, lab reports and lecture notes, organized by school and course. The uNotes plugin gives ChatGPT read access to that library and to the user's own study data: it can search the library, open a document and read its full text, list the user's flashcard decks and quizzes, look up their study streak, check how much of their monthly quota is left, and list the schools and courses they follow.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin exposes eight tools, all declared readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true, and none of them create, edit or delete anything in a uNotes account. Typical use is asking a question about material the user already has — "what do my Biology notes say about cell structure", "which courses am I following", "how long is my study streak" — and letting ChatGPT pull the answer out of the underlying documents.

Access is authorized with OAuth 2.1: PKCE (S256) with dynamic client registration, an explicit consent screen, and seven granular read scopes (search, documents, flashcards, quizzes, study, profile, library) plus offline_access. Tools are registered per request against the scopes the token actually carries, so a grant that omits a scope makes the matching tools invisible rather than merely blocked. Requests are rate-limited per user, and tools never accept a user identifier as input — every call is scoped to the authenticated account's own data.

release.description:
CNA provides a trusted, source-based news search and research service that allows users to search Central News Agency reporting directly within ChatGPT, stay informed about recent developments, and organize the evolving context surrounding specific people, events, and public issues.

Using natural language, users can search CNA news reports as well as content from CNA almanac, special features, and multilingual news coverage in English, Japanese, Indonesian, and other languages. The service also supports searches for standardized translations of foreign names and proper nouns, news photographs, government information, and fact-checking materials, helping users compare information across multiple sources and clarify uncertain claims. It can also organize retrieved information into event timelines, concise topic briefs, newspaper-style layouts, and relationship maps of people and organizations. These capabilities are suitable for news research, event retrospectives, issue tracking, information verification, content planning, and background research.

Responses preserve news headlines, publication dates, source information, and links to original articles whenever possible, allowing users to review the original reporting and conduct further verification. Some search results may come from government agencies, fact-checking organizations, contributed content, or other image sources; the system identifies their origins where available. The use and licensing of images remain subject to the terms, copyright requirements, and other applicable rules of their original sources.

release.description:
헤이유미(HeyYumi)는 한국의 맛집·식당·카페·바를 찾아 추천하고, ChatGPT 대화 안에서 식당 예약·레스토랑 예약까지 바로 이어주는 플러그인입니다. "강남 맛집 추천해줘", "성수동 조용한 카페", "저녁 7시 3명 예약되는 한식당"처럼 물어보면 됩니다. 서울·경기·부산·제주 42만 곳이 넘는 검증된 매장 데이터(교차 확인·신뢰도 점수)로 지어낸 답 대신 실제 영업시간·메뉴·가격·주차·분위기·비건·영어 응대 등 40가지가 넘는 조건으로 좁힙니다. 유미 파트너 매장이면 전화나 외부 링크 없이 채팅에서 예약을 요청하고, 사장님 승인 후 확정까지 받을 수 있습니다. 지금 그게 되는지도 사장님에게 바로 물어봐 드립니다. 고깃집에 삼겹살이 아직 남았는지, 카페에 두바이 쫀득 쿠키가 지금 있는지, 웨이팅이 얼마나 되는지, 10명이 바로 앉을 수 있는지를 실시간으로 확인해 답을 가져다줍니다. 한국 사람도, 한국에 놀러 온 외국인도 똑같이 쓸 수 있습니다.

HeyYumi helps you find where to eat, drink, or go out in Korea and book a table without leaving the chat — perfect for both Korean locals and visitors to Korea. Ask things like "best restaurants in Seoul," "quiet cafe near Hongdae with wifi," or "book a Korean BBQ place in Gangnam for 4 tonight." Every venue — restaurants, cafes, bakeries, dessert shops, and bars — comes from Yumi's refined, cross-verified dataset (420,000+ places, strongest in Seoul, Gyeonggi, Busan and Jeju), each with a confidence score and a last-checked date instead of a guess. Filter by neighborhood, subway station, landmark, cuisine, price, atmosphere, parking, pet-friendly, private room, vegan options, English-speaking staff, open-now, and more. At Yumi partner venues you can send a real restaurant reservation request to the owner right inside ChatGPT and get a confirmed or declined answer back — no phone call, no external booking site. You can also ask the owner about right-now availability: whether a BBQ spot still has pork belly, whether a cafe still has today's special cookie, how long the current wait is, or whether a party of 10 can be seated — the owner answers on the spot.

interface.short_description: Find & book Korean restaurants

release.description:
Sales tells you what happened. Bikky tells you why.

Bikky is the customer data platform built exclusively for multi-unit restaurants. It brings your POS, online ordering, and loyalty data together into guest profiles, so you can see how every marketing, menu, and operational decision lands with your guests.

This plugin brings that data into ChatGPT. Ask a question the way you would ask an analyst, and get an answer from your own brand's data—no spreadsheets, dashboards, or filters required.

Ask about sales, average check, and traffic by daypart or by store. Ask which menu items drive attachment and which cannibalize. Ask how many new guests an LTO brought in and how many came back. Ask which stores are gaining guests and which are losing them, or how a loyalty segment is trending. Before it answers, the plugin confirms the exact names of your menu items, locations, promotions, and segments, so the answer matches how your brand reports.

Everything is read-only. The plugin reaches only the businesses your Bikky account already has access to, and only where Bikky has enabled it. It cannot create, change, or delete anything.

Labor and weather data are not available.

You need a Bikky account to use it. Setup takes about two minutes.

release.description:
Orkasa is the CRM that real-estate agencies in Latin America run on: client files, property portfolio, viewings, offers and documents in one place.

This connector lets the broker ask about their own work, in their own words. «How is Mrs Herrera's file going?» returns the whole dossier — her operations and the stage each one is at, the property, the viewings, the offers, the documents and the latest messages — plus the next step Orkasa's Copilot recommends, and why. «What do I have today?» returns those steps in order: what is waiting on the agent first, and among those the most overdue. It also searches the portfolio by area, type, price and bedrooms, and reads the viewing schedule.

Four tools write: create a client, book a viewing, move an operation to the next stage, and record an offer. They respect the same locks as the app: an operation does not advance while its stage is still missing documents, and in that case the connector returns the list of what is missing instead of forcing the step. Publishing listings, generating mandates and sending documents for signature do not go through the connector.

The broker authorises specific permissions («see your leads», «book viewings»), sees which domain their data will be sent to before accepting, and can cut the access off from Settings › Connections. The assistant only sees what that user sees inside Orkasa: if they cannot see the rest of the office's clients in the app, they cannot see them here either.

Requires an Orkasa account attached to an agency.

release.description:
Find Japanese grants and public support programs using official data published by government agencies.

Rather than simply listing programs, this app compares public company information with program requirements and clearly separates confirmed matches, possible mismatches, missing information, and official sources. This helps users understand why a program may be relevant and what still needs to be verified.

The app can be used by business owners and project leaders researching support for their own organizations, as well as by professional advisors researching programs for their clients or preparing for consultations.

When useful, it can also reference public corporate information and historical selection statistics, and organize unresolved questions into a consultation brief for a qualified professional.

Results are provided for research and decision support only. They do not guarantee eligibility, selection, funding amounts, or legal compliance. Before applying, always confirm the latest official guidelines and information published by the administering organization.

Primary official sources
- J-Grants
- gBizINFO
- National Tax Agency Corporate Number System
- Financial Services Agency EDINET

release.description:
Chashmalink answers questions about Israeli household electricity from measured smart-meter data rather than estimates off a bill.

Behind it sits an analysed corpus of more than 20,000 Israeli households across 500+ municipalities, each a full hourly export from Israel Electric Corporation — up to 17,520 meter readings per home. That is what lets these tools answer with a number rather than a rule of thumb.

Ten read-only tools:

• compare_electricity_plans — rank every plan on the Israeli market by what it would save a specific household, per month and per year. Takes a monthly kWh figure or, far better, a 24-hour load curve.

• simulate_solar_tracks — price Israel's two mutually exclusive rooftop solar tracks against a real load shape, with payback and a recommendation. Which one pays more depends on WHEN a household consumes — the thing a roof-area calculator cannot see.

• get_city_consumption_benchmark — median monthly consumption, profile mix and 24-hour curve for a given Israeli city.

• get_national_load_curve — national demand by hour, day of week and season.

• classify_consumption_profile — classify a home as evening, night, morning, weekend or balanced, with peakiness and a night-shift opportunity figure.

• estimate_appliance_cost, size_air_conditioner, compare_ev_running_cost — running costs for appliances, air conditioning and electric cars at the current tariff.

• get_supplier_directory — every supplier and plan with its discount structure.

• how_to_export_my_iec_data — how a household downloads its own consumption file.

Privacy: no per-household data is reachable here. Every figure is either computed from the caller's own inputs or is a population aggregate published only where at least 25 analysed households sit behind it; a thinner cohort is refused rather than answered thinly. Nothing here writes, submits or contacts anyone.

Free, no account, no API key. Figures are in shekels and kWh.

When people ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google's AI for a recommendation, is your brand in the answer? Mencoro tracks the questions and keywords that matter to you across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Google Search and Google Shopping, in the countries you choose. It shows how often you are mentioned, in what position and tone, which competitors appear alongside you, and which websites the answers cite.

Connect Mencoro to ChatGPT and ask in plain language: how your share of voice changed this month, where a competitor overtook you, which negative mentions to look at, or which sites to get published on. Get a visibility report, check whether a campaign or new page moved the needle, and find what to improve next.

It can also run your monitoring for you: set up a project from your website, add competitors and prompts worth tracking, organize topics, and tune how often queries are checked. Anything that deletes data, spends checks or changes your organization is shown to you first and happens only after you confirm.

Requires a Mencoro account (mencoro.com).

release.description:
Understanding what your school district actually spends money on usually means digging through PDFs and state portals. USAFacts Spending Explorer puts that information in one place, right inside ChatGPT.

Ask specific questions: how much goes to instruction versus administration, how per-student spending compares to a nearby district, or how funding for a particular program has changed over time. USAFacts Spending Explorer gives clear answers alongside an interactive chart — select any category to see its exact share and click to dig even deeper. On the other side, explore how revenue is generated from a mix of state and local taxes, federal sources, and more. 

Then, ask a follow-up the same way you'd ask a person: “What about last year?” or “How does that compare to Dallas?” You'll still get a sourced answer, paired with USAFacts' way of turning complex government finance data into something easy to follow.

Try:
- "What does Los Angeles Unified spend the most money on?”
- "Is Austin ISD's spending going up or down?”
- "How does Austin ISD compare to Dallas ISD?"

This is a beta. To start, it covers school districts in Texas and California, but it won't stay that way for long. We're expanding to more states and adding new ways to explore the data with every update. Follow our progress here: https://usafacts.org/spending-explorer/

release.description:
TypedHand writes text out in your own handwriting.

You fill in one printed template sheet by hand, photograph it, and TypedHand
turns your letters into a font that is genuinely yours — the same hand, with
natural variation from letter to letter, not a traced imitation.

With this plugin, anything you have just worked out in ChatGPT can go straight
onto that page. Ask for a thank-you note, a summary, a worked maths solution or
a set of revision notes, then ask for it in your handwriting. TypedHand hands
you a link. Open it and the text is already there, written in your own hand, in
the TypedHand editor — where you can change any of it and export it as a PDF or
as a GoodNotes file for an iPad.

Maths is written out properly: paste or ask for LaTeX and the fractions, roots,
integrals and tall brackets are laid out as a handwritten worksheet rather than
squeezed into a line of plain text.

TypedHand is also for people who find writing by hand hard — with dysgraphia or
RSI, for example — and who still want a page in their own hand.

Opening the link requires a free TypedHand account, which you must be 16 or
older to create, and a handwriting font of your own. The plugin itself needs no
account and no sign-in.

release.description:

release.description:
LetterScript reads the documents in a California residential real-estate transaction and turns them into facts you can ask about: the transaction record with the page each value came from, contingency and closing dates derived from the executed contract, the point-of-sale disclosures the property's address triggers, and which of them you have already collected.

Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own deals without you opening the file. Ask what a contingency date is and where it came from. Ask which disclosures Berkeley requires for a specific address. Search the deal's documents and get an answer with the document and page cited.

This plugin is read-only. It cannot send email, edit a date, upload or delete a document, or move money. It reaches only the transactions you select when you connect it, and only for as long as you leave it connected.

Values are extracted or derived by AI and can be wrong or incomplete. Confirm every date and figure against the executed documents before you rely on it. Not legal advice.

LetterScript covers all 58 California counties. A LetterScript account is required.

Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own deals without you opening the file. Ask what a contingency date is and where it came from. Ask which disclosures Berkeley requires for a specific address. Search the deal's documents and get an answer with the document and page cited.

This plugin is read-only. It cannot send email, edit a date, upload or delete a document, or move money. It reaches only the transactions you select when you connect it, and only for as long as you leave it connected.

Values are extracted or derived by AI and can be wrong or incomplete. Confirm every date and figure against the executed documents before you rely on it. Not legal advice.

LetterScript covers all 58 California counties. A LetterScript account is required.

release.description:
Pick a target LSAT score by guessing, and you find out what the school's last class scored after you've applied.

Ask this connector what a law school's class scored and you get the 25th, median, and 75th percentile LSAT and GPA, for 196 schools, with the source next to each number. Ask what the school costs and you get its ABA 509 numbers: acceptance rate, tuition, the share of students who got a grant, the median grant, and the first-time bar passage rate, each with the year it was filed. Give it your LSAT score and it lists the schools where that score sits at or above the 75th percentile, the median, or the 25th percentile.

Ask when the next LSAT is and you get the next 3 test dates, the registration deadline for each, and the day scores come out, all checked against LSAC. Ask what's on the test and you get the current format. Logic Games came off the LSAT in August 2024, and prep books written before then still teach it.

You can also ask if there's a free explanation for a specific LSAT question. If there is, you get the answer, a short version of our reasoning, and the link to the full walkthrough. If there isn't, you get the closest ones that exist. For practice, it links a free drill by question type or Reading Comprehension passage topic.

Ask about our prep and it'll tell you what each package includes and which one fits your test date and your score gap.

I'm Steve Schwartz. I've been coaching the LSAT since 2005, and LSAT Unplugged is me plus a team of coaches.

It won't guess your admission odds, register you for the test, quote our prices, sell you anything inside the chat, or show LSAT question text.

release.description:
PadelTrue gives you the published specifications of padel rackets, each with the page it was read from and the wording used there, so you can check a claim before you buy.

Ask it to find a racket by name, to shortlist rackets by an explicit budget and priority, or to compare two exact models and years. Shortlists state the filters and ordering rule. Individual records and comparisons show the published evidence and the limits of calculated ratings.

What it covers: the PadelTrue catalogue, not the whole market. The ratings for power, control, handling, forgiveness and comfort are calculated from five published specifications with a formula printed on the website. They are not play tests, laboratory measurements, customer reviews or a personal fitting. When a rating input is missing the app says so, because a rating built on fewer inputs is less certain. When a maker's own page contradicts itself, the app reports the contradiction instead of choosing one side.

What it does not do: it does not sell rackets, take payments, hold accounts or give medical advice. A price is the price seen on the source page on the date shown. It does not tell you whether a racket is in stock or delivered to your country.

The app is read only and needs no sign-in. The app operates on the tool arguments sent for your request and does not request access to your full conversation or an account profile. Service request metadata and retention are described in our privacy policy.

PadelTrue may earn from eligible retailer links on its website. Commissions do not change ratings or result order. The data is open under CC BY 4.0.

This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to one HoverBot workspace, so the people who run a support bot can ask about it in plain language instead of reading dashboards.

It answers questions like: what did shoppers ask about returns last week that the bot could not answer, how does this week's conversation volume compare to last week's, and which knowledge sources mention the refund window.

HoverBot is an AI chatbot platform that answers customer questions from a company's own catalog, policies, and documentation.

Nine tools are available. list_chatbots and get_chatbot return the bots in the workspace and one bot's configuration, including its system prompt and knowledge libraries. list_knowledge_sources and search_knowledge cover the files, links, text and question-and-answer pairs that ground its replies. list_conversations and get_conversation return recent shopper conversations and full transcripts, with the retrieval confidence for each turn. get_unanswered_questions reports questions the bot answered from weak grounding and questions that produced no answer at all, each with its conversation id. get_analytics_summary returns conversation and message volume, active sessions, response rate and average response time, this week against last. list_leads returns the contact details the bots captured.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin cannot change a chatbot, edit a knowledge base, contact a lead, or alter any setting.

Access is granted by signing in to HoverBot, and the grant fixes which workspace the plugin can read. The workspace is never taken from a tool argument, so the plugin cannot reach another customer's data. Access tokens are listed in the HoverBot dashboard with the time each was last used, and revoking one takes effect on the next request.

search_knowledge matches keywords rather than meaning; the chatbot's own answering uses semantic retrieval, and this tool does not.

release.description: Audit, understand, and safely update authorized Google Tag Manager containers through ChatGPT.

interface.short_description: Connect Google Tag Manager
interface.long_description:
HYPD.AI for Tag Manager brings data from authorized Google Tag Manager accounts into ChatGPT, helping marketers, agencies, analytics teams, ecommerce teams, and developers understand how tracking is configured, troubleshoot implementation problems, compare versions, and make controlled changes.

Use it to:

• Discover the Google Tag Manager accounts and containers available to you, then select the correct container before beginning an audit or implementation task.

• List container workspaces and inspect complete snapshots of their tags, triggers, and variables to understand the current tracking architecture.

• Open individual tags, triggers, and variables in full to examine configuration details, firing conditions, dependencies, and naming conventions.

• Audit measurement setups for missing, duplicated, outdated, or potentially misconfigured components, including tags and triggers associated with GA4, Google Ads conversions, consent management, and other marketing or analytics platforms.

• Find overly broad or restrictive firing conditions, inconsistent naming, unnecessary duplication, orphaned variables, and other configuration risks that can affect data quality.

• Review the currently published container version and compare historical versions to understand exactly what changed, identify possible regressions, and prepare clear release notes.

• Plan tracking implementations conversationally and create drafts for new or replacement tags, triggers, and variables without immediately changing the container.

• Review proposed changes before they are applied, including the affected entities, configuration, intended outcome, and implementation reasoning.

• Create restorable container versions from approved workspace changes so each implementation has a documented release point.

• Publish an approved container version through a separate confirmation step, keeping workspace changes and live-site publication under distinct controls.

• Produce tracking audits, implementation plans, QA checklists, change summaries, and stakeholder-friendly explanations without manually documenting the entire container.

HYPD.AI only accesses accounts and containers available through the connected user. Reading, auditing, and analysis do not modify Google Tag Manager.

Changes follow a guarded workflow: HYPD.AI prepares a draft, shows the proposed change for review, requires explicit approval, and only then applies it. Publishing a version requires a separate approval. HYPD.AI cannot bypass Google Tag Manager permissions, change user access, delete containers, or silently apply unapproved changes.

Users should validate changes with Google Tag Manager’s Preview and Debug tools before publishing and remain responsible for deciding when a version is ready to go live.

release.description: The counter of a Bangladeshi vehicle-rental shop, in plain words: what is free, what is out, who owes, what earns — and, with permission, the bookings, handovers and payments themselves.

interface.short_description: Your vehicle-rental counter
interface.long_description:
RentnRide is the system a Bangladeshi vehicle-rental shop runs its counter on — bikes and cars out by the hour, the half-day, the day, the week or the month, with deposits, advances, handovers, dues and overdue tracking. This connector gives the owner and staff of ONE rental company a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what is free next weekend and get the count per class, with registrations, before you quote anybody. Ask what is happening today and get the bikes physically out, the ones due back before midnight and the ones already late. Ask who owes money and get it oldest first, with a number to ring. Ask what actually earns — by vehicle, by class, by channel or by driver — and get what was collected, biggest first, with deposits kept out of it because a deposit is money you expect to give back. Ask what one rental would come to and get the total with the rate-card lines it is built from. Ask about one booking by the number your staff say out loud and get its whole story.

With the owner's permission it also runs the counter: make a booking and hold the vehicle, extend it or move it to another bike, cancel it, hand a vehicle out and take it back with the meter reading, take a payment or hand a deposit back, charge a late fee the return worked out or damage the owner has assessed, add a vehicle and record when its papers expire, take one off the road for service and put it back, publish a price list, bar a customer or lift a bar, change what the public page says, and mint a link a renter opens to see their own booking. Each of those is a SEPARATE permission on the consent screen, in Bangla and English, and each says what it will do to the shop before it is granted.

Everything is scoped to the single rental company the signed-in user belongs to. No tool takes a company, tenant or shard parameter, and there is no way to ask for one. It cannot double-book a vehicle — that is decided inside one SQL statement by the platform's conflict authority, not by anything a model says. It cannot reverse a payment, book around a bar, change a colleague's role, or read an NID or licence number: those need a manager standing at the counter with their own credential, and there is deliberately no tool for any of them.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

- Which AI crawlers robots.txt blocks or allows

- A prioritised list of fixes you can copy, or ask for drafts of

You can also compare up to eight sites side by side, for example your site against competitors, and see who leads in each category.

How Glippy fetches: it reads only public files of the site you name (the homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and standard /.well-known discovery files), identifies itself as GlippyBot, and does not fetch a site whose robots.txt disallows GlippyBot. release.description:
Keel turns your ideas into systematic strategies for Hyperliquid crypto perpetual futures (perps). Connect it to ChatGPT, describe a strategy, and ChatGPT builds it from Keel's strategy components, backtests it on real Hyperliquid history with fees and slippage, and explains the results.

With Keel in ChatGPT you can:
- Build and edit strategies by describing them
- Backtest them and compare runs side by side
- Start from a verified strategy in the Keel library
- Keep notes on strategies and share a result by link
- See how the strategies you run in Keel are doing

Everything you create stays in your Keel workspace. Nothing is public unless you share it.

Keel in ChatGPT is for strategy research and backtesting. It does not place trades, submit orders, move funds or connect wallets — no order executes inside ChatGPT. What it writes is limited to your own Keel workspace: strategy drafts, backtest runs, notes and share links. Running a strategy with real capital is set up and approved by you in the Keel web app, outside ChatGPT. Backtests are simulations on historical data, not predictions or financial advice; trading perpetual futures carries a substantial risk of loss.

Keel measures the strategies you design. It does not give investment advice or recommendations, and backtest results do not predict future returns.

CALIL for AI lets ChatGPT search the catalogs of more than 7,400 public, university, and specialized libraries in Japan.

release.description: TalentDesk for recruitment agencies on Bullhorn or JobAdder: the day's list, candidate search, deep shortlists, applicants, the pipeline, business-development leads, submissions, interviews, placement fees and drafts, from chat.

interface.short_description: Your recruitment desk in chat
interface.long_description:
TalentDesk is a recruitment workspace for agencies that run on Bullhorn or JobAdder. Connect it and ask about your desk in plain English.

- Start the day: your Today list of who to call, who applied and which roles need you, and tick items off.
- Find candidates: search your whole database by role, skills, employer or town, and read a candidate's profile, CV and history.
- Shortlist: the deep shortlist ranks the best people in your database for a job's criteria, with what each one meets and misses. Add the ones you choose to the job.
- Applicants: see who applied and how well each fits, shortlist or decline them, and add them to a job. Add new candidates from CVs you attach to the chat.
- Pipeline: every candidate across your jobs by stage. Move stages, add notes and record interview outcomes.
- Win work: business-development leads, meaning companies hiring for the roles you fill and clients who have gone quiet.
- Submit: prepare the anonymised submission pack and cover email for a client.
- Interviews and placements: see and schedule interviews, and preview a placement fee against the client's terms of business.
- Write: job ads to copy, and availability requests and candidate or client emails in your own voice, saved as drafts in your own Outlook.

You stay in control. Sending an email or a submission pack, adding a CRM note, booking an interview, shortlisting candidates onto a job, deciding on an applicant, adding candidates and saving a placement are shown to you first and happen only when you confirm. Moving a candidate's stage updates your CRM as soon as you ask. Your assistant sees only what you can see in TalentDesk: by default names are shortened, contact details masked and CVs held back, unless your agency approves full data for the app. In that default mode the deep shortlist still shows each candidate's fit and what they meet and miss, with a short verbatim CV line where one exists. A workspace can run in Test mode, where emails go to a test address and CRM changes are simulated.

In ChatGPT Work (on the web, or in the desktop app with Cloud selected) and in dots, ChatGPT can also keep watch for you: ask it to tell you when your Today list is ready each morning, when someone applies to one of your jobs, or when a job's deep shortlist has finished, and what to do when it happens.

Requires a TalentDesk account. Drafts, sends and bookings go through your own Microsoft 365 account, which you connect in TalentDesk.

Energievergelijker by WVE is een Nederlandse energievergelijking en -bemiddeling voor stroom en gas, aangeboden door WVE. Je vergelijkt stroom- en gasaanbiedingen van een selectie leveranciers op basis van je adres en jaarverbruik. It builds a preparation checklist for policies, refunds, fulfillment, billing disclosures, currency handling, and authentication questions, and it keeps the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the EEA distinct. Approved coverage is conditional on underwriting and setup. It is not merchant approval. Entities outside comprehensively sanctioned jurisdictions may apply, and no US SSN or ITIN is needed to apply. This app never collects those numbers. Customer markets can be any non-sanctioned country, with the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the EEA kept distinct. Presentment currencies, settlement currencies, routes, and payment methods follow that approved catalog, including EUR to USD and GBP to USD, with conversion only when the currencies differ. Fees, reserves, and payout timing stay unknown. The app does not approve a merchant, move money, submit an application, or contact anyone. It does not store what you type. Do not enter card numbers, government IDs, or bank details. Some product categories are outside what this ChatGPT app will plan. Results are planning information, not legal or underwriting advice. OpenAI has not endorsed this app.

release.description: Look up nutrition facts, ingredients and allergen labeling for about 320,000 Korean packaged foods from Korean government open data. Read-only, no sign-in.

interface.short_description: Korean packaged food nutrition
interface.long_description:
Mukscan Food Facts looks up the official label data of Korean packaged foods: nutrition facts, ingredients, allergen labeling and HACCP status for about 320,000 products registered with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

Ask about a snack, ramen, drink or sauce from a Korean store and get the numbers from government records instead of a guess. For example: how much sodium is in one bag of Saeukkang (새우깡), or how Shin Ramyun and Jin Ramen compare per 100g.

What it does
- Searches products by Korean name, optionally narrowed by manufacturer
- Shows nutrition facts (up to 15 nutrients) per 100g or 100ml and per package, the ingredient list when available, allergen labeling as recorded, and the data reference date
- Compares 2 to 5 products side by side per 100g

What it does not do
- No prices, stores, purchase links or ads
- No health judgments or diet advice
- No "safe to eat" verdicts on allergens. Allergen data exists for about 4.6% of products, and missing data does not mean a product is allergen-free. Always check the package label.

Data comes from Korean government open data (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety; Korea Agency of HACCP Accreditation and Services), published under KOGL Type 1. Every answer carries the source and the data reference date. Read-only, no account needed.

release.description: Plan, schedule and track social media posts across the accounts connected to a PurrPlan workspace.

interface.short_description: Plan & schedule social posts
interface.long_description:
PurrPlan is a social media planning workspace. Connect it to ChatGPT to turn a brief into a dated content calendar without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Draft a post once and adapt it per network, then save it as a draft or schedule it for a date and time you choose.
- Plan a whole week of posts from a single brief, review each one, and adjust before anything goes out.
- Attach images or video to a post by importing media from a public URL.
- Read the comments, mentions and private messages collected from your connected accounts, and keep them organised.
- Look at how published posts performed: reach, impressions, engagement, and which posts did best over a period.

How it works: PurrPlan connects to your social accounts through each platform's official integration. You connect those accounts once in PurrPlan, then this plugin acts only on the workspaces your signed-in account can already access. Nothing is published to a network that you have not connected yourself.

Limitations to know before you start:
- You need an existing PurrPlan account with at least one connected social account. The plugin does not connect social accounts for you; that happens in PurrPlan.
- Publishing is asynchronous. A scheduled post leaves at the time you set, not at the moment you ask for it.
- Each network imposes its own rules, which PurrPlan enforces: length limits, how many images a post may carry, whether threads or first comments are supported, and which formats accept video. A request that breaks one of those rules is refused with the reason rather than silently trimmed.
- The inbox is read-only from here: you can read and sort conversations, but answering a message happens in PurrPlan. Publishing a reply is irreversible, so it is not delegated to the assistant.
- Analytics cover the periods the connected platforms expose, and a post published minutes ago has no figures yet.

Schedule a post for a specific date and time
Plan a week of posts from a single brief
Create a series of stories from images

Import an image or video from a public URL

Clonerrr is a marketing research tool for the people who grow mobile apps: founders, marketers and user acquisition teams. It does two jobs. It shows you real app ads and how they are built, and it audits an app's store listing against its competitors.

Ad research: search a library of real video ads that apps ran on Facebook and Instagram, taken from Meta's Ad Library. HS code lookup: describe a garment or accessory and get the likely 6-digit customs code with the reasons, close alternatives, and links to the US, UK and EU tariffs.

Landed cost: from a factory price to landed cost per destination market, with freight, duty, other costs, wholesale and retail margins, and suggested prices.

No account is needed. Images and tech packs are kept for up to 7 days so you can keep working on them, then deleted.

release.description: Turns rough drafts into clear, structured prompts and recommends an AI model, tool and effort level for the task, across 15 AI platforms. Asks focused follow-up questions before writing anything. It writes prompts only and does not carry out the task.

interface.short_description: Prompt writing & model advice
interface.long_description:
Prompt & Model Optimizer helps you turn a rough draft into a clear, structured prompt and suggests which AI model, tool and effort level to use for the task.

How it works
1. Paste a draft, or describe the prompt you need. It identifies the goal and what is missing, such as audience, format or length.
2. It suggests a model, tool and effort level with a one-line reason. It looks up the model's status in a list the developer maintains, and if it cannot confirm the current status, it tells you. The suggestion is optional: you can choose a different model.
3. Before writing anything, it asks its follow-up questions in one message, so you can answer in a single reply (for example 1a, 2c, 3b).
4. It rewrites your draft as a structured prompt for the tool you chose, for example with XML tags or Markdown sections, keeping your goal and facts. Coding prompts include a verification step.
5. Ask for changes and it updates the same prompt. A task that spans several tools can be split into one prompt per tool, with notes on what to carry from one step to the next.

Supported platforms
15 AI platforms, including chat assistants, coding agents, and design and writing tools. Ask whether your tool is supported. Where information about a platform is limited, it tells you.

Good to know
- It writes prompts. It does not carry out the task, browse the news or answer general questions.
- If you ask for an image, video, audio or code, it writes a prompt for a supported tool instead.
- Model information can change at any time. Check the provider's own documentation before relying on it.
- To look up model status and search its prompting notes, it sends model names and search terms to the developer's server, which does not store them. See the privacy policy for details.
- Please do not paste passwords, keys or sensitive personal data.
- Independent tool. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any AI provider.

release.description: Retirement and savings Monte Carlo simulator: household income, living expenses, savings and investment returns under random inflation, salary growth and market returns. Supports about 190 countries (curated data for Taiwan, Japan, US, China and Canada).

interface.short_description: Retirement & wealth simulator
interface.long_description:
WealthStoryLine runs a 3,000-path Monte Carlo simulation of a household's finances: one household income, living expenses, today's savings and investment returns, under random inflation, salary growth and market returns. Ask questions such as "Can I retire at 60?", "Will my savings last?" or "Can I reach $500,000 by 45?" and get the probability of reaching your goal, the bankruptcy rate and net-asset ranges for good, middle and bad outcomes in today's money, together with the assumptions that were used.

Who it is for: individuals, couples and financial educators who want to check a plan and its risks in plain language. It supports about 190 countries; Taiwan, Japan, the US, China and Canada use curated assumptions, other countries use 2005-2024 averages of official statistics (World Bank, OECD, BIS).

No sign-in is required. The plugin receives only the numbers needed for a simulation, not your conversation; anonymous inputs and results are deleted after 30 days.

Limitations: results are projections for planning discussions, not financial advice or a guarantee. Home purchases, mortgages, several incomes and fund portfolios are not modelled in this plugin (they are available on the WealthStoryLine website). Taxes and insurance are not modelled. It cannot trade, move money or connect to bank or brokerage accounts.
interface.default_prompt: Can I retire at 60 with $200k saved, $120k income and $70k yearly spending?
default_prompts: Can I retire at 60 with $200k saved, $120k income and $70k yearly spending?
Will $500k last if I retire at 55 and spend $40k a year?
How likely am I to reach $1 million by 50?

release.description: For personal trainers and coaches: turn a client's training program into a Hiignite program, with a demo video for every exercise.

interface.short_description: Client programs for coaches
interface.long_description:
Hiignite is software that personal trainers and coaches use to run their coaching business: client programs, workout tracking, form-check review and messaging. This plugin takes a training program you build in ChatGPT for one of your clients and saves it to your Hiignite program library, where you edit it, assign it to the client, and track it in the Hiignite app.

What it does:
- Drafts the program in Hiignite and checks every exercise against Hiignite's exercise catalogue, so matched exercises come with a demo video the client can watch.
- Saves the draft to your Hiignite library as a multi-week program with days, sets, reps, rest and supersets, ready to edit in the builder.
- Adds exercises the catalogue does not have to your account as your own custom exercises.
- Looks up exercises in the catalogue by name.

Who it is for: personal trainers and coaches who write programs for other people. It is not a workout planner for your own training.

Accounts: drafting needs no account. Saving asks you to sign in to Hiignite, or to create an account.

Limits: a saved program lands in your library unassigned; you assign it to a client in Hiignite. The plugin cannot see your clients, messages, form checks or billing, and it cannot change or delete anything already in your account. It does not write nutrition plans, schedule sessions or send reminders. A program drafted with an assistant is a draft: the coach who assigns it is responsible for it.
interface.default_prompt: I'm a personal trainer. Build an 8-week, 4-day hypertrophy program for my client and draft it in Hiignite.

interface.short_description: Private Secret Santa draws
interface.long_description:
Draw names for Secret Santa without sign-ups or email addresses. List who is taking part, who should not draw whom, the budget and the date, and DrawKind Secret Santa gives every person a private reveal link. Each link opens a page that shows only that person whom they are buying for, with the recipient's wish list, the budget and the exchange date. The pairings are encrypted inside the links, so nobody sees the full list, not even the organizer, unless the organizer asks for it.

Exclusions cover real groups: couples and households who should not draw each other, one-way rules such as "Ana can't draw Bo", and last year's pairs. An optional rule stops two people from drawing each other. Every valid arrangement is equally likely, the result says how many valid arrangements your rules allow, and when no fair draw is possible it explains exactly why (for example, one household holds more than half the group, or someone has excluded everyone).

The interactive card lists the participants and exclusions with a Copy message button for each person and a Copy all messages button, ready to paste into a text, WhatsApp or email. It never shows the pairings. Redraw makes a fresh set of links with a new draw code. Reveal pages work on any phone and are available in English, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Portuguese and Japanese.

For White Elephant (Yankee Swap, Dirty Santa) parties it shuffles a fair turn order, writes the rules (steal limit per gift, optional cap on steals per turn, no immediate steal-backs, a final swap for player 1) and gives you a printable PDF in Letter or A4 with a gift tracker, plus a printable web page.

Good for families, offices, classrooms, friend groups, long-distance exchanges and large teams of 3 to 60 people.

Limitations: it does not send messages for you (you share each link yourself); links cannot be edited after a draw, so changes need a new draw; White Elephant rules are in English; the PDF font cannot print Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic or emoji names, which appear in full on the printable web page.

release.description: Create invoices, quotes, and receipts with exact totals, then download a polished PDF.

interface.short_description: Invoices as polished PDFs
interface.long_description:
An invoice generator for freelancers, contractors, and small businesses that works inside the chat. Describe the work, the client, and the rates, and Billwise builds a professional invoice, quote, estimate, receipt, or credit note, shows a live preview, and gives you a print-ready PDF and a CSV of the lines.

The numbers are exact. Every line is rounded to the currency's minor units (round half up), reductions are applied before tax, and tax is summarised by rate, so an invoice with 23% and 8% VAT shows both groups with the right amounts. Any ISO 4217 currency works with the correct decimals: yen has none, dinar has three.

What you get:
- Invoices, quotes, estimates, receipts, and credit notes with numbering, issue and due dates, or payment terms such as Net 14
- Units such as hours or pieces, per-line or whole-document reductions (percent or fixed), shipping, deposits, and balance due
- Tax, VAT, or GST grouped by rate, with optional seller and client tax IDs
- A clean PDF in A4 or US Letter that paginates long item lists, with your payment instructions and notes
- Optional amount in words
- Edit quantities and prices in the preview and regenerate the PDF

How to make an invoice: ask for something like "Invoice from Northwind Studio to Acme Ltd: 12 hours of design work at 85 USD per hour, due in 14 days".

Limitations: Billwise creates documents only. It does not email invoices, track or process payments, store your documents, or give tax advice; you choose the tax rates. Labels are in English. The PDF prints names, addresses, and descriptions in Latin script with accents (for example Polish, Czech, German, or Vietnamese), Greek, and Cyrillic exactly as typed; Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, or Hebrew text and emoji cannot be printed in the PDF.

Plan paying off early: add a recurring extra payment or one-time lump sums and see the interest saved and how many months sooner the loan is paid off. Switch to biweekly or weekly payments, including accelerated biweekly.

See the whole monthly housing payment (PITI): principal and interest, property tax, homeowners insurance, HOA dues and PMI. PMI is charged only while the loan is above 80% of the home value and drops off once the balance reaches 78%, with the dates shown.

Compare 2 to 4 loans side by side, such as a 15-year vs a 30-year mortgage, different rates, or paying points to lower the rate. Each option shows the payment, total interest, upfront costs, total cost and the break-even month for points or fees.

The interactive view has rate, term and extra-payment sliders, a balance and interest chart, a yearly table and a CSV download.

Results are deterministic calculations from the numbers you give, the last payment is adjusted so the balance ends at exactly zero, and 0% loans are handled. No personal information is needed.

Limitations: fixed-rate loans only (no adjustable-rate resets, interest-only or balloon loans); it does not look up current rates, taxes or insurance quotes; results are informational and are not financial advice.

release.description: Time card calculator for hours worked, lunch breaks, overtime, and gross pay, with CSV and PDF timesheets.

interface.short_description: Hours worked, breaks, overtime
interface.long_description:
A time card calculator for hours worked. Give ShiftSum Time Card your clock-in and clock-out times and it adds them up exactly: multiple in and out punches per day, split shifts, overnight shifts that cross midnight, and unpaid lunch breaks, in 12-hour (am/pm) or 24-hour military time. Times written without am/pm, like 9 to 5, are read sensibly and the reading is shown at the top of the result so you can confirm it.

Every day is shown in hours and minutes and in decimal hours, so you can copy the right number into payroll. Hours are split into regular, overtime, and double time per workweek: the US federal rule (over 40 hours a week at 1.5x), California daily rules (over 8 hours a day, double time over 12, and the 7th consecutive day), or your own thresholds. A biweekly time card is split into its two workweeks, so overtime is never averaged away. Add an hourly rate to get gross pay to the cent.

Optional punch rounding covers the nearest 5, 6, or 15 minutes and the 7-minute rule. It flags overlapping punches, missing clock-outs, and shifts longer than 16 hours.

The time card appears as an editable table in the chat: fix a time or a break and the totals recalculate. Download a CSV for spreadsheets or a clean printable PDF timesheet with employee and supervisor signature lines.

Good for hourly employees checking a paycheck, small business owners and managers totaling staff time cards, freelancers logging billable hours, and anyone asking how to calculate hours worked in decimals.

Limitations: overtime rules vary by jurisdiction and contract, so results are informational and not payroll, tax, or legal advice. It calculates gross pay only (no taxes or deductions), does not track time live or store time cards, and handles up to 62 days per calculation.

interface.short_description: LiteTMS in plain language
interface.long_description:
LiteTMS is a transport management system (TMS) that road carriers and freight forwarders use to run their fleet, drivers, contractors and transport orders. This plugin connects your company's LiteTMS workspace, so you can ask about your drivers and keep your reminders in plain language.

What you can do today:
- Find a driver or another employee by name, status or position, and see who is active.
- Get a person's phone numbers and e-mail addresses.
- Check their documents and expiry dates: valid, expiring, expired or unknown.
- See the vehicle and trailer a driver uses, their languages, ADR qualification and branches.
- List your own reminders, and add, move, change or delete one.

How access works: you sign in with your own LiteTMS account. The plugin sees exactly what you may see in LiteTMS; your role and branches apply to every answer.

Who it is for: dispatchers, forwarders, fleet managers and office staff of companies that already use LiteTMS.

Limits: it changes data only through the tools made for that, never beyond your role, and your company's audit log records each change; everything else is read only. A reminder stays yours unless you ask for the whole company to see it. Orders, vehicles and GPS positions are not available yet. It never returns home addresses, dates of birth, bank details, salary, document numbers or attached files.

Before you start: you need a LiteTMS account, and AI app access has to be turned on for your company. An administrator turns it on in LiteTMS under Administration > Marketplace, or with one click on the Allow page the first time they connect. Then enter your company's LiteTMS address (for example acme for acme.litetms.eu), sign in and choose Allow. Disconnect at any time in LiteTMS under Settings > Connected apps.

Paycheck calculator for 2026: see how much is your paycheck after taxes, per check and per year. Give a salary, an hourly wage with hours and overtime, or the gross pay per check, plus your state, and Netwise Paycheck Calculator shows your take-home pay line by line.

What it computes:
- Federal income tax withholding with the IRS Publication 15-T (2026) percentage method and your Form W-4: filing status, the Step 2 box, Step 3 dependents (2,200 dollars per child under 17), and Step 4(a), 4(b) and 4(c).
- Social Security at 6.2% up to the 2026 wage base of 184,500 dollars, Medicare at 1.45%, and the 0.9% Additional Medicare tax on wages over 200,000 dollars, check by check through the year.
- State income tax withholding from each supported state's 2026 formula or brackets, plus state employee payroll taxes such as California SDI, New York PFL, New Jersey FLI, and Washington Cares. New York City and Yonkers local tax are included when you say so.
- Pre-tax 401(k), HSA, and health premiums, and Roth 401(k).
- Net pay per paycheck and per year, effective tax rates, and the paycheck where Social Security stops.

Compare two scenarios side by side, for example a job offer in Texas against one in California, or how much more per paycheck you keep if you raise your 401(k) to 10%. Or work backward: what salary do you need to take home 5,000 dollars a month?

The card shows a pay breakdown with a chart, a per check or per year toggle, and editable inputs. Download a PDF estimate and a CSV with one row per 2026 paycheck.

Limits: results are estimates for tax year 2026, not pay stubs, payroll, or tax advice. States without a verified 2026 method are clearly marked as not included. Most city, county, and school district taxes, bonuses and supplemental wages, tips, and self-employment tax are not modeled.

release.description: Prorated rent and tenant rent ledgers with late fees, running balance, and a PDF statement.

interface.short_description: Rent ledgers and prorated rent
interface.long_description:
LeaseLine Rent Ledger calculates prorated rent and a tenant's rent balance for small landlords and property managers. Give it the lease terms and the payments you received, and it builds a tenant ledger with amounts computed to the cent: rent charged each month, partial payments, late fees by your lease rule, and a running balance, plus the amount due as of any date.

Prorated rent for move-in and move-out: enter the rent and the move-in or move-out date and see the amount by all three common methods side by side, with the daily rate and the formula: actual days in the month, a 30-day month, and a 365-day year (rent x 12 / 365). The move-in and move-out days both count, and leap-year February is handled.

Tenant ledger: rent is charged on the due day each month, with a prorated first and last month. Payments are applied to the oldest charge first (or to rent before late fees, if your lease says so), and an overpayment becomes a credit that carries forward. Late fees follow the rule you enter: a flat fee, a percent of rent, a daily fee with a monthly cap, or a flat fee plus a daily fee, after a grace period. Rent increases, utility bills, pet rent, returned check fees and concessions can be added. Type the payments in the chat or attach a CSV or Excel file with a date column and an amount column.

The ledger appears as a table with a running balance, a summary card (total charged, paid, late fees, balance due), and a proration explainer. Download a clean PDF tenant ledger statement for your records or for the tenant, an Excel workbook (ledger, rent by month, summary), and a CSV.

Good for landlords who need a rent ledger template filled in, proof of rent payments for a tenant, the balance after a partial payment, or a tenant payment history for the year.

Limitations: this is a calculation, not legal advice. It applies the late fee rule you enter and does not check state or city late-fee limits, so check your state's rules. It does not calculate security deposit interest, collect rent, send notices, or store ledgers; download links expire after about an hour. Amounts are in US dollars, proration applies when rent is due on the 1st, and a ledger covers up to 10 years and 5,000 payments.

release.description: Commission payouts and rep statements from your comp plan, to the cent.

interface.short_description: Commission payouts, statements
interface.long_description:
Quotaline Commissions calculates sales commission payouts and commission statements for a sales team from its comp plan. Give it the plan terms and the sales, or attach a deals export from your CRM or spreadsheet, and it works out what each rep earned, deal by deal, to the cent.

It handles the plan structures that cause commission disputes: flat rates, tiered commission with marginal (stepped) or retroactive tiers, quota attainment with accelerators and decelerators, commission caps, recoverable and non-recoverable draws against commission with the balance carried forward, split deals (60/40 or across several reps), SPIFFs and bonuses, clawbacks for refunded or cancelled deals inside a clawback window, commission on gross margin, and OTE with target variable pay. When a plan does not say whether tiers are retroactive, both results are shown side by side so you can check the signed plan before payroll.

Typical tasks:
- How much commission do I get on 72k if I earn 5% up to 50k and 8% above?
- How much commission did each rep earn this month? (upload the deals CSV or Excel file; columns such as rep, deal, amount, margin, close date and status are matched automatically)
- Recoverable draw against commission: what is payable now and what carries forward?
- Compare two comp plans at 50% to 200% of quota and see where one overtakes the other.

Each statement lists each deal with the tier and rate applied, the draw recovered, clawbacks and the amount payable now. Download a commission statement PDF (one section per rep, with signature lines) and an Excel workbook with the team summary, each deal line and the tier breakdown. The widget shows rep cards with quota attainment bars and a marginal vs retroactive toggle.

Limitations: it follows the plan terms you enter and does not read comp plan documents. It does not compute payroll taxes, withholding or take-home pay. Up to 5,000 deal rows and 200 reps per run; CSV and .xlsx files only (no PDF or scanned files). Download links expire after about an hour. Results are informational; your signed compensation plan governs.

interface.short_description: Check a page's AI readiness
interface.long_description:
MAIO GEO Scanner checks how ready a single public web page is to be found, read and cited by AI assistants, then explains the result in plain language.

What it does
- Scores one page from 0 to 100 using MAIO's GEO scoring, with category scores for crawl access, answer-ready content, structured data, images, and, depending on the platform, freshness and trust signals.
- Reports the signals behind the score, such as structured data, Open Graph tags, lists, and whether a sitemap was found.
- Suggests up to three fixes that apply to what the scanner observed.

What it does not do
- It scores the page's initial HTML. Pages that build their content in the browser may be reported as incomplete, and no score is given in that case.
- It checks one page, not a whole site, and it does not measure real AI rankings or promise that a change will get the page cited.
- Suggested fixes are candidates, not a full audit or a ranking of importance.
- It never changes your website, and it respects each site's robots.txt.

Sign-in
- Requires signing in with a MAIO account. You can create one during sign-in. MAIO sees the page addresses you check, not your ChatGPT conversations.

Scores come from the MAIO scanner; this connector does not rescore them. Scoring profiles differ by platform (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow), so compare scores only between pages scored the same way.

PopUp Surf Trips watches 138 surf spots across the Americas and the Caribbean on a 16-day forecast and matches good surf windows to your own profile: skill level, the biggest wave you are comfortable on, water temperature, home airport and budget.

Ask "Any surf trips lining up for me?" and you get your matched trips best first: a dated surf window that runs as long as the swell lasts, departing 3 to 14 days from now, the spot and country, wave size and rating, a 0-10 Match Score with the reason it matched, a live flight price from your airport, places to stay for those exact dates, and sometimes a guided-surf camp. When the window is longer than the trip you want, it says which day is best so you can pick your own dates inside it. Ask why a trip matched, open one trip in detail, watch a spot so a good window there reaches you, or raise or lower your max wave height.

You sign in with your PopUp Surf Trips account. Booking links open the airline, stay or camp page in your browser; nothing is booked inside ChatGPT. The plugin is a trip builder, not a surf report: it will not guess conditions at a spot it has not matched for you, and it never changes your phone number, email or password.

release.description: Look up when a wine is ready to drink: estimated drinking window, peak years, and current status.

interface.short_description: Wine drinking windows
interface.long_description:
Sommelier's Window helps you decide when to open a bottle. Ask about a specific wine and vintage and get its estimated drinking window, peak years, and current status (for example Hold, Approaching Peak, or At Peak), shown on a simple timeline.

What you can do
- Search the Sommelier's Window database of analyzed wines by name, producer, and vintage.
- Get the drinking window for one wine: optimal years, peak years, how many years remain or until the window opens, a short condition and tasting summary, food pairing ideas, and decanting guidance.
- See a published critic score when one is available, with its source.
- If a wine is not in the database yet, ask for it to be analyzed. The analysis is added as a public page on sommelierswindow.com. New analyses are limited per day.

Good to know
- Drinking windows are estimates for properly stored bottles. Cellar temperature, humidity, light, closure, and bottle variation all affect how a wine ages, so treat the dates as a guide, not a guarantee.
- The status is calculated from the window years and the current year.
- The plugin provides educational wine information only, about how wines age and when they show best. It does not sell wine, process payments, give medical advice, or encourage drinking.
- No account or sign-in is needed, and the plugin cannot see your cellar or any personal data. The privacy policy explains what is processed, including how the daily limit on new analyses is enforced.

interface.short_description: Detect AI images, video, audio
interface.long_description:
Diopter AI checks whether a photo, video, or audio clip was generated or manipulated by AI. Upload a file in chat or share a link, and Diopter runs it through its trained deepfake detection models, then returns a verdict (for example: no AI detected, AI-generated, or inconclusive) with a confidence level and a link to the full report on diopter.ai.

Use it to sanity-check a suspicious image before sharing it, verify a video someone sent you, or look up the result of an earlier scan by its request ID. Sign in with your Diopter account to keep a history of your scans in your dashboard.

Each check is saved to your Diopter account, so ChatGPT asks you to confirm before running it.

Diopter analyzes media. It does not create, edit, or alter images, video, or audio, and it does not identify the people in them.

Detection is probabilistic: treat results as evidence to weigh, not a guarantee.

interface.long_description:
Greca House is an independent real-estate brokerage in central Athens. It continues the independent brokerage activity established by founder and owner Iryna Rondyak in Athens in 2008. This plugin lets you work with its public listings and research inside ChatGPT.

What it does:
- Search Greca House's current listings in Greece for sale or rent: apartments, villas, maisonettes, buildings, land and commercial property in Athens, Attica, the Peloponnese, the islands and elsewhere. Filter by area, budget, size, an exact number or range of bedrooms, listings with a 3D model, 360° tour or video, and listings Greca House classifies under a Golden Visa property route.

Limits:
- Results cover Greca House's own listings, not every property in Greece. Prices are asking prices, not sale prices.

- Cost estimates are not legal or tax advice; new-build VAT and exemptions are not modelled.
- Read-only: the plugin does not contact the agency, book viewings or store what you ask. Use the listing or contact links to reach Greca House.

release.description: Build and run an AI sales assistant for your online store from ChatGPT.

interface.short_description: AI sales assistant for stores
interface.long_description:
MyChatBot gives your online store an AI sales assistant. It answers your customers in Instagram and Messenger DMs, WhatsApp, Telegram, and the chat on your website, using your own product catalog and store policies. It recommends products, takes orders in the conversation, and flags chats that need a person.

With MyChatBot in ChatGPT, you build and run that sales assistant by describing your business. You don't need to open a dashboard for most tasks.

Set it up
- Share your website or describe what you sell. ChatGPT drafts your sales assistant's name, greeting, sales instructions, and a starter FAQ, and shows them on one card. Nothing is created until you approve it.
- Add a chat to your website. You get a code snippet to paste and a hosted page where you can try your sales assistant straight away.
- Add a call button to your website so visitors can talk to your sales assistant out loud.
- Connect Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, or TikTok. You get a link that finishes each connection in your MyChatBot account.

Teach it your store
- Import your catalog from a product feed or from a list you give it. Your sales assistant then answers with your real products, prices, and stock, and the feed refreshes on a schedule.
- A Shopify store connects from its web address alone, with no Shopify app or keys. Your sales assistant then sends shoppers a link to your Shopify checkout with their items already in the cart.
